title: Social Media Manager & Content Designer
description:
Social Media Content Producer — Skin Clinic Group (Ireland)



Job Type: Full-time, remote (40 hrs/week)

Salary: ₱70,000 - ₱100,000/month, depending on portfolio

Working hours: Flexible, but a minimum 3-hour daily overlap with Irish time (GMT/IST) is required

Start: Immediate, after a paid trial



About us



We are a group of three brands based in Cork and Dublin, Ireland:



The FILO Clinic — a nurse-led advanced skin and laser clinic

FILO First Skin + Glow Studios — an entry-level skin and glow studio

CALMA Health + Wellness — massage and wellness



Our brand voice is calm, educational and evidence-based. We are not a hype brand. We do not use shock before/afters, countdown-timer discounts, or "miracle" language. Clients come to us because they are tired of being sold to. If you have worked on Philippine beauty accounts with a whitening, glutathione or celebrity-endorsement style, this is the opposite of that — please only apply if you can adapt.



 What you'll do



Production (the bulk of the role)



- Edit our existing library of professional photo and video assets into finished content — Reels, carousels, static posts, Stories

- Publish 3 grid posts per week per brand, scheduled in advance and approved before posting

- Build and publish Stories daily: 3–5/day for The FILO Clinic and FILO First, 2/day for CALMA

- Repurpose and redistribute content to TikTok,
 and YouTube Shorts with format-appropriate edits (not straight re-uploads)

- Add captions, subtitles, on-screen text and light motion graphics

- Keep our media library organised and tagged so assets are findable and reused properly



Planning and analysis



- Maintain a rolling 4-week content calendar for approval

- Track and report monthly on reach, saves, shares, profile visits, follower growth and link clicks — with a short written read on what worked and what didn't

- Research trending audio, hooks and formats each week and propose which ones fit our brand (and flag which ones don't)

- Build shot lists and content requests ahead of our photo and video shoot days, based on gaps you've identified in the calendar



Non-negotiables



These are legal and clinical requirements in Ireland. Applicants who cannot work within them will not be considered.



- No before/after images may be published unless we have explicitly confirmed written client consent for that specific image

- No content referencing prescription-only medicines, including botulinum toxin, by brand or generic name — this is illegal to advertise to the public in the EU

- No treatment advice, pricing promises or medical claims in captions, comments or DMs. Enquiries get routed to us, always

- Irish English spelling throughout (moisturise, specialise, colour, programme)

- No AI-generated skin imagery or stock "results" photos, ever



Must have



- 5+ years editing short-form video for brands, with a portfolio you personally produced

- Fluent, natural written English — captions must not read as translated

- CapCut and Canva to a high standard; Adobe Premiere Pro and Photoshop a strong plus

- Meta Business Suite scheduling and Instagram Insights

- Reliable fibre internet and a machine that can handle 4K video editing

- Comfortable working from a brief and taking direct feedback



Nice to have



- Experience with medical, aesthetics, dental or wellness clients

- Basic motion graphics (After Effects)

- Experience with an approval workflow (Notion, Trello, ClickUp or similar)



How to apply



Applications without these will be skipped.



1. Send links to **three short-form videos you personally edited**, and for one of them, describe what the raw footage looked like before you touched it.

2. In two sentences: what is one thing most beauty and aesthetics accounts do that you think actively damages trust?

3. Tell us your expected monthly salary in PHP.

4. Start your message with the word **CORK** so we know you read this.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a **paid trial task** — we send you raw footage and you produce three Stories and one Reel. We pay for the trial regardless of whether we hire you.

title: Recruiter
description:
Position Overview



Applied Home Health Network (AHHN) is seeking a results-driven Home Care Recruiter to support our rapid growth across Illinois. This role is responsible for sourcing, screening, and onboarding high-quality caregivers (CNAs, HHAs, RNs, LPNs) to ensure uninterrupted care for our clients.



The ideal candidate is metrics-driven, highly organized, and thrives in a fast-paced healthcare environment, with a strong ability to build pipelines and fill cases quickly and consistently.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-Cycle Recruitment

Source, screen, and hire caregivers (CNAs, HHAs, RNs, LPNs)

Conduct phone and virtual interviews to assess qualifications and cultural fit

Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified candidates to meet staffing demands



2. Staffing & Fill Rate Execution

Partner with scheduling and care support teams to fill open shifts and new cases

Prioritize urgent and high-need cases to minimize unassigned hours

Ensure caregivers are matched appropriately based on skills, availability, and location



3. Candidate Sourcing Strategy

Utilize job boards (Indeed, social media, referrals, community outreach)

Develop relationships with:

CNA training schools

Nursing programs

Community organizations

Execute creative sourcing strategies to attract top talent



4. Onboarding & Compliance

Ensure all candidates meet Illinois requirements, including:

Background checks

Certifications and credentials

Health screenings

Coordinate onboarding process and ensure fast time-to-start



5. Data Tracking & Reporting

Track and report on key recruitment metrics:

Time-to-fill

Fill rate

Pipeline volume

Offer acceptance rate

Maintain accurate records in applicant tracking systems



6. Retention Support

Support caregiver engagement initiatives to reduce turnover

Conduct follow-ups with new hires to ensure satisfaction and retention

Collaborate with HR and operations to address staffing challenges

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Fill rate of open shifts (Target: 95%+)

Time-to-fill new cases (Target: ? 5 days)

Reduction in unassigned hours

Number of active caregivers onboarded weekly/monthly

Caregiver retention (30/60/90-day)

title: Social Media & Podcast Manager (Video, US Real Estate Coaching Brand)
description:
**READ THIS PART FIRST**



To apply, start your message with the word BLUEPRINT. Applications without it are deleted unread. This is the first test of the job, which is following a system exactly.



**WHO WE ARE**



We are a US real estate coaching company and sales team based in Virginia. Our founder, Dan Rochon, is a TEDx speaker and the author of Teach to Sell, published by Post Hill Press and distributed by Simon & Schuster. He hosts the No Broke Months podcast.



Our promise to agents is CPI, which is Consistent and Predictable Income. Every real estate agent wants it, and most have no idea how to build it. We teach them. Dan has not had a broke month since 2008 using this system.



We have a book, a podcast, a coaching community, and real agents whose incomes are changing. All of it is under produced. That is the job.



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**



You are not a posting assistant. You own attention for the whole brand.



- Social media across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn. Short form video first.

- The No Broke Months podcast, end to end. Guest scheduling, editing, publishing, show notes, clips.

- Turning one long form recording per week into a full set of short clips for every channel.

- Book marketing for Teach to Sell, including the Amazon and Audible review campaign.

- Telling our agents' stories. Their wins, their numbers, their transformations.

- A simple monthly report showing reach, views, opt ins, and applications, and what changed and why.



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**



- Content ships on schedule every week without anyone reminding you.

- One recording becomes ten or more usable pieces.

- You can look at last month's numbers and tell us which three things to stop doing.

- Our agents become the story. Not the founder, and not you.



**YOU ARE A FIT IF**



- You have 2+ years running social media or content for a US or international brand, and you can show the accounts.

- You edit short form video yourself. CapCut, Premiere, Descript, or similar.

- You write English that sounds like a person, not like a template.

- You are organized enough to run a publishing calendar and never miss.

- You look at analytics on your own and change what you do because of them.

- You can work at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time.

- You have reliable internet and a backup plan when it fails.



**YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF**



- You need someone to send you a content calendar every week.

- You have never edited a video yourself.

- You want a quiet posting job. This seat is measured.



**HOW WE HIRE, AND WE ARE OPEN ABOUT IT**



Every application is scored by the same AI system our agents use, built on twenty years of top producer sales experience. Everyone gets the same read, the same bar, and a fast answer. No one gets ahead by charming a recruiter.



After the first review, qualified applicants complete a short skills audition. We test the work, not the resume:



Write three hooks for a video we give you.

Look at a post that failed and tell us why.

A simple 90 day plan for one channel.

A 60 to 90 second video of you talking to camera about your best piece of work.



Strong candidates then move to a paid two week trial before anyone commits long term. You will know if this is your seat, and so will we.



**TO APPLY**



Send a message that includes, in this order:



- The word BLUEPRINT at the top.

- Links to two or three accounts or channels you have run, and what you did on each.

- Two short form videos you edited yourself.

- Your monthly salary expectation in USD.

- One sentence: the best performing thing you ever made, and why you think it worked.



We read every application that follows these steps. We read none that do not.

This is more than a simple video uploading position.



I am looking for someone who can help manage the channel, monitor performance, identify opportunities and actively suggest improvements.



You should think like a **YouTube Growth Specialist**.



The goal is to find someone who can eventually become an important part of the channel and grow together with the business.



---



# Main Responsibilities



## 1. Uploading & Publishing Videos



You will be responsible for making sure videos are consistently uploaded and published correctly and on time.



The channel currently aims to publish approximately:



### **3 videos per week**



Your responsibilities include:



* Uploading videos to YouTube

* Scheduling videos correctly

* Making sure videos are published on time

* Uploading the correct thumbnail

* Adding titles and descriptions

* Optimizing metadata and relevant keywords

* Selecting the correct playlists

* Adding end screens and cards where appropriate

* Checking subtitles or captions when available

* Checking monetization and video settings

* Performing a final quality check before publishing



Reliability is extremely important. Videos should always be uploaded and scheduled correctly.



---



# 2. Video Optimization



Every video should be properly optimized to give it the best possible chance of performing well.



This includes:



* Reviewing and optimizing video titles

* Reviewing titles for clickability and audience appeal

* Optimizing descriptions and metadata

* Reviewing thumbnails before publishing

* Making sure the title and thumbnail work well together

* Identifying opportunities to improve video packaging

* Suggesting alternative titles when necessary

* Suggesting thumbnail improvements

* Optimizing videos after publishing when opportunities are identified



I don't want someone who simply uploads the files and moves on.



I want someone who actively thinks about:



**"How can we give this video the best possible chance to perform?"**



---



# 3. Channel Monitoring & Analytics



You will regularly monitor the performance of the channel and individual videos.



Important metrics include:



* CTR (Click-Through Rate)

* Impressions

* Views

* Average view duration

* Audience retention

* Watch time

* Subscriber growth

* Traffic sources

* Overall video performance



You should actively look for patterns and opportunities.



For example:



* Why is one video performing better than another?

* Which titles are generating the highest CTR?

* Which thumbnails are working?

* Which topics are performing best?

* Which videos are underperforming?

* Where are viewers dropping off?

* What can we improve?



You don't need to simply report the numbers.



I want you to analyze what is happening and make recommendations.



---



# 4. Improving Underperforming Videos



Part of your role will be identifying videos that are not performing as well as expected.



When appropriate, you should suggest improvements such as:



* Better titles

* Alternative titles

* Thumbnail changes

* Improved packaging

* Metadata improvements

* Other optimization opportunities



The goal is to continuously improve the channel rather than simply uploading a video and forgetting about it.



---



# 5. Topic Research



Topic research will be an important part of your role.



You will help research and identify:



* New video topics with strong potential

* Topics with proven audience demand

* Trending topics within our niche

* Successful competitor videos

* Topics that are currently gaining momentum

* Opportunities that fit the Rexy Breaks It Down format



I prefer research based on **actual YouTube performance and evidence**, rather than simply brainstorming random ideas.



For example:



* What similar videos are currently getting views?

* What topics have recently performed well?

* Which competitors are growing?

* Which subjects have proven audience demand?

* What titles are working?

* Are there successful ideas that can be adapted to our format?



You should regularly bring researched topic ideas and opportunities to me.



---



# 6. Competitor & Trend Research



You will also monitor relevant competitors and trends.



This includes:



* Following relevant YouTube channels

* Monitoring what competitors are uploading

* Identifying successful videos and topics

* Analyzing titles and thumbnails

* Looking for emerging trends

* Identifying opportunities before they become oversaturated

* Finding successful formats that could inspire new content



The goal is not to copy other channels.



The goal is to understand what audiences are currently interested in and identify opportunities that make sense for Rexy Breaks It Down.



---



# 7. Proactive Channel Growth



This is one of the most important parts of the position.



I am **not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions**.



I want someone who takes initiative.



If you notice an opportunity, problem or potential improvement, I want you to bring it to my attention.



Ideally, your communication should look something like this:



**"I noticed this video is underperforming compared to similar videos. I believe the main reason could be the title and thumbnail. Here are three improvements I recommend."**



I want someone who actively:



* Looks for opportunities

* Analyzes performance

* Identifies problems

* Suggests solutions

* Brings new ideas

* Monitors competitors

* Researches new opportunities

* Helps improve the overall channel strategy



Think like a **YouTube Growth Specialist**, not simply an uploader.



---



# Working Hours



The position will initially start at approximately:



### **5 hours per week**



The workload will initially focus on:



* Approximately 3 video uploads per week

* Upload optimization

* Channel monitoring

* Basic performance analysis

* Improvement suggestions

* Topic and competitor research



However, the channel is growing and we are planning to expand the content production significantly.



Therefore, there is strong potential for the number of hours and responsibilities to increase quickly.



The ideal candidate should be interested in a **long-term collaboration** and preferably have the availability to take on additional hours as the channel grows.



---



# What I'm Looking For



The ideal candidate:



* Has experience working with YouTube channels

* Understands YouTube Studio and Analytics

* Understands CTR and audience retention

* Understands what makes titles clickable

* Understands thumbnails and video packaging

* Has experience with YouTube optimization

* Can conduct topic and competitor research

* Is proactive and independent

* Pays close attention to detail

* Is reliable and organized

* Can consistently meet deadlines

* Communicates clearly in English

* Is interested in YouTube growth and content strategy



Experience with tools such as the following is a plus:



* vidIQ

* TubeBuddy

* Nexlev

* YouTube Analytics

* Other YouTube research or optimization tools



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



This position is intended to become a **long-term collaboration** for the right person.



We are currently starting with approximately **5 hours per week**, but the channel is expanding quickly and the workload is expected to increase.



The right candidate will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and potentially become a larger part of the channel's operations.



As the channel grows, the role may expand into:



* More channel management

* More uploads

* Advanced analytics

* Growth strategy

* Topic research

* Competitor analysis

* Content strategy

* Channel optimization



I want to find someone who can **grow together with the channel**.



---



# When Applying, Please Include



Please answer the following:



1. Tell me about your experience managing YouTube channels.

2. Have you worked with channels similar to this before?

3. Please share examples of channels you have worked on, if possible.

4. What experience do you have with YouTube Analytics?

5. How do you analyze CTR and audience retention?

6. What experience do you have with optimizing titles and thumbnails?

7. How do you normally research new YouTube video topics?

8. Which tools do you use for YouTube research and optimization?

9. How would you identify opportunities to grow a YouTube channel?

10. Are you available to take on more hours as the channel grows?

11. What is your hourly rate?



### Important Question:



**If you were hired today, what would be the first three things you would analyze or improve on a YouTube channel?**



I'm looking forward to finding someone proactive, reliable and ambitious who wants to help grow **Rexy Breaks It Down** into a much larger channel.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
# Full-Time Virtual Assistant — Phone,
 & Jobber Scheduling (US Landscaping Company)



**Company:** Beaver Landscaping LLC — Hilton Head Island & Bluffton, South Carolina

**Website:** www.beaverlandscaping.co

**Type:** Full-time, long-term (40 hrs/week)

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern (= 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine time)

**Salary:** $1,000 – $1,300 USD/month, depending on experience *(night-shift differential included)*

**Start:** ASAP



---



## About us



Beaver Landscaping is a growing landscaping and lawn maintenance company serving homeowners, HOAs, and commercial properties in the South Carolina Lowcountry. We do weekly and recurring maintenance — mowing, trimming, edging, blowing — plus hedge work and seasonal cleanups. Our crews are in the field all day, which means the office side is wide open.



That's the job. You are the office. You are the first voice a customer hears and the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We already have good systems in place — Jobber for our CRM/scheduling, a business phone system with automated text-back, and automated review requests. What we don't have is a person to run it. That's you.



## What you'll do



**Answer the phone (this is a big part of the job)**

- Answer inbound calls live during business hours as a member of the Beaver team — not as an outsourced service

- Take new lead calls: get the property address, the service they want, and book the estimate

- Handle existing customer calls: schedule changes, "when is my crew coming," billing questions, complaints

- Return voi
s and missed calls quickly — speed to lead is how we win business



**Own the inbox and the text line**

- Respond to website form leads,
s, and SMS the same day (usually within minutes)

- Follow up with quotes that haven't been accepted yet

- Keep a friendly, professional, no-typos written voice



**Run Jobber (our CRM)**

- Create and maintain client records, properties, and job notes — clean data, no duplicates

- Build and adjust the crew schedule; move visits when weather or capacity changes

- Turn requests into quotes, quotes into jobs, and completed visits into invoices

- Chase unpaid invoices politely and persistently

- Keep recurring maintenance routes accurate week to week



**General admin**

- Daily end-of-day summary: calls taken, leads booked, issues that need an owner's decision

- Light data entry, reporting, and keeping our prospect lists tidy

- Flag problems early instead of sitting on them



## What we're looking for



**Required**

- Near-native spoken English. Clear, warm, confident on the phone with American customers. This is non-negotiable — we will screen for it.

- 2+ years in customer service, BPO/call center, admin, or virtual assistant work

- Excellent written English — you'll be writing directly to our customers

- Experience with a CRM, scheduling software, or ticketing system (Jobber, ServiceTitan, HousecallPro, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar)

- Reliable computer, headset, and a stable wired/fiber internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps) — plus a backup plan for power/internet outages

- Able to work the US Eastern day shift consistently (overnight in PH) and stick to it

- Organized, self-directed, and comfortable owning a task list without being chased



**Nice to have**

- Direct Jobber experience

- Background in a US home-services business (landscaping, lawn care, pest control, cleaning, HVAC, plumbing, roofing)

- Experience with OpenPhone/Quo, Google Workspace, or Google Business Profile

- Basic bookkeeping or invoicing/collections experience



## What we offer



- Stable, long-term, full-time work with a growing company — not a short project

- Paid training on Jobber and all our tools

- Direct access to the owners; your ideas get heard and implemented

- Performance raises based on results, not tenure

- Paid PH holidays and paid time off after 90 days

- Real ownership of a role that matters — you'll be the operational backbone of the company



## Salary



$1,000 – $1,300 USD/month for full-time (40 hrs/week), paid twice monthly, depending on experience and English fluency. This range already reflects a premium for the overnight PH schedule. Reviewed after 90 days.



---



## How to apply



Applications that don't follow these steps will not be reviewed. We read every one that does.



1. **Start your message with the word "PALMETTO"** so we know you read the whole post.

2. **Record a 60–90 second voice message** (Vocaroo, Google Drive, or any shareable link) where you:

   - Introduce yourself

   - Describe a time you handled an upset or frustrated customer on the phone and how it ended

   - Say this line exactly: *"Thank you for calling Beaver Landscaping, this is [your name], how can I help you today?"*

3. **Tell us in a few sentences:**

   - What CRM or scheduling software you've used, and what you did in it

   - Your experience working US hours, and whether you've done overnight PH shifts before

   - Your internet speed and setup, and your backup plan when power or internet goes out

4. **Confirm** you can work Monday–Friday, 9 AM – 5 PM US Eastern, starting immediately.



We move fast. Strong applicants will hear from us within a few days for a short video interview.

title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING & E-COMMERCE SPECIALIST

Aromabotanical Philippines | MY PRIME AROMA TRADING CORP.

Location: Philippines

Employment: Full-time

Salary: ?30,000/month + performance incentives



ABOUT THE ROLE

MY PRIME AROMA TRADING CORP. is the exclusive Philippine distributor of Aromabotanical, an Australian home fragrance brand.



We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist who will take an active role in building Aromabotanical’s online presence and, most importantly, turning that presence into sales.



This is not a social media posting job.



We are looking for someone who can think beyond “What should we post?” and instead ask:



Who are we trying to reach? What should we sell them? What campaign should we create? What content will make them interested? How do we convert that interest into a purchase? And did it actually generate sales?



You will have significant ownership of Aromabotanical’s digital marketing activities—from brainstorming campaigns and creating content to managing online stores, launching campaigns, coordinating promotions, and analyzing results.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Digital Marketing Strategy

Develop and execute a practical digital marketing strategy for Aromabotanical in the Philippine market.

Help establish the brand’s online identity and positioning.

Research competitors, trends, customers, products, and market opportunities.

Identify which products, customer segments, offers and marketing channels have the greatest sales potential.

Develop monthly marketing plans and campaigns aligned with sales objectives.

Continuously test new ideas and improve based on results.

2. Campaign Development & Execution

You will be expected to develop campaign ideas and actually execute them.



Examples include:



Product launches

Seasonal campaigns

Gift guides

Bundles and promotions

Payday campaigns

Christmas campaigns

Valentine’s Day campaigns

Mother’s Day campaigns

Limited-time offers

Brand-awareness campaigns

User-generated-content campaigns

Influencer/affiliate campaigns

Idea ? Strategy ? Content ? Launch ? Promotion ? Measurement ? Optimization



3. Content Creation

This includes:

Lifestyle content

Product demonstrations

Educational content

Promotional content

Social media graphics

Captions and copywriting

Product descriptions

Advertising creatives

You do not need to be a professional photographer or videographer. However, you should be capable of producing good, commercially useful content independently.



4. Social Media Management

Manage and grow Aromabotanical’s:




Instagram

TikTok

Other relevant platforms

Responsibilities include:



Content planning

Content calendars

Posting

Community engagement

Responding to comments/messages when appropriate

Monitoring trends

Identifying content opportunities

Tracking performance

The objective is not simply to increase followers.



The objective is to build an audience that can ultimately become customers.



5. E-Commerce Management

Help establish and grow Aromabotanical’s online sales channels, including:



Shopee

Lazada

TikTok Shop

Website/e-commerce platform

Responsibilities include:



Product listings

Product titles and descriptions

Product images and videos

Store merchandising

Promotions and vouchers

Bundles

Campaign participation

Pricing/promotion coordination

Store optimization

Monitoring sales and conversion

You should understand how marketplace customers actually shop and what influences conversion.



6. Digital Advertising

Manage and/or coordinate basic paid advertising campaigns through platforms such as:



Meta Ads

TikTok Ads

Shopee/Lazada/TikTok Shop advertising

You will be expected to:



Develop ad concepts

Select appropriate products/offers

Create or coordinate creatives

Launch campaigns

Monitor performance

Test different audiences and creatives

Optimize spending

Track sales and return on advertising spend

We are not looking for someone who simply “boosts posts.”



7. Influencer & Affiliate Marketing

Develop relationships with:



Micro-influencers

Content creators

Affiliates

Relevant lifestyle/home/interior creators

Identify creators who can genuinely help generate awareness and sales, coordinate collaborations, and measure results.



8. Analytics & Reporting

You will regularly track:



Online sales

Traffic

Engagement

Conversion rate

Advertising spend

Cost per acquisition

ROAS

Best-selling products

Campaign performance

Content performance

You should be comfortable looking at numbers and asking:



“Why did this work?”

“Why didn’t this work?”

“What should we change next?”



You will provide regular updates and recommendations to management.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a hands-on digital marketer, not a traditional social media manager.



Required

2–4 years of experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, or a related role.

Practical experience with social media platforms.

Experience with Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop or other e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Experience creating short-form video content.

Basic understanding of Meta/TikTok advertising.

Good copywriting and communication skills.

Comfortable using analytics and sales data.

Strong organizational skills.

Strong commercial mindset—understands that marketing ultimately needs to contribute to business growth.

Strongly preferred

Experience working with:



Consumer brands

Beauty/wellness

Home & lifestyle

Home fragrance

Retail

FMCG

E-commerce startups

Small businesses where you had to wear multiple hats

Experience managing an actual online store with measurable sales results is a major advantage.



THE IDEAL PERSON

You might be a good fit if you can say:



“I have an idea for a campaign, I know who we’re targeting, I can create the content, I can launch it, I can run the ads, and I can tell you whether it worked.”



We want someone who is:



Creative but commercially minded

Strategic but willing to execute

Comfortable getting their hands dirty

Curious and willing to experiment

Data-driven

Proactive

Resourceful

Comfortable working with limited resources

Able to turn an idea into an actual campaign

You will not have a large marketing department behind you.



We need someone who can make things happen.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days

Audit our existing digital presence.

Research competitors and opportunities.

Develop a practical digital marketing roadmap.

Establish priorities for our online channels.

Create the initial content and campaign plan.

60–90 Days

Consistent content and campaign execution.

Improved online presence.

Optimized e-commerce listings/stores.

Initial paid advertising tests.

Initial influencer/affiliate activities.

Measurable online sales.

Clear understanding of which products, content and campaigns perform best.

6–12 Months

Establish a sustainable online sales channel.

Grow marketplace and direct-to-consumer sales.

Develop repeatable campaigns.

Build a growing audience and customer base.

Improve advertising efficiency and conversion.

Establish a clear digital marketing system for Aromabotanical.

IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A CONTENT-ONLY ROLE

Please do not apply if your primary interest is simply:



Creating Instagram posts

Making Canva graphics

Scheduling social media posts

Growing followers

Taking aesthetic product photos

Content creation is part of the job, but it is not the main objective.



Our objective is:



BUILD THE BRAND. BUILD THE AUDIENCE. DRIVE ONLINE SALES.

APPLICATION

Please submit:



Your CV/resume

Portfolio or examples of social media/content work

Examples of e-commerce accounts you have managed, if applicable

A brief description of one digital campaign you personally worked on, including:

What was the objective?

What did you do?

What content/campaign did you create?

How much was spent, if applicable?

What were the results?

Shortlisted applicants will be given a practical case exercise:

“Aromabotanical currently has very limited online presence. You are given the responsibility of building its online sales. What would you do during your first 90 days?”



We are more interested in how you think and execute than in having a perfect answer.



MY PRIME AROMA TRADING CORP.

Exclusive Philippine Distributor of Aromabotanical

title: Virtual Assistant, SEO Delivery
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a part-time Virtual Assistant who sits in every meeting, captures what was agreed, and then makes sure it actually happens. The core of this job is follow-up. You will chase internal team members and external clients until tasks are closed, and you will surface a blockage early rather than reporting it after the deadline has passed.



You need enough SEO knowledge to understand what is being chased and who owns it, and to ask a sensible clarifying question in the room rather than nodding along and getting it wrong later. Admin experience helps but is not a requirement.



Engagement Terms

- Part-time, remote, paid hourly or on a fixed monthly retainer.

- You attend all scheduled internal and client meetings.

- You must be available 30 minutes before and 30 minutes after every meeting. The before block is for prep: last meeting's notes, the open action list, and anything we owe the client that is late. The after block is for output: notes circulated same day and the first round of follow-ups sent immediately, not tomorrow.

- Meeting times follow the client, so many sit within Singapore hours but some will not. You need to be flexible outside a fixed daytime schedule.

- Once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star VA and cleared the interview, you will be added to a WhatsApp group and the relevant client Slack channels.



Key Responsibilities

- Meeting support

- Ask clarifying questions during the meeting when an action item is vague, unowned or undated.

- Prepare the pre-meeting brief in the 30 minutes before: agenda, open items and their current status, and anything overdue on our side.

- Circulate notes in the 30 minutes after, structured as decisions, action items with an owner and a date, and open questions.

Follow-up and chasing

- Follow up with internal stakeholders (writers, editors, SEO specialists, developers) on task status against the agreed dates.

- Follow up with external stakeholders (clients, client-side dev and marketing teams, guest post contacts) for approvals, website access, content sign-off, information and assets.

- Maintain one live tracker of every open item with owner, date requested, date promised, next chase date and status.

- Escalate to the account lead once a chase has failed twice, with a one-line summary of what is stuck and what it is blocking. Do not simply forward the
 thread.

- Flag risk in writing before a deadline is missed, not after.

- Admin support

- Calendar management, scheduling and rescheduling across the team.

- Maintaining trackers, folder structure and file naming in Google Drive.

- Formatting and tidying decks, reports and documents.

- Light data entry into Google Sheets and the project management tool.



Preferred Skills

- Working knowledge of SEO. You do not need to run campaigns, but you should understand on-page, off-page and technical -SEO, what a brief is, what a meta title does, and roughly why rankings take time.

- Confident, persistent follow-up. You are comfortable chasing people more senior than you and clients who have gone quiet.

- Excellent written English. Your notes and chase messages go directly to clients.

- Clear spoken English, since you will be asking questions live on client calls.

- Strong organisation. One tracker, kept current, with nothing held only in your head.

- Google Sheets: filters, sorting, conditional formatting. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP is a bonus.

- Familiarity with a project management tool (Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Monday or Notion).

- Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4 or Looker Studio, even at a viewing level.

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet working space, and a plan for power outages.

title: Sales Representative — Setter & Closer
description:
About the Role

We partner with e-commerce wellness brands to sell high-ticket coaching programs to their existing product buyers. Our leads are warm — these are people who have already purchased a product and are looking for the next step. You are not cold calling strangers.



We have two sales tracks. You will be placed based on your strengths:

Track A — Setter: Contact warm leads, build rapport, qualify the buyer, and book a discovery call. You are the first voice the customer hears.

Track B — Closer: Run the discovery call, identify the buyer's goals and pain points, present the right coaching offer, and close the sale. You are the last voice before payment goes through.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to warm product buyers on behalf of our brand partners

Follow proven call scripts while adapting naturally to each conversation

Run discovery conversations to identify buyer goals and obstacles

Present coaching offers clearly and confidently

Handle objections with empathy and logic — no pressure tactics

Send SMS checkout links immediately after verbal agreement on the call

Log every call outcome in the CRM accurately and on time

Participate in daily team huddles and weekly performance reviews



What We Are Looking For

1+ year of outbound sales, phone sales, or call center experience

Confident, warm, and natural on the phone — not robotic or scripted

Resilient — you do not take rejection personally

Coachable — you listen to feedback and implement it immediately

Reliable — you log your calls, you show up, you do the work

Experience in health, wellness, or coaching sales is a plus

Fluent English — additional languages (French, Spanish, Italian) are a bonus



What You Get

Base pay + uncapped commission on every close

Full training provided — scripts, objection handling, product knowledge

Clear career path: top setters become closers, top closers become team leads

Remote — work from anywhere

Weekly performance bonuses for top converters



To Apply

Send a 60-second voice memo introducing yourself and explaining why you are the right person for this role. Applications without a voice memo will not be considered.

title: Follow Up Boss Expert — Full CRM Build-Out for a 1,200-Door Property Management Company (Project + Ongoing Retainer)
description:
Follow Up Boss Expert — Full CRM Build-Out for a 1,200-Door Property Management Company (Project + Ongoing Retainer)

Job type: Project-based (6–8 weeks, part-time to full-time hours), then optional ongoing monthly retainer Pay: Above market. I’m looking for the best FUB person on this platform, not the cheapest. Tell me your rate. Fixed-price project bids also welcome. Hours: Flexible, but you must be able to overlap 3–4 hours/day with US Central Time (Dallas–Fort Worth) for screen shares and Q&A. Start: Immediately

________________________________________

About us

McCaw Property Management is a locally owned property management and real estate brokerage in the Dallas–Fort Worth area of Texas. We’ve been in business since 2002 and manage 1,200+ rental homes across 50+ DFW cities. Our leads are landlords and real estate investors, not home buyers. We currently run our lead follow-up in LeadSimple and are moving everything to Follow Up Boss.

We have a full-time sales team (business development managers and licensed agents) who are already busy. What we don’t have is someone who truly knows how to build Follow Up Boss the right way. That’s you.

What you’ll build

This is a build-from-scratch engagement. Our FUB account is open but mostly empty. You will own the entire setup end to end:

1. Lead migration from LeadSimple Export, clean, de-duplicate, and import our existing leads and contacts into FUB with the correct stages, tags, sources, assigned agents, and notes/history preserved wherever possible.

2. Lead source connections Connect every inbound lead source so leads land in FUB automatically and correctly attributed: WordPress website forms (currently
-forwarded and not parsing correctly — this must be fixed properly, e.g., via Zapier/Gravity Forms/webhook), BiggerPockets, Google Business Profile, Zillow/rental listing sites, geo landing pages, and inbound office phone calls. Every source should have a correct Source value in FUB for reporting.

3. Lead routing and speed-to-lead Set up round-robin / first-to-claim routing so new landlord leads are grabbed by whichever agent responds first, with alerts to the team and automatic re-assignment if nobody claims the lead within a set time. Speed to lead is our #1 priority.

4. Phone, text, and
 — fully connected Set up FUB Calling and texting for the team (including A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration so our texts actually deliver), connect every team member’s
 (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365), set up call recording and voi
 drop where available, and make sure every call, text, and
 logs to the right contact.

5. Property-management drip campaigns (Action Plans) Build automated text +
 Action Plans for landlord/owner leads at every stage: new lead, no response, warm but not closed, long-term nurture, and past clients/referral. We will provide the messaging and copy; you build the sequences, timing, triggers, exit conditions, and Smart Lists so no lead ever falls through the cracks.

6. Team structure, pipeline, and reporting Configure users and permissions, stages/pipeline that match a property-management sales process (not a buyer/seller process), ponds, Smart Lists for daily agent workflow, and reporting dashboards so ownership can see lead volume by source, response time, and conversion.

7. Training and documentation Record short Loom-style training videos for our agents, and deliver a written setup document so we know how everything works and can maintain it.

Who we’re looking for

This role is for a FUB expert who has built accounts from zero, not someone who has only worked inside an already-built account. You should be able to say yes to most of the following:

• You’ve personally set up Follow Up Boss from scratch for at least 3 real estate teams or brokerages (not just administered them)

• You know Action Plans, Smart Lists, ponds, lead routing, tags, and custom fields deeply

• You’ve done a CRM-to-FUB migration before (LeadSimple, kvCORE, BoomTown, Lofty/Chime, Sierra, LionDesk, etc.)

• You’ve set up FUB Calling/texting and handled A2P 10DLC registration

• You’re comfortable with Zapier (or Make) and webhooks to connect lead sources FUB doesn’t natively support

• You’ve connected Google Workspace or Microsoft 365
 to FUB

• Bonus: property management experience, or experience with LeadSimple, AppFolio, or landlord-focused lead gen

• Excellent written English and clear communication. You’ll be talking directly with the owner and the sales team.

What happens after the build

If the build goes well, I’d like to keep you on a monthly retainer (roughly 5–10 hours/month) to maintain the system, build new Action Plans as we add campaigns, onboard new agents, and keep integrations healthy. Strong performers will also be first in line for other systems and automation work across my companies.

How to apply

To be considered, please answer these questions in your application. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed.

1. List the FUB accounts you have built from scratch (team name or type, size, and year). Describe one in detail.

2. Walk me through, step by step, how you’d set up first-to-claim lead routing with a fallback if nobody claims the lead in 5 minutes.

3. What is A2P 10DLC, and what do you need from me to get our texting registered?

4. Describe a CRM-to-FUB migration you’ve done. What went wrong and how did you fix it?

5. Attach screenshots (with client info blurred) of an Action Plan and a Smart List you built.

6. Your hourly rate and/or fixed-price bid for the seven items above, and your rough timeline.

7. Type the words “landlord leads” at the top of your reply so I know you read the whole post.

Shortlisted candidates will do a paid 1-hour screen share where you configure a few items live in a test account.

Thank you — I’m looking forward to working with someone who really knows this platform.

title: Senior UI/UX Product Designer (Figma, SaaS + mobile app) — NOT a graphic design role
description:
READ THIS FIRST

This is a PRODUCT DESIGN role: screens, flows, and interfaces for a live software platform and a mobile app, designed in Figma and handed to an engineer to build. It is NOT a graphic design role. If your portfolio is logos, branding boards, social media graphics, flyers, invitations, or Canva work, please do not apply — those applications will not be read, no matter how beautiful the work is.

 

If your portfolio shows real software — dashboards, web apps, mobile apps, booking flows — read on. This role was written for you.

 

SENIOR UI/UX PRODUCT DESIGNER — MAKE A LUXURY FAMILY-CARE PLATFORM THE MOST BEAUTIFUL, EFFORTLESS OF ITS KIND

Project-based full-time (about 6-9 months), then part-time retainer · Work from home · Flexible hours with a few hours' overlap with US Eastern (New York) time

 

ABOUT US

House of Nannies is a boutique, high-end domestic staffing agency in the New York area, founded by a nanny, serving families across Westchester, Manhattan, Greenwich and Fairfield, Bergen County, and the Hamptons. We run two platforms: our placement service (long-term nanny and newborn-care matching) and Little Minders, our membership babysitting service. Behind both sits the Manor — our internal operations platform where our team runs every family's search. We have a strong brand and a defined design language: warm, editorial, premium. We're looking for the product designer who will carry it through every screen.

 

THE ROLE

You'll own the UI/UX of our product experience end to end: our internal platform, our family and candidate portals, and our mobile app. You'll redesign existing screens for calm and simplicity, design complete flows with every state (empty, loading, error, success, popups), and hand clean Figma specs to our lead engineer, working a step ahead of him surface by surface. This is a craft-and-ownership role for someone who sweats interface details.

 

SHAPE OF THE ENGAGEMENT (WE'RE UPFRONT ABOUT THIS)

Full-time for the initial build — roughly 6 to 9 months — then transitioning to an ongoing part-time retainer for polish and new work as we grow. We name this now because we'd rather be honest about the rhythm than surprise you later.

 

IMPORTANT — ELEVATE, DON'T REINVENT

We are not looking for someone to reinvent our brand. We have a brand bible, a design system, and live screens. Your job is to take what exists to its most beautiful, effortless, premium version. If your instinct is to throw it out and start over, we're not the right fit for each other.

 

YOU MUST HAVE

- A portfolio of SHIPPED SOFTWARE: web applications, SaaS platforms, or mobile apps that real people use. Landing pages alone do not qualify; print and social graphics do not qualify at all.

- Strong flow and interaction design — you design journeys and states, not just pretty screens.

- Proven ability to work inside an existing brand system and elevate it respectfully.

- Figma fluency and clean developer handoff: components, specs, tokens.

- Clear communication with a non-technical founder — you explain design decisions simply.

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Marketplaces, booking systems, or membership products.

- A warm, editorial, premium aesthetic sensibility — our brand is soft and human, not techy or cold.

- Motion and micro-interaction sensibility.

 

HOW WE HIRE

A short PAID trial task — redesign one real screen of our platform, working from our brand brief (we pay a flat fee whether or not we continue) — then a portfolio deep-dive and reference check.

 

HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word ELEVATE, then send exactly three things:

1. A direct link to ONE software screen you personally designed — a dashboard, web app, or mobile app screen you're proudest of. This is the first thing we look at.

2. Your full portfolio link.

3. Your expected monthly salary, and one line: your approach when you inherit an existing brand you love.

 

Applications that don't start with ELEVATE, or whose strongest link is a logo or social media graphic, will not be read.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — Training Content (Remote, Philippines, Full-Time)



We're a US-based law enforcement training company producing educational video programs for police officers. We're scaling production hard over the next 90 days and hiring several editors at once.



You do not need to be an advanced editor for this role. If you know the basics, follow instructions precisely, and deliver on time, we will teach you the rest. 



The work



Each training program is made up of 8–14 video segments, each 10–15 minutes when finished. You'll receive raw video with slide visuals and narration, and turn it into a finished segment by following our written process: apply our project template, add the standard intro and outro, place lower thirds and title cards, clean up audio levels, cut dead air and mistakes, and export to spec.



We give you a step-by-step SOP, screen recordings of the entire workflow, a pre-built project template, and reference videos. Nothing is left to guesswork.



This is repeatable, templated work. We are not asking you to be creative. We're asking you to be consistent. Segment 200 needs to look exactly like segment 1.



Most editors get to 35–40 minutes per segment within a couple of weeks, which is 8–10 segments in a workday.



What we need



Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve — cutting, audio levels, titles, exporting. You don't need to be advanced. You must have access to one of these platforms. CapCut users will not be accepted as we need project Adobe compatible file exports when you are done.

The ability to follow a written process exactly, without shortcuts or improvising

Attention to detail. Small mistakes matter here.

Good written English — enough to read a brief and flag a problem clearly

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing without crashing

A few hours of overlap with US Eastern time

Reliability above everything. If you say Thursday, we need Thursday.



We also want people who speak up. If something in the source material looks wrong or doesn't make sense, tell us. Editors who quietly pass problems through cost us more than they save.



Pay



Paid per completed segment, not hourly

$6 per segment

Guaranteed minimum of 150 segments per month once you're hired — most editors will do more than this

Realistic full-time earnings: $1,100–1,300 per month

Paid weekly by Wise for your first month, then biweekly



Growth



This is a long-term position, not a short project. We have hundreds of programs to produce and the work is not going away.



We promote from within. Editors who prove they're fast, accurate, and reliable move up in rate over time. Beyond that, as the team grows we'll need people to review other editors' work, train new hires, and run parts of the production process — and we'd rather fill those roles with people who already know how we work than hire from outside.



We're not making promises up front. But the opportunity is real, and it goes to whoever earns it.



Hiring process



Send your application (details below)

If we like it: a paid test — 4 segments, real source material, with our full SOP and reference videos provided. $25 flat, paid whether or not we move forward. 72 hours to complete.

If you pass: a paid batch of 3 full programs at $6 per segment, so we can see your consistency and turnaround

Then an ongoing full-time position



We pay for every stage. We never ask anyone to work for free.



To apply



Reply with:



What editing software you use and how long you've used it

A sample of anything you've edited — a portfolio, a YouTube link, a school project, anything. It does not need to be professional work.

How many 10–15 minute segments you think you could finish in a day

Your available hours in US Eastern time

Tell us about a time you had to follow a detailed process exactly. Two or three sentences.

Put the word BADGE at the top of your reply so we know you read the whole posting

Proactive Sourcing: Supplement assigned leads by pulling additional prospective deals from the MLS, local wholesalers, and off-market databases during downtime.

Tiered Deal Commissions:

Grade A Deals (BRRRR / Strategic Acquisitions): $600 bonus per closed deal.

Experience or fast adaptability with ClickUp (pipeline workflows) and Privy.Pro (or MLS property valuation tools).

In the title of message add “Let’s Close a Deal”

title: WooCommerce Store Manager & Customer Service
description:
Position: WordPress & WooCommerce Store Manager / Customer Service

Location: Remote

Store: Canadian eCommerce Business

Pay: Starting at 700 CAD/month (~500 USD)

Schedule: Daily availability, with an important morning check at 8–9 AM EST

Payment: Twice per month or another arrangement that works for both sides



Who We Are Looking For



The most important thing to us is reliability.



This is not a difficult job technically. The systems and processes are straightforward.



What makes someone successful in this position is being the person we can trust to:



Check the store → Process orders → Respond to customers → Follow up on unpaid orders → Keep everything organized → Let us know when something needs attention.



We don't want someone who needs to be constantly told what to do.



We want someone experienced who can eventually look at the business and say:



"I see what needs to be done, and I'll take care of it."



If you are organized, experienced with WordPress/WooCommerce, have time during the day, and are looking for a stable long-term position with room to grow, we'd like to hear from you.





About the Position



We are looking for a reliable, experienced, and organized person to help manage the day-to-day operations of our Canadian eCommerce store.



This is a long-term position for someone who has experience with WordPress, WooCommerce, order management, and customer service and who is looking for a stable role where they can grow with a business.



The work itself is straightforward and does not require sitting at a computer for 8 hours straight. The most important thing is being available throughout the day to check the store regularly, process orders on time, and make sure customers are taken care of.



In terms of actual hands-on work, this will generally be around 4–6 hours per day or less, depending on the day. The rest of the time is mainly being available to monitor the store and respond when something comes in.



Main Responsibilities

1. Order Management



This will be one of the most important responsibilities.



Check the store approximately every 30–60 minutes for new orders and payments

Once payment is received, move the order into processing

Make sure orders are processed promptly and do not sit waiting unnecessarily

Generate/print shipping labels when required

Check for any issues with orders or payments

Complete the morning order check and make sure everything is fully up to date



The morning check around 8–9 AM EST is especially important.



2. Customer Service



We receive a relatively small number of customer
s each day, but every message needs to be handled professionally and on time.



Responsibilities include:



Checking the customer service inbox throughout the day

Responding to customer questions and requests

Following up on customer issues

Making sure no customer messages are left unanswered

Providing friendly and professional support



You will be given the information and guidelines needed to handle common customer questions.



3. Unpaid Order Follow-Ups



When a customer places an order but has not completed payment:



Monitor unpaid orders

After approximately one hour, send a friendly reminder

Remind the customer that their order is waiting for payment

Encourage them to complete the purchase and use any applicable discount

Track customers who complete their purchase after being contacted



We also offer performance bonuses based on customers successfully saved from unpaid orders.



4. Store Monitoring & Improvement



We don't just want someone who follows instructions.



We want someone who can think for themselves and take ownership of the store.



Part of the job will be:



Keeping an eye on the website

Looking for things that could be improved

Noticing problems before they become bigger issues

Identifying potential improvements to the customer experience

Checking that WordPress and WooCommerce are functioning properly

Bringing new ideas and suggestions to us



If you notice something that could make the business run better, we want you to tell us.





Compensation



Starting salary:



700 CAD/month (~500 USD/month)



We are willing to pay competitively for the right person because we are looking for someone who will take the position seriously and stay with us long term.



Payment can be made twice per month, or we can discuss another payment schedule that works well for both sides.



Additional Benefits

Guaranteed monthly salary

Performance-based bonuses

Bonuses for successfully recovering unpaid orders

Potential raises as responsibilities increase

Paid time off when proper notice is provided

Opportunity to grow into a larger management role

Long-term position with a growing business

Opportunity to Grow



We operate multiple websites and have plans to continue growing.



The initial role will focus primarily on WooCommerce order management, customer service, and store monitoring, but we are looking for someone who can eventually take on more responsibility.



If you do a great job, learn our systems, and show that you can manage things independently, there will be opportunities to:



Take responsibility for additional websites

Manage more areas of the business

Take on additional WordPress/WooCommerce responsibilities

Receive raises

Become a more senior operations/management team member



We are specifically looking for someone who wants to grow with the business rather than simply work a temporary job.





We are looking for someone with:



Previous experience with WordPress

Strong experience with WooCommerce

Experience managing online stores

Customer service experience

Good written English

Strong attention to detail

Reliable internet connection

Ability to work independently

Ability to follow processes consistently

Good communication

Ability to notice problems and take initiative

Availability to check the store regularly throughout the day

Ability to be available







How to Apply



Please send us:



Your previous experience with WordPress and WooCommerce

Any eCommerce stores you have previously managed

Your customer service experience

Your availability during the day

Your experience with order processing and shipping

How long you have worked in similar positions

Why you believe you would be a good fit for this position



Please be honest about your experience and availability. We are looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship.

title: ECOMMERCE GRAPHICS ASSISTANT
description:
ECOMMERCE GRAPHICS ASSISTANT



About the role

We’re looking for an organised, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to join our team as an E-Commerce Graphics Assistant. In this role, you’ll support our brand portfolio, including Majority and Oakcastle, by adapting, localising and formatting visual content and product documentation across our international e-commerce marketplaces.



A primary focus of the role will be taking existing English graphics, product assets and user guides, running the copy through translation software, and cleanly fitting the translated text into established design templates.



You’ll work mainly with Adobe Illustrator and Microsoft PowerPoint, adapting existing designs, formatting manuals and supporting the wider team with a variety of ad hoc design and graphic tasks.



Main responsibilities

• Translate and localise Amazon listing images and A+ Content for different international marketplaces. 

• Use translation tools to translate product copy and check the output for consistency, formatting and suitability within the asset. 

• Add translated copy into existing graphics while maintaining the original layout, design and branding. 

• Adapt comparison tables, feature graphics, product callouts and other Amazon assets for different languages. 

• Translate and format product manuals, user guides and other product documentation. 

• Use Microsoft PowerPoint and Adobe Illustrator to edit and adapt graphics. 

• Check translated assets for formatting, product information, visual consistency and any obvious errors. 

• Update graphics when product specifications, translations or content change. 

• Keep files and translated assets organised and accessible to the wider team. 

• Manage projects and deadlines across multiple products and markets. 

• Communicate with the team about progress, questions or anything needed to complete a task. 

• Support the Design and Marketing teams with ad hoc graphic design and content tasks, including resizing and adapting existing assets for different uses. 

• Follow existing templates, brand guidelines and processes to keep content consistent. 

What we’re looking for



Software experience:

Experience editing and adapting existing designs using Adobe Illustrator and Microsoft PowerPoint.



Eye for layout and design:

A good visual sense when it comes to typography, spacing, text hierarchy and line wrapping, particularly when working with longer translated text.



Confident using translation tools:

Comfortable using translation software to translate English text and working with the output to make sure it fits naturally within existing designs and layouts.



Strong attention to detail:

High accuracy when handling technical product information, feature callouts and specifications.



Organisation and time management:

Good file management habits and the ability to manage tasks and assets across multiple products and marketplaces.



Independent working:

Able to follow instructions, work efficiently within existing templates and raise questions when something is unclear.



Clear communication:

Good written and verbal English skills, with the ability to keep the team updated on task progress and deadlines.



Desirable experience

• Previous experience with Amazon listings or A+ Content. 

• Experience working with e-commerce or product content. 

• Experience translating or localising marketing content. 

• Experience with consumer electronics or technical products. 

• Experience working with product manuals or user guides. 

• Experience adapting content for different European languages and marketplaces. 



What the role looks like day to day

The role will involve a mix of translation work, Amazon content updates, product manuals and general graphic tasks.

You might spend one day adapting a set of Amazon listing images for several markets, and another updating a product manual, making changes to A+ Content or supporting the team with a smaller design task.



It’s a varied role that would suit someone who enjoys working across different projects and can keep work accurate, organised and on schedule.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
LEAD THE CREATIVE OPERATION. THEN HELP BUILD WHAT COMES NEXT.

Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage the editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and make sure strong creative moves from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail.



This is not a coordinator role. It is not a virtual-assistant role. We need a Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time.



A NOTE FROM OUR CMO

Before applying, watch this short video from our CMO about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like:


/share/9cd974e7c8a848de8b84a4a992df4e45



Once Creative Production is stable and you have demonstrated the judgment, leadership, and capacity required, the role will expand into Social Media Operations. That second phase will include the team, publishing, community, creator, affiliate, and channel systems around the content.



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date. The exact timing will depend on demonstrated readiness and business needs.



ABOUT VERITAS

Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups—mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories—for consumers, work teams, and government fleets.



We are a growing US company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines. Several team members have grown with the company over the long term. We want the same for this role.



THE DETAILS

• Full-time independent contractor role with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and overall fit—not an hourly position

• Approximately 45–50 hours per week, with the regular work schedule fully aligned with Pacific Time

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM–8:00 AM or 12:00 AM–9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time

• Fully remote and long-term

• This must be your only job. No part-time employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage

• Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna required; no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

At full production, the team aims to produce one long-form video and up to 14 supporting creative assets each week. These may include shorts/reels, static graphics, or carousels and are adapted for distribution across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION

• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance.

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS

Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members.

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



HOW THE ROLE FITS

You will report to and work closely with senior marketing leadership. In Phase 1, the video editors report to you. In Phase 2, the Social Media Moderator also reports to you.



You will have authority over routine departmental planning, assignments, quality, coaching, corrections, and process improvements within approved standards. Cross-functional, sensitive, contractual, financial, policy, staffing, reputation, and other material decisions remain with senior leadership.



HOW WE USE AI

Our marketing operation uses AI for context, research, briefs, feedback, quality control, documentation, analysis, automation, and institutional memory.



We want someone who uses AI heavily to improve judgment and execution—not someone who accepts raw output. Sources must be checked. Brand and product accuracy must be protected. What the team learns should improve the next workflow.



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU

• Have at least eight years of professional work experience.

• Have at least three years managing teams and direct reports.

• Have at least two years of experience inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience—not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative-production pipeline and can explain the team size, volume, process, problems, decisions, and results.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can diagnose why an edit is technically correct but still wrong for the overall story.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain a Philippine graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Reside in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna and be willing to attend occasional in-person meetings.

• Have reliable primary internet, a backup connection, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

• Someone who waits for detailed instructions before acting.

• Someone whose experience is limited to task-based VA work, short freelance engagements, or managing multiple clients.

• A strong individual contributor who does not want to manage, coach, and hold people accountable.

• Someone who reviews only technical editing details but cannot evaluate the complete story and business goal.

• Someone who creates more process without improving output, visibility, quality, or results.

• Someone planning to keep another job, freelance clients, or subcontract any part of the work.

• Someone testing a graveyard schedule for the first time without a credible plan to sustain it.



HOW WE WORK

Clear priorities. Direct feedback. Strong ownership. Problems are raised early. Decisions are documented. The goal is not to look busy. The goal is to build work that performs and an operation that improves.



Our brand voice follows the same standard: short words, short sentences, confident but never salesy. Like a friend who knows the gear.



HOW TO APPLY

Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams
