title: Growth Marketing & Social Media Strategist - Meta Ads, Email & Funnels
description:
WE DO NOT NEED ANOTHER SOCIAL-MEDIA POSTER.



We need the person who knows what we should test next.



The $2 Bill Brand helps entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and experts become impossible to compare by becoming the ONLY choice in their space. Our founder, Brad Holcman, brings a Hollywood-trained storytelling and positioning perspective to personal brands and businesses.



We already have a team member who can produce and distribute content, and a GoHighLevel technical specialist who can build pages, funnels, automations, and related assets.



What we need now is a sharp, hands-on marketing strategist who can connect the dots between our offers, content, paid advertising, lead magnets,
 list, funnels, and actual results.



This is a fractional strategy and performance role. At 10 hours per week, your job is to create clarity, prioritize the highest-leverage actions, manage or improve a limited number of important marketing tests, and direct our existing execution support.



THE BASICS

Type of work: Part time, 10 hours per week

Pay: $500 USD per month

Start date: As soon as the right person is found

Location: Philippines

English level: Fluent / Advanced

Experience level: Expert. Four or more years hands-on.

Schedule: 10 hours weekly, including one weekly strategy call and one weekly execution and measurement call during mutually agreed U.S. Eastern-Time hours. Remaining hours are flexible.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. One clear growth plan and scorecard

You will audit our existing channels and customer journey, identify the largest growth constraints, and create a practical 90-day plan.



You will define what we should measure, where the data is unreliable, what needs to be fixed first, and what we should stop wasting time on.



Each week, you will provide a simple scorecard showing the most relevant information available: content performance, paid-media activity and spend, traffic, lead generation, funnel conversion signals,
 and list growth, and the next action we are taking.



You will explain what changed and why in plain English.



2. Paid-media strategy and focused optimization

You have hands-on Meta Ads experience and understand campaign structure, audiences, retargeting, creative testing, landing-page alignment, budget pacing, Meta Pixel and Conversions API concepts, and conversion-event quality.



You will not be expected to run unlimited campaigns or manage large budgets from day one. You will help us d
 what one or two paid-growth efforts are worth testing, set up or review the strategy, identify the right measurement, optimize what is live, and tell the team what should happen next.



3. Organic content and social-media strategy

You will build a strategic view of our founder-led content across YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok,
, and
.



You will recommend content pillars, formats, calls to action, distribution priorities, and posting rhythm based on the goal of each piece of content.



Our content VA handles most publishing and distribution. You will supply the why: whom we are speaking to, what message we need to test, which format and channel makes sense, what call to action belongs with it, and what signal tells us it worked.



4.
 list, lead magnets, and funnel strategy

You will recommend the highest-leverage ways to grow the
 list, improve lead magnets, strengthen welcome and nurture sequences, and move people from content or ads into the right next step.



You will create clear briefs for our GoHighLevel technical specialist. You are not expected to personally build every page or automation at this budget. You are expected to know what should be built, why, and how success should be measured.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 days: A concise audit, a measurement and tracking checklist, a 90-day priority plan, a first scorecard, one lead-magnet or funnel recommendation, and a focused paid and organic test plan.



Days 31-60: Weekly scorecards, clearer content priorities, one or two well-defined paid or funnel tests, and implementation briefs that the team can execute.



Days 61-90: A documented learning system. What is working, what is not, what should be scaled or stopped, and the next most valuable test.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE

You have at least four years of hands-on experience in growth marketing, paid social, performance marketing, funnel strategy,
 marketing, or a closely related role. Four years is the floor, not a suggestion. If you have two, this is not your role yet.



You have personally worked in Meta Ads Manager and can show that you understand more than posting boosts or reporting likes.



You understand how content, ads, lead magnets, landing pages, forms, CRM handoffs,
 sequences, and tracking should work together.



You have used GoHighLevel, 
, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, ClickFunnels, Webflow, or comparable tools. You know how to use Google Analytics and UTM tags, and you recognize when the data is insufficient to make a confident optimization decision.



You write excellent English, are commercially minded, bring recommendations rather than vague opinions, and can coordinate with a small team without turning strategy into a complicated document no one uses.



SKILLS THAT MATTER FOR THIS ROLE

Growth marketing, marketing strategy, Meta Ads,
 Ads, Instagram Ads, paid social, social media strategy, content strategy,
 marketing, lead generation, funnel strategy, GoHighLevel, CRM, landing pages, conversion rate optimization, Google Analytics, UTM tracking, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, retargeting, A/B testing, copywriting.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

Do not apply if your experience is only scheduling social-media posts or designing Canva graphics. We already have publishing support.



Do not apply if you expect to be paid to make a generic strategy deck and then disappear. We need someone who will help turn the strategy into a weekly operating rhythm.



At 10 hours per week, this is also not a request for you to edit every video, create every design, publish daily across every channel, build all technical funnels, write every
, or manage an unlimited number of ad campaigns.



The scope is strategic direction, focused performance work, and excellent coordination with our existing execution team.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with this exact phrase:



ONLY growth is measurable.



Applications without that phrase will not be considered.



Please include ALL of the following:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs profile and a clear statement of your actual role in each campaign or client result.



2. A two-to-three-minute Loom or video introduction explaining one paid campaign, funnel, or
-growth project you personally improved.



3. One short case study that states the starting problem, your actions, the spend range if paid media was involved, the tracking approach, the result, and what you learned. Anonymized screenshots are welcome. Do not disclose confidential client information.



4. Your answer: What is the largest monthly Meta Ads budget you have personally managed, and what conversion event did you optimize for?



5. In 250 words or fewer, visit 
 and share one audience, offer, content, or funnel hypothesis you would test first. This is how we evaluate your thinking.



6. Your hourly rate, confirmation you can work 10 hours weekly with two Eastern-Time calls, the CRM, funnel, and
 tools you have used hands-on, and two references.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid US$30 practical exercise. We will provide a fictional campaign snapshot and a short funnel description. In 45 minutes, you will tell us what data you need, what you would investigate first, what two tests you would prioritize, and how you would measure the outcome.



WHY JOIN US

You will have real influence on the growth of a distinctive founder-led brand, but you will not be expected to do everything alone.



You will work directly with Brad and coordinate with the content and GoHighLevel execution team. If you prove you can create measurable progress, this role can expand over time.

title: Executive Assistant & Founder Support VA - Full-Time
description:
THIS IS NOT A BASIC "DO WHATEVER I SEND YOU" VA JOB.



The $2 Bill Brand helps entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and experts become the recognized authority in their industry. Our founder, Brad Holcman, is building a business around a simple but powerful idea:



Do not be the best. Be the ONLY.



Brad has a lot of ideas, opportunities, commitments, projects, and responsibilities moving at once. He needs someone who is naturally organized and genuinely enjoys turning a messy stream of tasks, voice notes, meetings, and reminders into a calm, visible plan.



You will work directly with Brad as his Executive Assistant and Founder Support VA. Your job is to help make sure important business and personal commitments do not disappear, priorities are clear, follow-ups happen, the calendar supports what matters, and Brad knows what deserves his attention today.



This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who is hungry to learn, takes ownership, communicates clearly, and wants to become an indispensable right hand over time.



THE BASICS

Type of work: Full time, 40 hours per week

Pay: $500 USD per month

Start date: As soon as the right person is found

Location: Philippines

English level: Fluent / Advanced

Experience level: Intermediate to Advanced

Schedule: Full-time remote. Required weekday overlap of 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time. Remaining hours are flexible around agreed deliverables.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Run the founder's daily operating system

You will collect tasks and ideas from messages, meetings, voice notes,
, and conversations. You will put them into one organized task system, clarify deadlines and next actions, and keep a close eye on what is due, stuck, or forgotten.



Each workday, you will prepare a short founder brief with the day's highest priorities, calendar, deadlines, follow-ups, and decisions needed. At the end of the day, you will close loops and prepare the next day so nothing important is lost.



2. Protect the calendar and inbox

You will help organize Brad's Google Calendar, schedule and reschedule meetings, add preparation details, protect focused work time, avoid conflicts, and make sure important meetings have the right information attached.



You will help organize
 and messages under agreed rules. You will flag urgent items, draft simple replies when appropriate, track waiting-on responses, and make sure people are not left without an answer. You will never send sensitive communications or make commitments without clear approval rules.



3. Keep business projects and follow-ups moving

You will track important priorities across our content, marketing, coaching, client, and team work. You will follow up with people, maintain simple status views, convert meeting notes into next actions, and alert Brad early when something needs a decision or is at risk of slipping.



You are not expected to do every specialized job in the company. Your responsibility is to make sure requests, deadlines, and decisions do not get lost.



4. Support approved personal logistics

With clear privacy boundaries, you may help research and coordinate personal appointments, travel options, family-calendar reminders, gifting, reservations, orders and returns, and other practical logistics that protect Brad's time. You will always ask before making purchases, sharing sensitive information, or doing anything outside pre-approved rules.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 days: You create one clean task/follow-up system, learn Brad's preferences, establish the daily brief, improve calendar habits, and begin reliably capturing actions from meetings and messages.



Days 31-60: You run a consistent weekly priority review, keep a forward-looking calendar view, track key projects, and proactively close routine communication loops.



Days 61-90: Brad trusts the system. He knows his priorities, important commitments are anticipated, and business and personal logistics are more organized with fewer reminders coming from him.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE

You have at least one year of meaningful administrative, executive-support, operations-support, or project-coordination experience. You may have supported a founder, manager, small business owner, agency owner, or executive.



You do not need to have been a Chief of Staff. But you must be able to explain the system you personally used to stay organized.



You have excellent written and spoken English. You are highly reliable, calm under pressure, discreet, detail-oriented, comfortable using Google Workspace, and not afraid to ask a clear question when the next step is ambiguous.



Experience with Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Trello, Slack, WhatsApp, Zoom, travel research, and AI productivity tools is helpful. Strong judgment, follow-through, and communication matter more than knowing every tool.



SKILLS THAT MATTER FOR THIS ROLE

Executive assistance, administrative support, calendar management,
 management, task management, project coordination, personal assistance, Google Workspace, Google Calendar, Gmail, meeting management, online research, documentation, written English, problem solving, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, travel planning, AI productivity tools.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

Do not apply if you want a passive role where you simply wait for a written list of tasks. Do not apply if you cannot reliably work the required Eastern-Time overlap, have unstable internet without a backup plan, or are uncomfortable handling confidential business and personal information with maturity.



We are not looking for someone to be on call 24/7, perform every specialized function in the company, or make financial or personal decisions without approval. We are looking for a proactive, reliable assistant who wants to grow into a true right-hand support role.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with this exact phrase:



I am the Operating System.



Applications without that phrase will not be considered.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Django + React + Laravel)
description:
We're a small US software company building real products in health tech and telehealth, web apps, and video-visit infrastructure used by actual patients and clinics.  Real products with users, and a team that ships fast.



 We're hiring a senior full-stack developer, full-time, to own features end to end, from ticket to production.

 

The setup



 - You work as part of our team, under our name. This is a white-label subcontractor role: your

 tickets, commits, and communications are under our company identity. You'll have direct access to me

 (the founder/engineer) daily, clients and end users only ever see our brand, never a third party.

 - Full-time (40 hrs/week), weekly pay, on time, every time.

 - Long-term: we're building a team, not filling a gap.



 Why you'll like this job



 - You get AI leverage. Using AI agents and coding assistants to do your work isn't frowned upon here,

 it's the workflow. You'll be expected to use them well, and you'll look good because of it.

 - You work directly with the founder/engineer, not through layers of PMs and account managers. Short

 feedback loops, clear tickets, honest conversations.

 - Modern, serious stack: Django/DRF, PostgreSQL, React + TypeScript, React Native, AWS, Terraform,

 WebRTC telehealth.

 - Stability. This is a full-time, long-term contract position, we're building a team, not filling a

 gap. We pay on time, every time, in USD.

 - Room to grow. You'll do code review with an experienced senior engineer and can grow into leading

 the engineering team.



 What you'll do



 - Take detailed Jira/notion tickets and finish them completely: code, tests, review, and deploy-ready work.

 "Done" means shipped, not "done on paper."

 - Build and maintain backend features in Django/DRF + PostgreSQL (APIs, auth, integrations).

 - Build and maintain frontends.

 - Debug messy real-world problems, third-party data mismatches, weird edge cases, things nobody else

 caught.

 - Join a daily stand-up and stay responsive in Slack. clear written English

 matters.

 - Use AI agents/LLM tooling aggressively to multiply your output.



 What we're looking for



 - 4+ years of professional experience with at least one serious production codebase you can walk me

 through.

 - Strong backend skills: Django or similar, PostgreSQL, REST APIs.

 - Strong Product understanding and businsiness understanding when it comes to product work

 - Strong frontend skills: React + TypeScript, real state management, real testing.

 - Bonus (big pluses): Laravel, AWS (Lambda, Amplify, Terraform), WebRTC/video, healthcare

 experience.

 - You verify before you trust, your own work included. Tests, evidence, screenshots.

 - Full-time availability (40 hrs/week), stable internet, and 4+ hours overlap with US business hours in Eastern Time.





 How to apply



 Don't send me a generic cover letter. Do this instead:



 1. Tell me about the hardest bug you've ever found, the one everyone else missed. What was it, and

 how did you find it?

 2. Link me to the production app or code you're proudest of.

 3. Start your application with the word "verified."

 4. Have you had US healthcare experience 



 Applications that skip these get skipped.

title: Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator
description:
Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time

**Location:** Remote



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, responsive **Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator** to support our Parts and Supply Chain operations. This role serves as a key point of contact for parts customers while helping keep estimates, payments, Parts Research requests, purchase orders, and order updates moving forward.



You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day follow-through that creates a great customer experience and gives our internal Supply Chain team more time to focus on purchasing, sourcing, technical research, inventory, and complex procurement needs.



## What You’ll Do



* Answer inbound parts calls,
s, and assigned leads.

* Gather customer and equipment information, including make/model, serial numbers, data tags, photos, quantities, and requested parts.

* Create and maintain accurate customer and lead records.

* Coordinate requests requiring technical identification with our internal Parts Research team.

* Create and send parts estimates using approved information.

* Follow up consistently on open estimates through sale or closure.

* Communicate pricing, availability, and lead times to customers.

* Send payment links or instructions and follow up on routine outstanding payments.

* Create clear handoffs to Supply Chain when parts are ready to be ordered or shipped.

* Follow up on open purchase orders and vendor acknowledgments.

* Maintain accurate expected ship dates, lead times, backorder/delay information, and tracking details.

* Keep customers and internal teams informed throughout the process.

* Proactively flag delays, exceptions, or issues requiring additional support.



## What Success Looks Like



You are responsive, organized, and consistent. Customers receive timely communication, estimates don’t fall through the cracks, open orders have clear status updates, and internal teams can quickly determine where an order stands.



Key performance expectations include:



* **95%+** compliance with inbound customer response standards

* **98%+** compliance with required parts estimate follow-up

* **95%+** compliance with open purchase order visibility requirements



## What This Role Does Not Own

This role supports procurement and order coordination but does **not** independently make purchasing, sourcing, pricing, or technical parts-identification decisions. Complex vendor issues, inventory management, physical receiving/shipping, and other procurement exceptions remain with the internal Supply Chain team.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone and

* Consistent with follow-up and task management

* Able to manage multiple open requests without losing track of details

* Proactive about communicating delays and next steps

* Comfortable working across multiple systems and maintaining accurate records

* Team-oriented and able to coordinate effectively with Sales, Service, and Supply Chain

* Able to work consistently during **7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time**



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys customer service, coordination, organization, and keeping processes moving from initial request through completion.

title: Experienced Dispute & Chargeback Manager for Fast Growing Health & Beauty Ecommerce Stores
description:
We operate international health and beauty dropshipping stores and are looking for an exceptionally intelligent and experienced Dispute, Chargeback Manager & Revenue Recovery Specialist.



This is not a beginner position, a general customer support position, or a role for someone who has only occasionally responded to disputes.



Your main responsibility will be to protect company revenue by managing active disputes from beginning to end. You will communicate with customers, negotiate dispute closures, assess financial risk, collect evidence, prepare processor submissions, meet deadlines and d
 which strategy creates the lowest possible loss for the company.



We are looking for someone who already knows how to do this at a high level.



There will be no basic dispute-management training and no step-by-step hand-holding. We will explain our internal systems, stores and policies, but you must already understand how disputes work in the health and beauty dropshipping industry.



If you do not have a strong and verifiable track record managing Klarna, PayPal and credit card disputes, do not apply.



Your main objective:



Your performance will be judged by:



* Disputes closed directly with customers.

* Chargebacks prevented.

* Revenue recovered.

* Disputes won through strong evidence.

* Refunds avoided where possible.

* Losses minimized in weak cases.

* Evidence submitted correctly and before deadlines.

* Follow-ups completed without reminders.

* Cases documented and organized properly.

* Your ability to work independently.



Customer satisfaction is not the primary KPI.



Communication must remain professional, but the purpose of the communication is to resolve the dispute, protect revenue and reduce financial damage.



What you will do:



Manage active disputes



You will take ownership of disputes opened through:



-Shopify Payments:

* Klarna.

* Credit Card



-PayPal.







You will be responsible for:



* Investigating each case.

* Reviewing the order timeline.

* Understanding what the customer is claiming.

* Identifying contradictions or weaknesses in the claim.

* Determining what evidence is available.

* Determining what evidence is still missing.

* Contacting suppliers, carriers, warehouses or pickup points when needed.

* Communicating directly with the customer.

* Persuading customers to close unnecessary disputes.

* Negotiating resolutions that minimize losses.

* Following up persistently until a final outcome is reached.

* Preparing evidence if the customer refuses to cooperate.

* Submitting evidence before every deadline.

* Recording the result of each case.



You must understand that every case requires a different strategy.



A copied template, generic apology or automatic refund offer is not dispute management.



Negotiate with customers:



A major part of this role is getting customers to close disputes voluntarily before they escalate.



You must know how to:



* Read the customer’s real motivation.

* Identify what outcome they actually want.

* Challenge inaccurate claims without losing control of the conversation.

* Explain policies, delivery information and refund processes clearly.

* Use logic, urgency, firmness and reassurance strategically.

* Avoid unnecessary admissions that weaken the company’s position.

* Avoid offering refunds as much as possible.

* Offer calculated alternatives where appropriate.

* Keep the customer focused on the resolution you are proposing.

* Know when further communication is unlikely to improve the outcome.



We use a commercially aggressive approach to dispute recovery.



You should be comfortable using persistent follow-up, strong negotiation, precise wording and every procedural advantage available.



We need someone aggressive enough to recover revenue, but intelligent enough not to damage the business while doing it.



Handle Klarna, PayPal and credit card disputes:



You must have direct, hands-on experience managing disputes from beginning to end across Klarna, PayPal and credit card payment processors.



This includes investigating the order, communicating with the customer, determining the correct strategy, collecting evidence, submitting the response, meeting every deadline and following the case until a final outcome is reached.



You must have experience handling cases involving:



* Product not received.

* Delivered but not received.

* Packages delivered to pickup points.

* Uncollected packages.

* Returned shipments.

* Refund not received.

* Incorrect products.

* Product-quality complaints.

* Cancellation requests.

* Opened or used health and beauty products.

* Customers refusing to follow return instructions.

* Customers keeping disputes open after a solution was offered.

* Unauthorized-transaction claims.

* Customers claiming the product was significantly different from what was advertised.



Across all payment methods, you should understand:



* How disputes escalate.

* How and when customers can close a dispute.

* Evidence and response deadlines.

* Tracking and proof-of-delivery requirements.

* Order and fulfilment timelines.

* Proof of authorization.

* Refund and cancellation records.

* Customer communication evidence.

* Policy acceptance.

* When additional evidence should be requested from suppliers, warehouses, carriers or pickup points.

* How to identify weaknesses in both the customer’s claim and the company’s position.

* When to defend, negotiate, partially refund, fully refund, reship, settle or accept the loss.

* The difference between relevant evidence and irrelevant document dumping.

* How to organize evidence so the reviewer can understand the case quickly.

* How to turn a complicated order history into a clear, convincing and easy-to-review evidence submission.



You must know what strengthens a case, what weakens it and when a dispute is commercially worth defending.



Klarna disputes



You must understand the Klarna dispute process, including:



* The different escalation stages.

* How customers pause invoices or payments.

* How customers can close or update a dispute.

* What happens when a dispute is escalated for formal review.

* Which evidence Klarna expects for different dispute types.

* How to communicate with customers while a Klarna dispute is active.

* How to handle customers who refuse to close a dispute after receiving a reasonable solution.

* When continued negotiation is more effective than immediately submitting evidence.



PayPal disputes and claims



You must understand:



* PayPal disputes.

* PayPal claims.

* PayPal chargebacks.

* Card-funded PayPal transactions.

* Item-not-received claims.

* Significantly-not-as-described claims.

* Unauthorized-transaction claims.

* Appeals and escalations.

* PayPal tracking and delivery requirements.

* The difference between resolving a case directly with the buyer and defending it through PayPal.

* When a PayPal dispute may also become an external credit card chargeback.



Credit card chargebacks



You must have experience responding to credit card disputes through payment processors, payment gateways, acquiring banks or chargeback-management platforms.



You should understand:



* Chargeback reason categories and reason codes.

* Processor-specific evidence requirements.

* Proof of authorization.

* Representment.

* Pre-arbitration or second-stage disputes where applicable.

* How card issuer disputes differ from Klarna and PayPal cases.

* How to respond when the payment processor only allows limited evidence or text.

* How to select the strongest evidence instead of submitting every available document.

* How to prepare a concise case summary that directly addresses the dispute reason.



You must be able to turn a complicated case into a clear, convincing and easy-to-review evidence submission.



Prepare strong evidence packages:



You will collect, organize and submit evidence such as:



* Shopify order confirmations.

* Order and fulfilment timelines.

* Tracking information.

* Proof of delivery.

* Last-mile carrier tracking.

* Pickup-point confirmations.

* Customer
s.

* Return instructions.

* Refund records.

* Previous resolution offers.

* Store policies.

* Screenshots.

* Internal notes.

* Chronological evidence summaries.

*...



Every submission must be accurate, relevant, organized and easy for the reviewer to understand.



You must know what strengthens a case, what weakens a case and what should not be included.



Minimize losses in weak cases:



Not every dispute can be won.



You must be intelligent enough to recognize when defending a case is no longer the most profitable option.



When a case is weak, you should assess:



* Order value.

* Product cost.

* Shipping cost.

* Chargeback fees.

* Payment processor fees.

* Probability of winning.

* Probability of escalation.

* Whether the product can be recovered.

* Whether a partial refund may close the case.

* Whether a replacement is cheaper than a refund.

* Whether the customer is likely to cooperate.

* Whether continuing creates unnecessary processor risk.



You must be able to recommend the lowest-cost resolution and explain your reasoning clearly.



Intelligence and judgment:



This is a mentally demanding role.



We need someone who can process incomplete information, recognize patterns, identify contradictions, predict customer behavior and make good decisions without being told exactly what to do.



For every case, you should naturally ask:



* What is the customer claiming?

* What probably happened?

* What can we prove?

* What can we not prove?

* Which parts of the customer’s story are inconsistent?

* What evidence is missing?

* What will the payment processor care about?

* What should be communicated to the customer?

* What should be included in the evidence?

* What should be excluded?

* What is the probability of winning?

* What is the cheapest acceptable outcome?

* What is the next action?

* What deadline cannot be missed?



We are specifically looking for someone who is:



* Exceptionally intelligent.

* Strategically minded.

* Commercially focused.

* Highly persuasive.

* Psychologically perceptive.

* Extremely organized.

* Creative.

* Resourceful.

* Calm under pressure.

* Detail-oriented.

* Punctual.

* Proactive.

* Reliable.

* Comfortable making decisions.

* Able to explain and defend their reasoning.

* Able to receive feedback without ego.

* Capable of working without constant supervision.



You must know when to be firm, when to negotiate, when to request more evidence, when to challenge the customer and when to accept a controlled loss.



Organization and punctuality:



Dispute management is deadline-driven.



A strong case submitted after the deadline is worthless.



You must maintain a reliable system for:



* Active disputes.

* Platform deadlines.

* Customer follow-ups.

* Missing evidence.

* Supplier requests.

* Carrier investigations.

* Return status.

* Refund decisions.

* Escalation stages.

* Final outcomes.

* Recovered revenue.

* Total losses.



You must never rely on memory alone.



Every active case must have:



* Clear notes.

* A current status.

* A next action.

* A follow-up date.

* A final deadline.



Being disorganized, late, forgetful, passive or dependent on repeated reminders will result in failure in this role.



Required experience:



You must have a strong and verifiable track record in:



* Klarna dispute management.

* PayPal disputes and claims.

* Credit card chargebacks.

* Shopify order investigations.

* Chargeback evidence preparation.

* Health and beauty e-commerce.

* Dropshipping fulfilment.

* International shipping disputes.

* Product-not-received claims.

* Delivered-but-not-received claims.

* Return and refund disputes.

* Product complaints.

* Opened-product and hygiene-related complaints.

* Negotiating dispute closures directly with customers.

* Reducing refund and chargeback losses.



General customer support experience is not enough.



Fashion customer service experience is not enough.



Occasionally responding to disputes as part of a support role is not enough.



Using a white-label chargeback service without personally choosing the strategy, investigating the case and building the evidence is not enough.



We want someone who has personally:



* Investigated disputes.

* Contacted customers.

* Negotiated closures.

* Chosen refund and settlement strategies.

* Collected missing evidence.

* Written evidence summaries.

* Submitted processor responses.

* Tracked deadlines.

* Taken responsibility for the result.



Health and beauty dropshipping experience is mandatory



You must understand the specific risks connected to health and beauty dropshipping, including:



* Customers expecting guaranteed or immediate results.

* Product-did-not-work complaints.

* Complaints about packaging or product appearance.

* Ingredient and instruction questions.

* Opened or used products.

* Hygiene-related return restrictions.

* Product expectation mismatches.

* Longer shipping times.

* Supplier-side delays.

* Overseas fulfilment.

* Tracking gaps.

* Last-mile carrier handovers.

* Returned or uncollected parcels.

* Customers opening disputes before contacting support.

* Increased payment-processor scrutiny around health-related products and claims.



You must understand how these disputes differ from ordinary fashion-store complaints.



Independence and working style:



We are looking for an expert who can take ownership of daily dispute management.



There will be no basic training.



At the beginning, we will review your work closely to determine whether your claimed experience is genuine. You will be evaluated through your decisions, organization, communication, evidence quality and results.



We expect you to understand the work from day one.



If you want you may fill in additional hours by handling daily customer support tasks when dispute volume is lower. However, this is not the main role we are hiring you for.



We are hiring a dispute expert first.



Customer support experience will never compensate for weak dispute-management ability.



AI and templates:



You may use AI tools for:



* Improving wording.

* Translation.

* Grammar checks.

* Organizing information.

* Summarizing timelines.



You may not use AI as a replacement for judgment.



You must personally understand every case, verify every fact, adapt every message and choose every strategy.



If you copy generic responses, upload the same evidence for every case or cannot explain your decisions, you will not succeed in this role.



Compensation:



Starting with $5 USD per hour.



Performance bonuses may be offered based on:



* Disputes closed.

* Chargebacks prevented.

* Cases won.

* Revenue recovered.

* Refund losses reduced.

* Deadline accuracy.

* Evidence quality.

* Independence and reliability.



Exceptional performers may receive higher compensation over time and eventually take full ownership of the dispute-management department.



Do not apply unless you are genuinely experienced:



No strong dispute-management track record means no interview.



No direct experience with Shopify and Shopify Payments (klarna, cc), Paypal and health and beauty dropshipping means no hire.



We will not hire based on confidence, impressive language or generic customer support experience.



We will test whether you can actually perform the work.



Candidates who exaggerate their experience will be identified quickly.



How to apply:



Provide three real dispute examples that you personally managed.



At least one example must involve PayPal.



At least one example must involve a Klarna Dispute/Chargeback.



At least one example must involve a health, beauty, wellness, cosmetics or personal-care product.



For each example, explain:



1. What the customer claimed.

2. Which payment platform was involved.

3. The order value.

4. What evidence was initially available.

5. What evidence was missing.

6. How you obtained the missing evidence.

7. What weaknesses existed in the case.

8. How you communicated with the customer.

9. How you attempted to get the dispute closed.

10. What evidence you submitted.

11. Whether you defended, negotiated, partially refunded, fully refunded, reshipped or accepted the loss.

12. The final outcome.

13. How much revenue was recovered or lost.

14. What you learned from the case.



Also answer the following questions:



* How many disputes or chargebacks did you manage per month?

* Which dispute platforms have you personally used?

* What was your approximate dispute win or closure rate?

* How much experience do you have in health and beauty dropshipping?

* Which credit card dispute categories or reason codes have you handled?

* How do you track deadlines and follow-ups?

* How do you d
 whether to defend or settle a case?

* What would you do if tracking shows delivery but the customer denies receiving the parcel?

* What would you do if a customer refuses to close a dispute after receiving a reasonable solution?

* What is your current availability?





Hiring process:



Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical dispute-management assessment.



You may be asked to:



* Review a Shopify order timeline.

* Identify weaknesses in the case.

* Determine what evidence is missing.

* Write a message intended to get the customer to close the dispute.

* Prepare an evidence summary.

* Select which documents should be submitted.

* Identify which documents should not be submitted.

* Recommend whether to defend, negotiate, partially refund, fully refund, reship or accept the loss.

* Explain your reasoning.

* Create a deadline and follow-up plan.



We are not interested in theory.



We are looking for someone who can think, investigate, negotiate, organize and recover revenue in real situations.

title: Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology Specialist
description:
Position Overview

ATTN: introductory video, your résumé, and your portfolio is required to apply for this position.



Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology 

Specialist



Position Summary



Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is seeking a highly organized, innovative, technology-driven Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology Specialist to support the development, implementation, management, and growth of our online and hybrid educational programs.



This position will be responsible for building and maintaining high-quality courses within Kajabi, supporting Google Classroom, assisting students with technology needs, developing interactive learning experiences, supporting landing pages and enrollment funnels, organizing prospective student leads, and working closely with our team to improve enrollment conversions.



The ideal candidate is not simply someone who can upload course content. We are seeking someone who can think strategically about the entire student journey—from initial interest and landing page engagement through enrollment, onboarding, course participation, and completion.



The individual must be comfortable learning new technologies, utilizing artificial intelligence, solving technical problems, managing multiple projects, meeting strict deadlines, and proactively bringing ideas to leadership that improve our programs and the student experience.



Primary Responsibilities



Kajabi Course Development & Management



* Build, organize, launch, and maintain online courses within the Kajabi platform.

* Create course modules, lessons, categories, learning pathways, assessments, downloads, resources, videos, and other educational materials.

* Upload and properly organize videos, presentations, PDFs, worksheets, assignments, links, and supporting course materials.

* Structure courses so students can easily understand where to begin, what to complete next, and how to progress through the program.

* Create professional and visually appealing course layouts consistent with the Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute brand.

* Set up course access, student enrollment, automated communications, notifications, certificates, completion requirements, and other Kajabi features when applicable.

* Regularly review existing courses and recommend improvements.

* Test courses before launch to ensure links, videos, lessons, downloads, automations, and student access are functioning properly.

* Maintain accurate course information and make updates when curriculum or program requirements change.



Student Engagement & Interactive Learning



The Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology Specialist will be expected to continuously identify ways to make our online programs feel engaging, supportive, and interactive rather than simply providing students with videos to watch.



Responsibilities include:



* Develop creative methods for increasing student participation and course completion.

* Recommend quizzes, assessments, assignments, discussion activities, challenges, progress checkpoints, and interactive exercises.

* Develop opportunities for students to apply what they are learning.

* Assist with incorporating live sessions, recorded demonstrations, student discussions, projects, milestone celebrations, certificates, and other engagement strategies.

* Identify students who may be experiencing difficulty navigating the learning platform and assist with resolving those barriers.

* Research new educational technology and recommend tools that can improve the online learning experience.

* Help create systems that encourage students to continue progressing through their programs.

* Review student engagement patterns and recommend improvements when participation begins to decline.



Google Classroom



The candidate must have working knowledge of Google Classroom and be comfortable assisting instructors and students with the platform.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating and organizing Google Classroom courses.

* Adding and managing students.

* Posting assignments, announcements, resources, and instructional materials.

* Organizing classwork by topics or modules.

* Assisting instructors with classroom organization.

* Helping students locate assignments and course materials.

* Troubleshooting common Google Classroom issues.

* Helping maintain consistency between Kajabi, Google Classroom, and other systems used by the school.



Student Technology Support



This position will serve as an important technology resource for students after they enroll.



The specialist must be comfortable providing patient, professional technical support to students who may have limited technology experience.



Responsibilities include:



* Assist students with accessing Kajabi, Google Classroom, online courses, and other required platforms.

* Help students understand how to log in and navigate their programs.

* Troubleshoot password, login, access, video, assignment, browser, and basic platform issues.

* Assist students with locating lessons, assignments, resources, and course requirements.

* Develop easy-to-understand technology instructions, tutorials, FAQs, and student onboarding resources.

* Help ensure newly enrolled students receive appropriate access to their programs.

* Escalate complex technical problems when necessary and follow through until an appropriate resolution is reached.

* Maintain professional and supportive communication when assisting students.



Artificial Intelligence & Technology



The candidate must have a strong working background in artificial intelligence and modern digital productivity tools.



Responsibilities include:



* Utilize AI to improve productivity, course development, student engagement, marketing, lead management, and internal processes.

* Assist with creating course outlines, educational resources, quizzes, assignments, communications, marketing materials, and other content using AI responsibly.

* Identify AI tools that may improve the school’s operations or educational delivery.

* Develop repeatable AI-assisted workflows that save the organization time.

* Remain current on emerging AI and educational technology.

* Bring new technology recommendations to leadership rather than waiting to be instructed on every improvement.

* Help the organization determine where automation can replace repetitive manual processes.



Landing Pages, Funnels & Enrollment Technology



The candidate must have experience with or strong knowledge of landing page and funnel-building platforms such as GoHighLevel, Leadpages, Kajabi, or similar systems.



Responsibilities include:



* Build and update landing pages for programs, events, courses, and enrollment campaigns.

* Assist with creating high-converting enrollment funnels.

* Ensure landing pages clearly communicate program benefits, calls to action, and next steps.

* Connect forms, landing pages, lead databases,
/SMS communications, and enrollment processes when required.

* Test funnels regularly to ensure leads are being properly captured.

* Identify broken links, missing automations, incorrect forms, or other problems that could cause the school to lose prospective students.

* Recommend improvements to landing pages and enrollment processes based on performance and student behavior.

* Work with admissions and marketing staff to continually improve the prospective student’s journey from inquiry to enrollment.



Lead Organization & Enrollment Conversion



This position will also support the organization and management of prospective student leads.



Responsibilities include:



* Organize incoming leads from landing pages, advertising campaigns, websites, forms, and other sources.

* Ensure leads are accurately entered into the appropriate lead-management system.

* Maintain accurate lead statuses and follow-up information.

* Help prevent prospective students from being lost due to poor organization or lack of follow-up.

* Assist with creating automated
 and SMS follow-up sequences.

* Work with admissions personnel to identify high-interest prospective students.

* Help track leads through the enrollment process.

* Assist with re-engagement strategies for prospective students who previously expressed interest but did not enroll.

* Help analyze where prospective students are dropping out of the enrollment process.

* Recommend improvements designed to increase the percentage of inquiries that become enrolled students.



The goal is not simply to collect leads—it is to help create an organized system that moves qualified prospective students toward enrollment.



Marketing & Program Promotion



The specialist will work collaboratively with leadership, admissions, instructors, and marketing personnel to properly promote school programs.



Responsibilities include:



* Understand the primary benefits and selling points of each assigned program.

* Assist with developing digital assets needed to promote programs.

* Ensure marketing campaigns connect to the correct landing pages and enrollment funnels.

* Coordinate course launches with the appropriate team members.

* Assist with promotional campaigns for new programs.

* Help ensure that prospective students receive consistent messaging from advertisement through enrollment.

* Provide technology and implementation support for special enrollment campaigns, webinars, virtual information sessions, open houses, and program launches.



Innovation & Continuous Improvement



We expect the person in this position to bring ideas—not simply wait for assignments.



The specialist should regularly evaluate our technology, courses, student experience, and enrollment processes and ask:



* How can we make this easier for the student?

* How can we make this more interactive?

* How can we automate this process?

* How can we improve student engagement?

* How can we improve course completion?

* How can we capture more leads?

* How can we follow up with leads more effectively?

* How can we increase enrollment conversions?

* How can AI help us accomplish this more efficiently?

* What technology should we be using that we are not currently using?



Recommendations should be practical and include a proposed method for implementation whenever possible.



Project & Time Management



Strong time-management skills are an essential requirement of this position.



The employee must:



* Manage multiple projects simultaneously.

* Maintain an organized project schedule.

* Understand project priorities and deadlines.

* Complete assignments by the assigned due date and assigned due time.

* Communicate immediately when a legitimate issue may affect a deadline.

* Avoid waiting until a deadline has passed to communicate problems.

* Provide appropriate progress updates on larger projects.

* Follow through on assignments from beginning to completion.

* Test completed projects before reporting that they are finished.

* Maintain organized digital files, folders, course assets, passwords/access information, and project documentation according to company procedures.

* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and accuracy.



Teamwork & Communication



The Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology Specialist must work effectively with leadership and other team members.



The employee will be expected to:



* Communicate professionally with students, instructors, staff, and leadership.

* Participate in planning and project meetings when requested.

* Accept constructive feedback and make requested revisions promptly.

* Collaborate with admissions and marketing teams to support enrollment goals.

* Work with instructors to transform educational materials into organized online learning experiences.

* Clearly explain technology to team members who may not have a technical background.

* Maintain confidentiality regarding student, employee, business, and proprietary information.

* Maintain a positive, solution-oriented approach when challenges occur.



Required Skills & Qualifications



Candidates should demonstrate strong knowledge or experience in several of the following areas:



* Kajabi

* Google Classroom

* Artificial intelligence and AI productivity tools

* GoHighLevel

* Leadpages

* Landing page development

* Sales and enrollment funnels

* CRM and lead-management systems

*
 and SMS automation

* Online course development

* Learning management systems

* Basic technology troubleshooting

* Student technology support

* Digital marketing

* Lead nurturing and conversion

* Google Workspace

* Online forms and digital workflows

* Project management

* Content organization

* Strong written communication

* Strong verbal communication

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong problem-solving abilities



Preferred Experience



Preference may be given to candidates with experience working within:



* Online education

* Career schools

* Google Ads, Meta Ads

* Membership-based education

* Digital course companies

* Admissions or enrollment departments

* Digital marketing agencies

* CRM/funnel management

* Education technology



Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be evaluated based on measurable results, including:



* Courses completed accurately and on schedule.

* Projects completed by assigned deadlines.

* Quality and organization of Kajabi courses.

* Student ease of access to online programs.

* Speed and professionalism of student technology support.

* Student engagement within online programs.

* Accuracy of lead organization and management.

* Functionality of landing pages and enrollment funnels.

* Improvement of automated processes.

* Contribution to lead-to-enrollment conversion.

* Quality of new ideas presented and successfully implemented.

* Communication and collaboration with the team.

* Ability to independently identify and solve problems.



Our Expectation



Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is continuing to expand its educational reach through online, hybrid, and technology-supported programs. This position will play an important role in helping us build the infrastructure necessary for that growth.



We are looking for someone who sees technology as more than software. Technology should make education easier to access, make students more engaged, make our team more efficient, and help more prospective students successfully move from interest to enrollment.



The right individual will be organized, creative, dependable, technology-driven, solutions-focused, and excited about helping us build educational programs that can grow and serve students at a high level.

title: Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
ATTN: introductory video, your résumé, and your portfolio is required to apply for this position.



About Us:

CURE Advanced Aesthetics Institute is a premier aesthetics and beauty school dedicated to preparing students for successful careers through advanced training, hands-on experience, and industry-recognized certifications. 



Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist



Position Summary



Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is seeking a motivated, organized, results-driven Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist to help grow enrollment, strengthen prospective student relationships, manage incoming leads, and provide an exceptional customer experience.



This is a sales and conversion-focused position. The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure that prospective students who express interest in our programs receive timely, professional, consistent, and persuasive follow-up designed to move qualified prospects from inquiry to conversation, conversation to application, and application to enrollment.



The ideal candidate must be comfortable with sales, follow-up, telephone conversations, text messaging,
 communication, CRM systems, lead organization, customer service, marketing, and working toward measurable enrollment goals.



We are looking for someone who understands that every inquiry represents a potential student whose life and career may be positively impacted by the right educational opportunity. This individual must be able to build relationships, communicate value, overcome reasonable objections, follow up consistently, and help prospective students confidently determine whether our programs are the right fit for their goals.



?



Primary Responsibilities



Lead Management & Organization



The specialist will be responsible for maintaining an organized and effective lead-management system.



Responsibilities include:



* Receive and manage leads generated through websites, landing pages, Google Ads, social media, events, referrals, telephone calls,
, and other marketing sources.

* Ensure new leads are entered into the appropriate CRM or lead-management system.

* Respond to new inquiries promptly.

* Maintain accurate lead statuses and contact information.

* Categorize leads according to their stage within the enrollment process.

* Maintain detailed notes regarding conversations, interests, concerns, objections, follow-up dates, and next steps.

* Schedule appropriate follow-up activities.

* Prevent qualified leads from becoming lost due to inconsistent communication.

* Maintain an organized daily pipeline of prospects requiring attention.

* Identify older leads that should be re-engaged.

* Keep lead databases accurate, current, and organized.

* Identify high-intent prospects who may be ready to enroll.

* Track prospects from initial inquiry through enrollment.



Every qualified lead should have a clear status, a documented next step, and an appropriate follow-up date.



Sales & Enrollment Conversion



This individual must be comfortable selling educational programs and communicating the value of making an investment in professional education.

title: QA & Release Engineering Manager
description:
We are seeking a hands-on QA & Release Engineering Manager to raise the quality bar across our software delivery process and help build a disciplined, scalable QA function. This person will actively test software, lead QA practices and standards, expand test automation, and ensure releases are validated and deployed safely and predictably.



This is not a coordination-only management role. The ideal candidate is an experienced QA or quality engineer who can set expectations for the QA team while remaining technically hands-on with testing, automation, CI/CD, deployments, and release troubleshooting. The role combines QA leadership, quality engineering, release management, and practical DevOps responsibility.



Core Responsibilities

QA Leadership, Standards & Discipline

• Own and continuously improve the QA process across the product and engineering organization.

• Establish clear QA standards for test planning, execution, regression testing, defect reporting, evidence, retesting, and sign-off.

• Set a high and consistent quality bar for the QA team and coach team members on effective testing practices.

• Ensure QA work is systematic, reproducible, documented, and traceable rather than dependent on informal or ad-hoc testing.

• Define what must be validated for different types of changes and ensure appropriate test coverage before release.

• Review QA results and challenge incomplete testing, weak defect reproduction, or unsupported sign-off.

• Identify recurring gaps in QA execution and drive corrective process improvements.

• Help establish useful QA metrics such as escaped defects, regression failures, reopen rates, automation coverage, and recurring defect categories.

• Work constructively with Engineering and Product while maintaining independent authority to determine when quality requirements have not been met.



Hands-On Quality Assurance

• Personally perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and release testing as needed.

• Create and maintain test plans and test cases for new functionality, regressions, integrations, and critical workflows.

• Validate acceptance criteria and verify that completed engineering work behaves correctly across relevant environments and scenarios.

• Produce clear, actionable defect reports with reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, supporting evidence, and appropriate severity.

• Ensure defects are properly retested and regressions are covered before closure.

• Focus QA effort based on product risk, customer impact, change scope, and historical failure patterns.



QA Automation & Quality Engineering

• Own and expand meaningful automated regression coverage across the product.

• Determine which tests should be automated and which are better suited to manual or exploratory testing.

• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot automated UI, API, integration, and regression tests as appropriate.

• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and ensure they run at the correct stages of software delivery.

• Establish automated quality gates that prevent progression or release when required tests fail.

• Track flaky tests, automation failures, coverage gaps, and recurring regressions and drive them to resolution.

• Work with Engineering to ensure unit and engineering-level tests remain an engineering responsibility while QA provides broader product, integration, and regression assurance.

• Continuously reduce repetitive manual QA work where reliable automation provides better coverage and faster feedback.



Release Ownership & Deployment Control

• Own or directly support the end-to-end release process from QA readiness through production deployment and validation.

• Establish and enforce clear Definition of Release Ready and Definition of Release Complete standards.

• Confirm required code reviews, tests, scans, approvals, documentation, QA sign-off, deployment steps, and rollback preparation are complete before release.

• Plan, coordinate, execute, and validate production releases across relevant application components.

• Maintain release schedules, release manifests or records, release notes, deployment evidence, and rollback procedures.

• Identify release risks and dependencies early and escalate blockers before they affect delivery.

• Have the authority and judgment to stop or delay a release when required quality or readiness criteria have not been met.

• Ensure failed or partially completed releases have clear recovery and rollback procedures.

CI/CD, DevOps & Deployment Automation

• Own and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting build, test, security validation, packaging, and deployment.

• Maintain and improve Bitbucket repositories, Git workflows, branching practices, pull-request workflows, and pipeline integrations as they relate to quality and releases.

• Automate deployments across development, QA/staging, and production environments.

• Reduce manual deployment steps and opportunities for human error while preserving appropriate controls.

• Ensure pipelines provide clear visibility into failures and prevent unsafe deployments.

• Support and troubleshoot Docker/containerized application environments and deployment workflows.

• Support and oversee deployments into AWS environments, including configuration, permissions, dependencies, logs, monitoring, and deployment health.

• Help maintain consistency across development, QA/staging, and production environments and troubleshoot environment-related failures with Engineering.



Security, Release Validation & Production Follow-Through

• Integrate and maintain automated security, dependency, vulnerability, and code-quality scanning within the delivery pipeline.

• Define how critical test, security, and code-quality findings affect release readiness.

• Define and execute post-deployment smoke tests and validation procedures.

• Verify that releases are functioning correctly before considering deployment complete.

• Monitor deployment health, errors, logs, and other production signals following releases.

• Coordinate rapid response, rollback, or remediation when a release introduces problems.

• Lead or participate in post-release reviews and ensure quality or release failures result in concrete corrective actions.

• Maintain a clear audit trail showing what was released, when, by whom, and with which validations.



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong hands-on software QA experience in a production SaaS, web application, or similarly complex software environment.

• Experience leading QA practices, setting testing standards, or serving as a senior/lead QA engineer responsible for the quality bar of a team.

• Strong understanding of test strategy, functional testing, regression testing, exploratory testing, integration testing, defect management, and release validation.

• Hands-on experience building or maintaining automated software tests, ideally including API, integration, regression, and/or browser-based testing.

• Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience managing or directly supporting software releases and production deployments.

• Strong experience with Git workflows, branches, pull requests, and repository management; Bitbucket experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.

• Working knowledge of AWS and cloud deployment environments.

• Ability to troubleshoot failed builds, pipelines, automated tests, environment problems, and deployments.

• Understanding of rollback strategies, release risk management, and production i
 response.

• Ability to distinguish between QA responsibilities and engineering responsibilities and hold both functions to appropriate quality standards.

• Strong attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and low tolerance for undocumented, unverified, or casually bypassed quality steps.

• Ability to coach others, enforce standards constructively, and communicate clearly when work is not ready to progress.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Nice to Have

• Previous experience as a QA Lead, QA Manager, Senior QA Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, SDET, Release Engineer, or similar hands-on quality role.

• Experience managing or mentoring a distributed QA team.

• Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines.

• Experience with Docker or containerized deployments.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code and AWS deployment automation.

• Experience with automated security, vulnerability, dependency, or static-analysis scanning.

• Familiarity with PHP, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, and web application architectures.

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools.

• Experience improving an existing QA organization where processes, automation, or release discipline needed to mature.

• Experience supporting distributed engineering and QA teams.



Ideal Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior QA practitioner who wants ownership, not someone who views QA management as primarily assigning test work or tracking tickets. They are comfortable getting directly involved in difficult testing, reproducing defects, reviewing automation, troubleshooting pipelines, and validating releases.



They can walk into an existing QA process, identify where discipline or coverage is weak, establish practical standards, coach the team to meet them, and measure whether quality is actually improving. They know when a defect indicates an isolated issue and when it points to a broader gap in testing, engineering checks, or release controls.

They also understand the software delivery process beyond QA: why a build failed, why a test should block deployment, how environments differ, how a release should be packaged and validated, and where CI/CD or deployment automation can eliminate risk and manual work.



They are comfortable saying that a release is not ready when required standards have not been met, while working constructively with Engineering, Product, and QA to resolve the issue quickly.



Success in this role means the QA team becomes more disciplined and effective, automated coverage increases where it matters, fewer defects escape into production, and releases become more predictable, auditable, and automated over time.

We are a growing direct-to-consumer ecommerce brand, and we run paid ads on Meta every single day. We are looking for a talented short-form video editor to create high-converting Meta ads, with a focus on AI animation and AI cartoon UGC style creatives.



You understand that a good ad is not just beautiful. It stops the scroll, holds attention, and converts. If you love both video editing AND figuring out what makes people buy, keep reading.



## What you will create

- AI cartoon UGC ads

- AI animated storytelling ads

- Short-form Meta creatives

- New variations of our winning ads

- Strong short-form video editing skills for social and Meta ads (portfolio required)

We are looking for someone to help us find winning creatives and scale them with us long-term.

Green Frog Web Design builds websites and runs SEO and paid ads for lawn care and landscaping companies across the United States and Canada. You will be building sites that help real business owners grow.



What you'll do



Build and update client websites in WordPress using Elementor

Make sure every site looks great on mobile, tablet, and desktop

Create simple graphics and images for websites and marketing

Apply basic on-page SEO (titles, headings, page structure) as we train you

Take feedback from our team and clients and implement it quickly and accurately

Follow our design system and processes so every site meets the same standard



Schedule



This is a full-time role, 40 hours per week.

4 hours are mandatory: 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM Mountain Time (currently 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine time).

The other 4 hours are flexible. You choose when you work them during the same day.

If you cannot commit to the mandatory hours every weekday, please do not apply.

Someone who wants to get better every single week

Honest about what you know and don't know. If you're stuck, you say so.

Detail-oriented. You catch the misaligned button before the client does.

Good written and spoken English

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet place to work

Application process

title: Quantity Surveyor / Mechanical Engineer - Steelworks / Structural Steel| Remote
description:
About PropFix.ie



PropFix.ie is Ireland's trusted property maintenance specialist, offering comprehensive solutions with years of expertise across the construction and renovation sectors. We transform spaces through our diverse range of services, from handyman solutions and office fit-outs to complete renovations, house extensions, and specialized installations including doors, floors, and partitions.



Our commitment to delivering the best value property maintenance has established us as a reliable partner for residential and commercial clients nationwide. With decades of experience, including 50 years of expertise in garage conversions, we pride ourselves on impeccable craftsmanship, turning our clients' visions into reality while ensuring their properties remain in top condition.



Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role combines technical expertise with project coordination, focusing on metal fabrication design, cost estimation, and project delivery. The successful candidate will work closely with our sales, procurement, and installation teams to ensure seamless project execution from concept to completion.



Key Responsibilities

Design & Technical Work



AutoCAD 2D/3D Drawings: Prepare and edit precise technical and design drawings for industrial door installations.

Technical Documentation: Maintain comprehensive technical drawings, specifications, and project records.

Design Support: Assist with custom design adjustments and modifications to meet specific project requirements.

Quality Control: Review drawings for accuracy, consistency, compliance, and adherence to industry standards.

SolidWorks Expertise: Create, model, simulate, and optimize metal fabrication components and assemblies.



Project Management & Coordination



Job Pricing: Conduct detailed cost estimation and quantity surveying work for projects

Material Take-off: Identify and quantify material requirements with precision

Project Coordination: Support project scheduling and timeline management

Reporting: Provide regular progress updates and comprehensive cost reports



Procurement & Client Management



Material Ordering: Coordinate purchasing activities and maintain effective supplier communication

Supplier Coordination: Manage procurement processes and vendor relationships

CRM Updates: Maintain accurate client and project data in our CRM system



Required Skills & Experience

Technical Requirements



Tekla & AutoCAD Proficiency: Advanced skills in Tekla Structures and AutoCAD (2D & 3D applications)

Industry Knowledge: Experience with construction and industrial door systems

Quantity Surveying: Proven experience in cost estimation and QS methodologies

Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail



Professional Skills



Supplier Management: Experience in procurement and supplier coordination

CRM Systems: Familiarity with customer relationship management platforms

Organization: Exceptional organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills



What We Offer



Competitive salary package

Opportunity to work with cutting-edge industrial door technologies

Professional development and training opportunities

Collaborative and supportive work environment

Career growth potential within an expanding company

Involvement in diverse and challenging projects across Ireland



Application Reminders



To help optimize your application and improve its visibility during our screening process, please make sure to follow the instructions below. A complete and well-structured application may increase your chances of being considered for the role.



Submit your updated CV and portfolio (if applicable). Please ensure both documents are current and highlight your most relevant skills and work experience.

List all software, tools, and platforms you are proficient in. Be sure to include all relevant applications and technologies you have experience using so we can better assess your qualifications against the role requirements.



Application Instruction:





Thank you, and we look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper & Tax Preparer for a US Startup
description:
Type: Part-time, remote, long-term Hours: 10–15 hours/week Rate: Depending on credentials and experience Software: QuickBooks 



About us

We're a Texas-based startup. We are small 2 person team, fast pace, and we'd rather do the books right the first time than clean them up later. This is a long-term role. We're looking for one person to own our books and our filings, not a seasonal contractor.

What you'd own

Monthly bookkeeping

All transaction categorization in QuickBooks Online

Bank and credit card reconciliation

Accounts payable and receivable

Month-end close

Payroll coordination with our payroll provider

Monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement

Tax preparation and filing

Prepare and file our federal returns

Prepare and file Texas state filings, including the annual franchise tax report

Sales tax filings — monthly and quarterly, across the states where we have obligations

Quarterly estimated tax calculations

Year-round tax planning input as decisions come up

Keep us current on filing deadlines so nothing sneaks up on us

Requirements

Must have

IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) in good standing, with an active PTIN — or actively pursuing and passing your remaining SEE parts on a defined timeline

3+ years preparing and filing US business returns

3+ years of QuickBooks Online bookkeeping for US-based companies

Multi-state sales tax filing experience

Solid grounding in US GAAP conventions and US chart-of-accounts structure

Excellent written English 

Why this role is a good one

You own the whole picture — books through filing — instead of handing off at year-end

Consistent part-time hours and a predictable monthly payment

Direct working relationship with the founders. No layers, no ticket queue

Room to grow with us as we scale

We pay on time, every time

How to apply

Send us:

Your background — a resume or a short summary of your professional history, credentials, and the clients or firms you've worked with

Your EA number and PTIN status (or where you are in the SEE process, with dates)

A short note on your US business filing experience — entity types, states, industries

Your hourly rate

Your weekly availability — how many hours, which days

Your time zone and the hours you can overlap with us

Put "Experienced" in your subject line so we know you read the full post.
