title: Video Editor for Facebook & Instagram Ads
description:
We are a Swedish e-commerce company with several brands. We need a full-time Video Editor to create direct-response video ads for Meta 
 and Instagram).



This is not only a video editing job. You must do the full creative work:

- Research the customer, product, reviews, competitors and ads

- Study our active ads in Meta Ads Library

- Study our reference video carefully

- Find strong hooks and angles

- Write or improve scripts

- Find, create or generate the footage you need

- Edit the complete ad

- Improve ads based on results



At first, you will work with Scarlet Intimates / Scarlet Flow, a Scandinavian period-underwear brand. The two main customers are:

1. Mothers buying Scarlet Flow Teen for daughters before or around their first period.

2. Adult women who want a comfortable and dry alternative to pads.



IMPORTANT: THE PAID TEST



Selected applicants receive a Google Drive folder with the full creative brief, brand information, research and a reference ad.



You must create two complete Swedish ads:

1. One Adult ad

2. One Teen ad



These are not quick sample videos. Both videos must be complete, polished and ready to run as real Meta ads. Treat the test exactly like real full-time work.



For the test, you must:

- Read and follow every part of the brief

- Search Scarlet Intimates in Meta Ads Library and study our active ads

- Study the reference video carefully

- Do more research yourself

- Source or create your own content and B-roll. TikTok is a good source for research and B-roll ideas

- Make natural Scandinavian-looking visuals

- Keep the Scarlet product correct and consistent in every scene

- Avoid obvious one-prompt AI content

- Use fast cuts, scene variation, text, transitions, movement, sound effects and strong pacing

- Write the hooks and scripts, make voice-over and captions, and deliver finished ads



Deadline: 3 days.

The test pays $50 total when both finished creatives are delivered and the complete brief and requirements have been followed. Rushed, incomplete or off-brief tests are not approved for payment.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with this exact first line:

META VIDEO | [the editing software you use most]



Then include:

1. A link to one real, finished e-commerce or direct-response ad that you personally made. Do not send a montage.

2. Go to Meta Ads Library. Find one active Scarlet Intimates ad and paste the link. In 3 simple bullet points, explain the target customer, the hook, and one thing you would improve.

3. Confirm that you can source or create content yourself and finish two test ads within 3 days.



If any item is missing, we will not review the application.



LONG-TERM ROLE



This is a full-time role, 40 hours per week. Salary is $400-$750 per month plus performance bonuses, with room to grow. We want someone who can stay for several years. If hired, we provide the AI tools needed for the work.

Ideally we are looking for long-term employees to join our team. There is a great deal of growth opportunity for those that consistently make a positive contribution to our company. Furthermore, we require someone with attention to detail, so at the top of your application please mention the word "fruit", so that we know you actually read this text. We are seeking candidates that can elevate our creative process and output.



About the role:

• You’ll create high-converting static ads (image-based) that drive clicks and purchases.

• We’re testing various angles and formats: problem/solution, testimonials, visual storytelling, us vs. them.

• You will be supplied with brand assets, product images, angle concepts, and copywriting.

• You will be on boarded with training on the brand identity, info on the creative styling (Which you can also improve further), and also details on the customer personas.



What sets this role apart:

We expect you to be skilled with AI image generation tools like Nano Banana and SeedDream,

You’ll use these tools to generate fresh, unique ad creatives in line with the angle and copywriting.

Your creative opinion will always be welcomed and valued if you have ideas on how to improve an ad idea, creative or also the copywriting for example.



What we’re looking for:

• Experience designing static ads for Meta 
/IG), especially for e-commerce

• Eye for direct-response design: not just beautiful, but strategic and conversion-focused

• Strong skills in AI image creation to produce unique visuals that match our brand

• Ability to deliver multiple iterations for testing, optimized for various placements (feed, story)

• Proficiency in the English language, both written and oral



This position will be paid by the hour, and we will provide you with work for full time hours. We are also open to part time to start if you are the perfect fit.



Please respond by providing your relevant experience, including a visible portfolio of static ads, and also your weekly availability in terms of hours.



I look forward to your proposal.



Thank you.

Florian

title: DIRECT RESPONSE VIDEO EDITOR
description:
$1,000–$1,500/month + Performance Bonuses | Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote



IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are ONLY looking for candidates who have previously worked at:



• Resilia

• Lymphoria

• Rosabella

• Serene Herbs

• Everly

• ClarityMD



If you have not worked at one of these companies, please do not apply.



💰 ROLE DETAILS



Position: Senior Direct Response Video Editor

Type: Full-Time, Long-Term

Pay: $1,000–$1,500/month + bonuses for winning ads

Workload: 32 creative briefs per month

Location: Fully Remote



This is a long-term role for an editor who understands DTC health and wellness advertising, direct response, and AI-powered creative production.



Your ads will be tested with real ad spend and performance data.



🎬 WHAT YOU'LL DO



Create high-performing video ads across formats such as:



• AI UGC

• Voiceover + B-roll

• Greenscreen

• AI avatars

• Claymation

• Pixar / 3D-style creative

• Podcast-style ads

• Product and story-driven ads



The goal is simple: create ads that capture attention, retain viewers, and drive conversions.



🧠 WHAT WE EXPECT



You should understand:



• Strong hooks and pattern interrupts

• Retention-focused pacing

• Direct-response storytelling

• B-roll selection and visual sequencing

• Captions, kinetic text, and motion graphics

• Sound design and audio cleanup

• Basic color correction

• AI-generated creative and asset integration

• Clean project organization and reliable deadlines



You should be able to explain why an ad will or will not perform.



🛠️ TOOLS



Experience with tools such as:



• CapCut

• ElevenLabs

• HeyGen

• Kling

• Veo 3

• Nano Banana

• Higgsfield



You should also be comfortable learning new AI tools quickly.



🔥 WHAT WE CARE ABOUT

1. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



You must have worked at Resilia, Lymphoria, Rosabella, Serene Herbs, Everly, or ClarityMD.



2. DIRECT-RESPONSE THINKING



You understand:



Hook → Retention → Desire → Proof → Offer → CTA



3. SPEED AND QUALITY



You can complete 32 briefs per month while maintaining strong creative quality.



4. OWNERSHIP



You work independently, meet deadlines, respond quickly, and take feedback well.



5. AI SKILLS



AI is a core part of our creative workflow. You should know how to use AI assets without making ads feel obviously AI-generated.



🚫 DO NOT APPLY IF...



• You have not worked at one of the six listed companies

• You only create visually attractive videos without understanding performance

• You need constant supervision

• You are unwilling to learn new tools

• You are not interested in long-term creative growth



📝 HOW TO APPLY



Your application must include:



Which listed company you worked for

Your exact role and dates of employment

A brief description of your experience

Your portfolio with DTC or performance ad examples

Your strongest editing and AI skills

ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS

1. PERFORMANCE



Choose one successful ad you created and explain why it worked.



2. ITERATION



Describe an ad that underperformed, what the data showed, and what you changed.



3. AI CREATIVE PROCESS



Explain your process for creating AI UGC, avatars, claymation, 3D, podcast, or other AI-driven ads.



4. HIGH-VOLUME WORK



Tell us how you manage quality and deadlines when producing a high volume of ads.



⚠️ APPLICATION CODE WORD



Include ScaleMode somewhere in your application.



Applications without this code word will not be reviewed.



🎯 FINAL STEP



Shortlisted applicants will complete a trial task.



We are looking for someone who can think like a performance creative editor, not just someone who can edit videos.



If you have worked at one of the listed companies and can deliver high-quality creative consistently, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Graphic Designer (Email, Ads & Social), Hobby & Ecommerce Brands
description:
==============

ABOUT THE ROLE

==============



We're a friendly digital marketing agency working with ecommerce and hobby brands: anime-inspired brands, trading card games (Magic, Pokémon, sports cards), collectibles, and local game stores. We love this world, and we're looking for a designer who does too.



We're after someone who makes designs that look great and get people to click and buy. If you've got a good eye and solid work to show, we'd love to hear from you.



==============

WHAT YOU'LL DO

==============



- Design marketing
s that are clean, on-brand, mobile-first, and built to convert.

- Create static ads and social media content.

- Whip up multiple versions of a design for testing.

- Match each client's brand and keep it consistent.

- Help build brand guidelines for clients who don't have them yet.

- Take feedback and turn revisions around fast.



======================

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

======================



- A good eye for clean, modern design, and a sense of where you want the reader's eye to go.

- You get what makes an ad or
 actually perform, not just look nice. Our stuff needs to drive clicks and sales, so you can explain why your design choices work.

- Figma is a must. It's what we use to pass designs to our
 team. Canva, Photoshop, or similar are a plus.

- Comfortable switching between very different brand styles.

- Branding experience. You can help build brand guidelines for brands that don't have them.

- Reliable and organized. You can handle a few brands at once without quality slipping.



===========

NICE TO HAVE

===========



- You're into the hobby world yourself: anime, trading card games (Magic, Pokémon, sports cards), collectibles. You'll design better for these brands if you actually get them.



============

HOW TO APPLY

============



1. Start your message with "Pikachu" so we know you read this in full.

2. Send your portfolio link.

3. Record a short Loom (1 to 3 minutes): who you are, why you want to work with us, and your favorite anime, card game, or hobby. Keep it casual, no need to make it fancy.

4. Tell us your expected monthly rate and when you can start.



Looking forward to meeting you!

title: Podcast Video/Audio Editor
description:
I am looking for an experienced Video/Audio Editor who is SKILLED, RELIABLE and has a great EAR for pacing. I need someone who can take raw podcast footage and remove the pauses and filler words to make me and my cohost sound even smarter than we already are. 



I am looking for someone DETAIL-ORIENTED, HONEST and DEDICATED to join the team as soon as possible! You’ll be editing approximately one hour of raw podcast footage per week (video + audio), cutting dead air, filler words ("um," "uh"), long pauses, and false starts, choosing 10 - 30 second teasers to open the episode, and Inserting provided intro (between teaser and start of episode) and outro (at the very end). You will not need to worry about multi-camera cuts or overlays. You’ll deliver a finished episode ready for publishing on Patreon (video + audio) and to the podcast platforms (audio only).

I anticipate this will be 3-5 hours of work per week to start, with the potential to grow to 7-10 hours per week if we're a good fit — including social media clips down the line. Must know Riverside.fm's editor OR your own software (Premiere, DaVinci, Final Cut, etc). Bonus points if you use a platform that leverages AI to identify filler words and balance audio levels, etc. I’m looking for someone with a good ear for PACING, in other words, you know when a cut helps the conversation flow vs. when it kills the natural rhythm. There are REAL deadlines every week. So this is a GREAT long-term opportunity with room to grow, but you must be reliable and consistent.



If this sounds like you, reply to this job post with: A link to 1-2 podcast OR video edits you've done, your typical turnaround time, and a movie or tv show you loved as a child.

title: Senior Accountant - Big 4 Audit and Accrual Experience Required - IMMEDIATE START
description:
About Us:

Profitability Partners is a distinguished fractional CFO business based in Florida, specializing in delivering financial expertise to  contractor and home service businesses. We are on the lookout for a highly experienced Senior Accountant with a comprehensive background in audit, and general accounting/bookkeeping practices particularly on an accrual pasis. This remote, full-time opportunity is ideal for an overseas professional eager to take on a central role in our expansion, with the potential to grow into a managerial position overseeing our accounting operations. 



Compensation is $2,500 per month with an annual bonus equivalent to $2,500 based on performance. 



THIS ROLE IS FULL TIME ONLY AND IMMEDIATE START - PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE SEEKING PART TIME WORK OR INTEND TO WORK MULTIPLE ROLES AT ONCE



Key Responsibilities:



Month-End and Year-End Closing:



Manage the month-end and year-end close process, ensuring accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions.

Conduct thorough account reconciliations and adjust journal entries to reflect the correct financial position.

Prepare detailed financial reports and statements, analyzing for variances and providing insights on financial status.



General Accounting & Financial Management:

Maintain accurate and comprehensive financial records and general ledgers.

Manage all aspects of bookkeeping, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing, and payroll.



Accrual Based Accounting

Prepare client books on an accrual basis - including revenue recognition, COGS recognition timing, and operating expense cost recognition. 

Reconcile payment processors and tie data to CRM with journal entries.

Preparation of accrual based working papers

Proper AP/AR balance sheet reconciliation



Qualifications:

Experience working with home services and other businesses with manual invoice data and complicated contracts

Experience working with clients in the 5mm-30mm revenue range

Previous experience working with US based accounting/bookkeeping firms as well as background in audit.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

CPA certification is required.

At least 3 years of GAAP-based accounting experience, with a focus on audit with time spent at a Big 4 accounting firm.

Experience with accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks desktop and online).

C1 level or higher proficiency in English.

Demonstrated expertise in managing full-cycle accounting and tax filing processes.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

A strong sense of ethics, confidentiality, and professionalism.

Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

title: Financial Analyst/ Administrative Assistant
description:
## About the role



This is a blended role for someone who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and in an inbox. You'll own the numbers that tell us how the business is performing -membership revenue, provider productivity, location P&Ls - while keeping the day-to-day operations of the office running smoothly.



It's a strong fit for someone who has worked in health and wellness and understands the rhythms of the industry: recurring membership revenue, seasonal swings in demand, retail and service mix, practitioner scheduling, and the compliance details that come with client health information.



## What you'll do



### Financial analysis

- Build and maintain monthly financial reporting, including P&L by location, service line, and product category

- Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle; track actuals against plan and explain the variances

- Analyze membership metrics — new sales, churn, retention, average revenue per member, lifetime value

- Support pricing decisions on memberships, packages, services, and retail

- Model the financial case for new locations, service lines, equipment purchases, or hires

- Reconcile accounts and partner with our accounting firm on month-end close

- Process payroll inputs and commission or bonus calculations 

- Track vendor spend, negotiate where you see room, and flag contracts up for renewal



### Administrative support

- Manage calendars, meetings, and travel for the leadership

- Handle accounts payable and receivable, expense reports, and invoicing

- Maintain organized digital records for contracts, licenses, insurance, and certifications

- Coordinate with vendors, landlords, insurance carriers, and service providers

- Support onboarding logistics for new team members

- Keep licensing, certification, and renewal deadlines from sneaking up on anyone

- Help prepare board or investor materials and internal presentations

- Take on the operational projects that don't fit neatly in anyone's job description



## What we're looking for



**Required**

- [2–4]+ years in financial analysis, accounting, bookkeeping, or business operations

- Direct experience in the health and wellness industry

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, building a model from scratch)

- Hands-on experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite

- Strong written and verbal communication; you can explain a variance to someone who doesn't read financial statements

- Genuine attention to detail and follow-through on tasks nobody is chasing you about

- Comfort handling confidential financial and personnel information with discretion



**Preferred**

- Experience with multi-location or franchise operations

- Exposure to HIPAA requirements or clinical/practice administration

- Understanding of recurring-revenue and subscription business models



- A role with real breadth — you'll see the whole business, not one slice of it

- Direct access to leadership and visible influence on decisions

description:
About the work



Trio Ad Group is a US advertising agency in Des Moines, Iowa. We produce print and packaging for five brand kits: a healthcare company, an IT services company, a nonprofit health center, and two consumer brands. The next two months are print-heavy. You will build finished, print-ready files from locked copy and approved direction, and you will own pre-press so nothing comes back from the printer.



What you will produce



Trade-show backdrops on the printer's own templates: backlit fabric panels, counter wraps, CMYK, bleed and safe zones, type outlined, artwork kept off the seams

Packaging: a gatefold on a supplied dieline, and box art as it comes

One-pagers, flyers, trifolds, brochures, and an event invitation suite

A 9x9 game-board handout, full color front, one color back

Letterhead, business cards, tee art, koozie art, a truck decal

Canva templates a client's own team will run after you build them

Static ad creative, resized across placements

What you must have



Five or more years producing print for real printers, with proofs you checked yourself

Pre-press you can show: dielines, bleed and safe, CMYK and SWOP builds, outlined type, PDF/X exports, packaged native files

InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop at a professional level. Canva for templates.

English you write clearly. You will read a brief, ask questions in writing, and flag problems before they ship.

The discipline to work from a locked brief: copy does not change, the brand kit is the law, and you flag what breaks instead of fixing it quietly

Reliable internet, a backup for outages, and a machine that runs the Adobe suite without lag

How we work



One brief per job: dimensions, locked copy, the brand kit, and the printer's spec

First draft, then up to two revision rounds, reviewed in our portal

Final delivery as a print-ready package

Weekly hours agreed in advance. Invoice every two weeks, paid on time.

You sign a contractor agreement (the work belongs to Trio on payment, client material stays confidential) and one client NDA

You work from brand kits, locked copy, and dimensions. No client platforms, no client data.

How to apply



Start your message with the word DIELINE so I know you read this. Then send:



Three print pieces you produced, each with the printer's spec it was built to

One packaging or large-format piece, with the dieline or template you built it on

Your hourly rate and the hours you can hold in US Central time

Your internet speed and your backup plan for outages

Applications without the word DIELINE and the four items get no reply.

Use AI tools daily and suggest ways AI can make our processes faster

Work inside GoHighLevel (GHL): update contacts, pipelines, and basic workflows

Make minor website edits when needed: text updates, swapping images, simple page tweaks

Requirements

2+ years of social media management experience for businesses or agencies

Excellent written English — your captions go straight to US business audiences

Strong Canva skills; basic video editing skills

Experience with scheduling tools (Rella, Later, Buffer, Planoly, or similar)

Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini in your workflow

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM is a big plus

Able to make simple website edits (WordPress, GHL sites, Wix, or similar builders)

Reliable internet, own computer, and availability for some US Eastern Time overlap for weekly check-ins

Organized, honest, and consistent — deadlines are non-negotiable in this role

Schedule & Pay

Independent contractor; starts around 3 hours per week per client account

Hours increase as you take on more client accounts — top performers grow into a lead role managing other SMMs

Weekly rhythm: Monday planning, Tuesday creation, Wednesday QA and client staging, Thursday revisions and scheduling, Friday inbox and cleanup

Rate: state your hourly rate expectation in your application

title: Experienced Virtual Psychometrician or Psychologist
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Virtual Psychometrician or Psychologist to join our team. This role involves administering, scoring, and interpreting psychological and educational assessments in a virtual environment. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in psychometrics or psychology, with a focus on maintaining HIPAA and FERPA compliance, and exceptional attention to detail in both report writing and communication. The person must have availability during USA Eastern or Pacific time zone business hours to ensure seamless collaboration and support.



Key Responsibilities:

• Administer psychological and educational assessments in a virtual setting

• Score assessments accurately and efficiently using provided tools and guidelines

• Interpret data and provide insights to inform recommendations for support and intervention

• Prepare detailed and accurate reports with professionalism and clarity

• Ensure strict adherence to privacy standards, including HIPAA and FERPA regulations

• Communicate effectively with school psychologists, educators, and tea
mbers

• Maintain confidentiality and ethical guidelines in handling sensitive information

• Stay updated on assessment tools, technologies, and best practices in virtual psychometric or psychological work



Qualifications:

• Master’s or Doctoral degree in psychology, educational psychology, or a related field

• Experience as a psychometrician or psychologist, administering and interpreting assessments

• Proficiency with assessment tools and scoring software (e.g., WISC, BASC, Woodcock-Johnson, or similar)

• Strong knowledge of privacy regulations, including HIPAA and FERPA

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in report writing and scoring

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for accurate and professional reporting

• Proficient in using technology for virtual assessments (e.g., Zoom, online assessment platforms)

• Ability to work independently and maintain high standards of professionalism

• Availability during USA Eastern or Pacific time zone business hours



Compensation:

Pay is negotiable based on experience.



Application Process:

To apply for this position, candidates MUST complete all three of the following steps:

1. Submit a resume outlining relevant experience.

2. Upload proof of credentials (e.g., certification or licensure in psychometrics or psychology).

3. Submit a link to a newly created video introduction where you:

• State the current date (to verify it’s a new video).

• Explain your experience in administering and interpreting assessments.

• Highlight your attention to detail in report writing and your approach to maintaining HIPAA and FERPA compliance.



Important Application Instructions:

• Applications must be submitted through the following link: 
/4130RpL

• Applications submitted directly on other platforms will not be considered.

• Do not apply if you do not complete all requirements as described above.

• Old video introductions or videos that do not include the required components will not be considered.



We look forward to reviewing your application and seeing how your expertise can support our mission to provide high-quality services!

title: WordPress Engineer (1 to 2 Months)
description:
WordPress Engineer

Mid-Level | Remote-Friendly | Contract or Full-Time





About the Role

We're hiring a mid-level WordPress Engineer to join a growing engineering team that treats WordPress as a serious, modern engineering discipline — not a drag-and-drop CMS. You'll work on version-controlled, Composer-managed WordPress builds with structured content, design-token-driven theming, automated testing, and a proper CI/CD pipeline. If you're tired of plugin-soup builds and want to work the way front-end and back-end engineering is supposed to be done, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

• Build and maintain WordPress sites on a Composer-managed project architecture — WordPress core, plugins, and themes declared as pinned, version-controlled dependencies (no wp-admin plugin installs).

• Develop bespoke, classic (non-block) WordPress themes coded from a client's design system, using structured, reusable template components.

• Build page-composition experiences using ACF Flexible Content (or comparable structured-field tooling), with a strict one-to-one mapping between each content block and its template partial.

• Implement and maintain a design-token pipeline so every colour, spacing, and typography value flows from a single source of truth — nothing hardcoded into templates or stylesheets.

• Model custom post types, taxonomies, and fields in code so content structure is reviewable, version-controlled, and reproducible.

• Build accessible, secure custom forms without general-purpose form-builder plugins — proper nonce protection, honeypots, rate limiting, and spam prevention.

• Maintain a small, vetted set of third-party plugins — every addition assessed, pinned to an exact version, and justified.

• Apply WordPress security hardening as standard practice: locked-down file editing, environment-based secrets, disabled XML-RPC, rate-limited login endpoints, and related measures.

• Write and maintain automated tests — coding standards, static analysis, accessibility checks, and end-to-end coverage.

• Work within a CI/CD pipeline where every change is peer-reviewed, scanned, and tested before it reaches production.

• Use a containerised local development environment for consistent, reproducible setups across the team.

What We're Looking For

• 2–4 years of professional WordPress development experience.

• Strong PHP fundamentals, comfortable working outside a "vanilla" WordPress install (Composer-based project structures such as Bedrock or similar).

• Experience building custom themes from a design system — semantic, accessible markup, no reliance on page-builder plugins.

• Familiarity with Advanced Custom Fields (or comparable structured-content tooling) for content modelling.

• Working knowledge of modern front-end practice: progressive enhancement with vanilla JavaScript, and CSS custom properties or design tokens.

• Solid understanding of WordPress security fundamentals — sanitisation, escaping, nonces, and capability checks.

• Some exposure to automated testing (unit, accessibility, or end-to-end) and Git-based CI/CD workflows.

• Comfortable working independently against documented engineering standards, and collaborating closely with designers and other developers.

• Good written and spoken English for async collaboration with a distributed team.

Nice to Have

• Experience with a design-token / style-dictionary pipeline, or with Storybook as a component review tool.

• Familiarity with WCAG AA accessibility standards and automated accessibility testing tools.

• Experience with WordPress multisite.

• Exposure to dependency or security scanning tools in a CI pipeline.

What You Can Expect

• A remote-friendly, engineering-first WordPress role built around real standards — not a one-off plugin-install job.

• Clear technical documentation and conventions to build against from day one.

• A collaborative code-review culture and modern CI/CD tooling.

• The opportunity to grow into more senior architecture and mentorship responsibility over time.



Attach your CV or CV Links (PDF File Preferred)

• Track adherence to schedules, procedures, and assigned responsibilities.

• Review required event photos, documentation, and job-completion requirements when applicable.

• Maintain appropriate worker efficiency and performance records.

• Identify recurring performance or operational concerns.

• Identify shortages, discrepancies, damaged equipment, and missing items.

• Coordinate routine inventory counts and verification.

• Track equipment requiring cleaning, repair, maintenance, or replacement.

• Help ensure rental-management software accurately reflects operational inventory availability.

• Communicate inventory concerns before they affect upcoming events.



Subrental & Vendor Coordination



• Identify items that need to be sourced from outside vendors.

• Order and coordinate approved subrental equipment, including linens and other rental items.

• Verify quantities, sizes, colors, specifications, dates, and event requirements.

• Coordinate vendor communication and track incoming subrental orders.

• Coordinate receipt and return of sub-rented equipment.

• Ensure subrental requirements are completed according to event deadlines.



NC 811 & Tent Permitting Coordination



• Coordinate NC 811 utility-marking requests for applicable tent installations.

• Track marking requests and completion status.

• Coordinate required tent permitting and organize information needed for permit applications.

• Track permit deadlines, approvals, inspections, and outstanding requirements.

• Maintain organized records of permits, utility markings, and related documentation.

• Escalate unresolved permitting or site-compliance concerns before installation.



Event Execution Support



• Monitor logistics throughout active event days.

• Coordinate schedule and routing changes when necessary.

• Assist with unexpected field or site issues.

• Maintain communication with warehouse and field personnel.

• Coordinate pickup and return requirements and track subrental returns.

• Maintain accurate logistics documentation.



After-Event Evaluation



• Review completed events from an operational perspective.

• Evaluate whether scheduling, preparation, delivery, setup, pickup, and return were completed properly.

• Identify delays, damages, missing equipment, incomplete responsibilities, or other operational issues.

• Review worker efficiency and execution.

• Document recurring problems and opportunities for improvement.

• Communicate significant findings to management.

• Help turn lessons learned into improvements for future events.



TECHNICAL SKILLS & SYSTEM EXPERIENCE



AI & Productivity Tools



• Proficient with modern AI-assisted productivity tools, including ChatGPT, Manus, and similar platforms.

• Comfortable using AI responsibly for research, problem-solving, documentation, organization, communication, data review,

process development, and workflow efficiency.

• Resourceful and able to use technology to solve routine problems independently while knowing when management

involvement is required.



Rental Management Software



• Previous event/equipment rental software experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience with RentKit, Event Office / Inflatable Office, ERS / Event Rental Systems, Point of Rental, or comparable

rental-management platforms is particularly valuable.

• Direct event rental, equipment rental, tent rental, event logistics, or related industry experience is a significant advantage.



General Technical Skills



• Google Workspace, Google Sheets/spreadsheets, shared documents, cloud storage,
, and calendar management.

• CRM systems, digital scheduling tools, data entry, record maintenance, and online research.

• Ability to learn new software quickly and work across multiple applications simultaneously.

• Strong data accuracy and attention to detail.



ATTENDANCE & RELIABILITY

Consistent attendance is a must.



• Excellent and consistent attendance and dependable punctuality.

• Availability throughout scheduled working hours.

• Reliable high-speed internet and dependable computer/workstation.

• A reasonable backup plan for common internet or power interruptions.

• Prompt communication when an unavoidable emergency affects availability.

• Ability to consistently maintain an overnight Philippine work schedule.

• Strong personal accountability and follow-through.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Highly organized and detail-oriented; proactive rather than reactive.

• Dependable, consistent, resourceful, and technologically adaptable.

• Comfortable coordinating people remotely and holding others accountable for assigned responsibilities.

• Able to manage multiple events and deadlines simultaneously.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Confident communicating with workers, vendors, and management.

• Able to prioritize urgent versus non-urgent matters and recognize problems before they become emergencies.

• Able to work independently without constant supervision.

• Comfortable researching solutions and escalating appropriately when management decisions are required.

• Experience in event rentals, event logistics, dispatching, warehouse operations, inventory management, project

coordination, construction logistics, workforce coordination, or similar environments is strongly preferred.



WORK SCHEDULE

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines-Based

Working Hours: 6:00 AM-3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Because U.S. Eastern Time observes daylight saving time while the Philippines does not, Philippine working hours will

generally be 6:00 PM-3:00 AM PHT during U.S. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) and 7:00 PM-4:00 AM PHT during U.S.

Eastern Standard Time (EST).



Applicants must be comfortable maintaining an overnight Philippine schedule that follows U.S. Eastern Time throughout the

year.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful Event Logistics Coordinator does not simply wait for instructions. They consistently think: What events are

coming up? Is everything ready? What needs to happen next? Who is responsible? Has it actually been

completed? Is anything missing? What could cause a problem tomorrow? What can we improve next time?

The goal of this position is to create organized, efficient, predictable event operations and help ensure that the right people,

equipment, information, permits, subrentals, and resources are in the right place at the right time.



ABOUT CHARLOTTE PARTY RENTALS



Charlotte Party Rentals is an established event rental company serving Charlotte, North Carolina and surrounding

communities. Our team provides tents, tables, chairs, linens, and other event rental equipment and services for private,

corporate, community, and large-scale events.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of our operations team and contribute

to improving the systems, organization, efficiency, and quality of our company.



HOW TO APPLY

• A brief introduction about yourself.

• Your relevant experience in logistics, operations, event rentals, warehouse coordination, inventory, workforce coordination,

or project management.

• Any experience with RentKit, Event/Inflatable Office, ERS, Point of Rental, or other rental-management software.

• Other software/platforms you are proficient with.

• Your earliest available start date.

title: Amazon Senior PPC Specialist | XP Strategy
description:
XP Strategy runs Amazon and marketplace advertising for seven- and eight-figure sellers in the US and internationally, including UK-based Nature's Blends. As an Amazon Ads Verified Partner, we work hands-on in AMC and DSP, and we run advertising in Walmart Connect and Target Plus. The team is small, senior, and fully distributed, and we are growing.



You run the advertising for a portfolio of client brands. You hit each account's ACoS and TACoS targets. The Account Manager sets the goal; you d
 how the ads get there, from structure and bids to budgets, keywords, and negatives. You watch pacing daily and catch spend problems before they cost budget.



What we're looking for

- Experience with AMC is required. DSP experience is a strong plus.

- 3+ years managing Amazon PPC hands-on, ideally at an agency, across several brands at once

- A track record managing five-figure monthly ad spend for seven-figure brands (required)

- Deep command of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display

- Campaign architecture that holds up as an account scales: branded, non-branded, and competitor segmentation with deliberate match types

- Bid and budget discipline against clear ACoS and TACoS targets

- Bulk operations experience

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, with strong analytical skills

- At home in the Amazon Ads console and in AdLabs (our primary tool), Helium 10, Data Dive, and MixShift, with the judgment to override a tool when the data says otherwise

- Fluent written and spoken English; you can tell an Account Manager or brand owner why ACoS moved and what you are doing about it

- Comfortable running several accounts at once without dropping details, with ClickUp, Asana, or a similar tool in daily use

- Vendor Central, Walmart Connect, and Target retail media are a plus



Responsibilities:

- Campaign build-out. Build campaigns across ad types and match types, structured to our naming conventions and SOPs.

- Bids and budgets. Manage bids and budgets to each account's targets. Keyword harvesting and negations run on a set schedule, and budgets are planned around launches, Prime Day, and Q4 before the traffic arrives.

- Optimization and research. Tune placements and budgets continuously, run keyword, competitor, and market research, and A/B test content for conversion.

- Quality control. Check the accuracy of everything that ships to an account. A misplaced decimal on a bulk upload spends client money.

- Reporting and forecasting. Deliver reporting an Account Manager can put in front of a client, framed in revenue, profitability, and TACoS. Flag performance problems early, and build advertising forecasts clients can plan budget and inventory against.

- Collaboration. Work with Account Managers, creative, and catalog. When ranking or conversion is the actual problem, say so.

- Growth. Track Amazon advertising updates and bring the expansion opportunities you find in the data as concrete recommendations. Keep ClickUp current.



What success looks like after a year:

- Your accounts hold their ACoS and TACoS targets month over month.

- Any account you have touched is structured cleanly enough for someone else to pick up.

- Account Managers trust your numbers without re-checking them, and your analysis shows up in their client calls.



Working terms:

- US Eastern hours, 9:00am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday

- Direct access to leadership, with influence over how advertising is run here

- Exposure to seven- and eight-figure brands across Amazon, Walmart and Target

Read this post fully, then complete our short application form. It includes a 2-minute video where you walk us through a PPC win you are proud of, as if you were explaining it to the client.

title: Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist
description:
Del Playa Group (DPG) is a U.S.-based professional services firm specializing in accounting, finance, and audit solutions for businesses and CPA firms. We help clients expand capacity, strengthen controls, and elevate performance through three pillars: fractional CFO advisory, top offshore talent, and transformative technology.



Headquartered in Orange County, California, DPG was founded through the strategic merger of NS Auxilium, MN Advisory Services, and Devine Financial Solutions. At Del Playa Group, our mission is simple: “Help audit and finance teams do more with less, without compromising quality and control.”



APPLY HERE: 



The Role



We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist to support our U.S. operations. This role will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounts payable activities, vendor communications, purchase order workflows, payment processing, and account reconciliations.



The ideal candidate is proactive, systems-savvy, and comfortable managing high-volume transactions with accuracy and efficiency. You will play a key role in ensuring invoices and payments are processed timely, vendor accounts are properly reconciled, AP inquiries are resolved promptly, and purchasing processes follow established company controls.



This role requires strong ownership of the AP function, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with accounting, finance, operations, and vendors.



Key Responsibilities



Accounts Payable Entry & Payment Processing

Process vendor invoices accurately and timely in Intacct

Review invoices for proper coding, approvals, supporting documentation, and compliance with company policies

Set up and process ACH payment batches in Intacct

Process ACH payments through the bank and ensure payments are completed accurately and on schedule

Post recurring bills and maintain accurate AP records

Prepare and post AP-related journal entries as needed

Monitor outstanding invoices and payment status to ensure timely resolution

Support credit card transaction processing and reconciliation



AP Inbox & Vendor Support

Own and manage the AP inbox, ensuring all AP-related requests and inquiries are reviewed and addressed promptly

Respond to vendor and internal AP questions regarding invoices, payment status, account balances, and required documentation

Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve invoice, approval, and payment issues

Maintain professional and timely communication with vendors and internal teams

Escalate complex or unresolved AP issues when appropriate



Vendor Statement Reconciliation

Perform regular vendor statement reconciliations to ensure all invoices, credits, and payments are accurately recorded

Investigate and resolve discrepancies between vendor statements and company records

Identify missing invoices, duplicate transactions, unapplied payments, and outstanding balances

Maintain accurate vendor account records and supporting documentation

Coordinate with vendors and internal accounting teams to resolve discrepancies



Purchase Orders

Process all purchase order (PO) requests in accordance with established company procedures

Company Overview

We are looking for a Personal Assistant who works as an Agenda Setter: someone who looks at what needs to happen today, this week and this month, d

Your day is a mix of: reviewing what's on the founder's plate, blocking focus time in the calendar, keeping the project boards (Trello, Bitrix24) up to date, sending short follow-ups so tasks don't stall, and organizing incoming information so decisions are easy. title: Creative Strategist / Head of Creative — DTC Ecommerce Brands (Full Time, Remote)
description:
Creative Strategist / Head of Creative — DTC Ecommerce Brands (Full Time, Remote)



We run a portfolio of direct to consumer ecommerce brands in the USA, including clothing brands. Our growth comes from one thing: volume and quality of creative. We are building an in house creative team and looking for a creative strategist to lead it — someone who owns the ideas, the angles, the testing, and the people.



You don't need to come from an agency. You need to come from performance. If you have spent years figuring out why one ad prints money and another dies in the first two seconds, this role is for you.



## WHAT YOU WILL DO



You are the brain of the creative operation. Editors execute — you d
 what gets made, why, and what happens to it after it launches.



Day to day this looks like:



• Owning the creative strategy across all our brands: angles, hooks, concepts, and formats



• Writing scripts and briefs for ads — UGC style, advertorial, direct response video, and static ads



• Managing and directing our video editors: assigning work, giving sharp feedback, and holding a high quality bar



• Running the testing system: d
 what gets tested, structuring hook and angle tests, reading the data, and calling winners and losers



• Turning winners into scaling plans — new variations, new angles, new formats



• Building creative briefs that editors can execute without back and forth



• Researching competitors, trends, and what's working in the market right now



• Working hands on with AI tools when needed — you should be able to generate, not just direct



• Reporting directly to the founders on creative performance and pipeline



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Real experience in performance creative for DTC ecommerce — you have made ads that spent real money on Meta, and you can show the results



• Strong scriptwriting for paid social: UGC ads, advertorials, VSLs, statics. You know how to write a hook that stops the scroll and a structure that sells



• Deep understanding of marketing angles, customer psychology, and how to test them systematically



• Experience managing editors or a creative team — giving feedback that makes work better, not just different



• Hands on with the tools: CapCut, Claude, and Higgsfield are must haves. You use AI daily for scripting, ideation, image and video generation



• Familiarity with the wider AI stack — Nano Banana Pro, ChatGPT Image, Seedance, Kling 3.0, Sora — and platforms like Freepik and Artlist



• You understand the full ad production pipeline and can spot where it breaks



• An interest in clothing and fashion, or experience with clothing brands, is a strong plus



• Comfortable working independently, communicating clearly in English, and being reachable during agreed hours



• Reliable internet and a machine that can handle heavy creative and AI workflows



Claude, CapCut, and Higgsfield are non negotiable. They are part of the daily workflow, not bonus skills.



## WHERE THIS ROLE GOES



This is a leadership seat. As the team grows, you grow with it — more editors under you, more brands, more budget, more ownership. The path here is head of creative, with real influence over how our brands look, sound, and sell. We invest in the person in this seat and expect them to build the creative machine with us.



## COMPENSATION



• 1,500 – 2,000 USD per month depending on experience



• Higher compensation is on the table based on performance and negotiation



## HOURS



Full time, 40 hours per week, Philippines time working hours. Start date: ASAP.



## HOW TO APPLY



Your application will not be reviewed unless it includes all of the following:



1. **A portfolio or proof of work** — ads you have strategized, scripted, or produced for ecommerce brands, with results where possible (spend, ROAS, CTR, or context on performance). Links or attachments (Drive, 
, personal site) are fine.



2. **Script samples** — at least two ad scripts you have written (any format: UGC, advertorial, direct response). Real work, not theory.



3. **A written description of your AI workflow** — how you use Claude, Higgsfield, CapCut, and any other AI tools day to day. What do you use each one for, and what have you produced with them? This is required.



4. **A short note on how you test creative** — how you structure tests, what you look for in the data, and how you d
 what scales.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to walk through real examples during the interview — actual scripts, actual tests, actual generations — so be ready to show your work, not just talk about it.



---



A couple of things you may want to adjust before posting:



- **Job title** — I'd post it as **"Creative Strategist (Head of Creative Track)"** — "Head of Creative" alone tends to attract agency people who expect agency salaries, while "Creative Strategist" attracts the performance marketing crowd you actually want.

- **Proof of results** — if you've had issues with inflated portfolios, you could add "be ready to share ad account screenshots" to the interview line.

title: Senior SEO & Content Growth Specialist
description:
Senior SEO & Content Growth Specialist — Part-Time, 25 Hours/Week

We are seeking an experienced Senior SEO & Content Growth Specialist to drive organic growth across a portfolio of healthcare, mental health, professional education, and online service brands.

This is a hands-on execution role.

We are not looking for someone who simply produces blog posts, runs keyword reports, or schedules social content. We need someone who can identify meaningful growth opportunities, execute against them, and improve measurable performance across search, AI-driven discovery, content, and social media.

Hours: Approximately 25 hours per week

Schedule: Part-time, ongoing

Work Arrangement: Remote

Brands You Will Support

You will work across several established brands, including:

Kentucky Counseling Center

Counseling Now

ESALetterOnline.co

Therapy Trainings

These businesses operate across mental healthcare, telehealth, emotional support animal evaluations, and continuing education for behavioral health professionals.

Primary Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Execution

You will be responsible for identifying and executing opportunities to improve organic search performance.

Responsibilities include:

Keyword research and prioritization

Competitor analysis

Content-gap analysis

Search intent analysis

Identifying high-value ranking opportunities

On-page SEO

Internal linking

Topic-cluster development

Keyword cannibalization review

Updating and improving existing content

Identifying pages with strong ranking potential

Monitoring rankings and organic performance

Recommending technical SEO improvements when needed

We currently use Ahrefs, and strong experience with Ahrefs or a comparable platform is required.

SEO Content Development

You will help create and optimize long-form content designed to rank and convert.

This includes:

Developing content briefs

Writing and editing SEO-focused blog content

Optimizing existing articles

Structuring content around search intent

Building internal-linking strategies

Identifying opportunities to strengthen topical authority

Ensuring content is accurate, useful, and competitive

Several of our brands operate within healthcare and mental health, so content quality and accuracy matter.

We are not interested in publishing generic AI-generated content.

AI tools may be used to improve efficiency, but the final product must demonstrate strong research, judgment, editing, and subject relevance.

AI Search / GEO / AEO

We want to improve visibility not only in traditional Google search, but also in AI-driven search environments.

You should understand or be actively working with:

Google AI Overviews

Generative Engine Optimization

Answer Engine Optimization

ChatGPT and AI-powered search

Perplexity

Entity authority

Topical authority

Structured answers

Citation-worthy content

FAQ and question-based content

Schema opportunities

You should be able to explain how you would adapt traditional SEO strategies for the changing search environment.

Social Media Content & Engagement

You will also support social media growth and content distribution across our brands.

Responsibilities include:

Developing content calendars

Creating social posts

Writing captions

Repurposing blog content into social content

Creating educational and engaging posts

Identifying timely content opportunities

Scheduling and publishing content

Monitoring engagement

Supporting responses and community interaction

Reviewing performance and adjusting strategy

We are not looking for someone who posts simply to maintain a posting schedule.

Social content should support brand authority, engagement, traffic, and growth.

What Success Looks Like

We care about outcomes, not just completed tasks.

Success in this role should contribute to:

More Page 1 keyword rankings

Improved rankings for high-value keywords

Increased qualified organic traffic

Increased non-branded search visibility

Increased leads, registrations, purchases, or conversions from organic traffic

Stronger topical authority

Better performance from existing content

Increased visibility in AI-generated search results

Improved social reach and engagement

Consistent identification of new growth opportunities

You should be comfortable reviewing performance and explaining:

What is working

What is not working

Why performance changed

What should be tested next

Required Experience

You should have demonstrated experience with:

SEO strategy and execution

Ahrefs and/or Semrush

Google Search Console

GA4

Keyword research

Search intent analysis

Competitive research

Long-form SEO content

Content optimization

Internal linking

Topic clustering

WordPress or similar CMS platforms

AI-assisted content workflows

Social media content creation

Performance reporting

Strongly Preferred

Experience with the following is highly valuable:

Healthcare SEO

Mental health SEO

YMYL content

Telehealth

Multi-location healthcare organizations

Professional education

Continuing education

Local SEO

GEO / AEO

AI-search optimization

Ideal Candidate

You will likely be a strong fit if you:

Can independently identify SEO opportunities

Are highly comfortable working inside Ahrefs and Search Console

Understand the difference between traffic and valuable traffic

Know how to prioritize keywords based on business value, not just search volume

Can improve existing content rather than constantly recommending new content

Can write and edit strong long-form content

Understand how SEO, content, AI search, and social distribution work together

Can operate independently without needing constant direction

Are comfortable being held accountable to measurable results

Who Will Not Be a Good Fit

This role is not a good fit if your primary strategy consists of:

Mass-producing AI articles

Keyword stuffing

Buying low-quality backlinks

Publishing content without search-intent research

Reporting traffic without understanding business outcomes

Creating generic social posts with no strategic purpose

Waiting for someone else to tell you exactly what to work on

We need someone who can recognize opportunities and take ownership of execution.

To Apply

Please provide:

A brief overview of your SEO experience.

Examples of websites where you materially improved organic performance.

Examples of keywords or pages you helped rank.

Screenshots or other supporting evidence from Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, or GA4.

Examples of long-form content you have written or managed.

Examples of social media content or accounts you have supported.

Your experience with GEO, AEO, AI Search, or Google AI Overviews.

Any healthcare, mental health, or YMYL experience.

Your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation for approximately 25 hours per week.

Application Assessment

Before applying, review:

Kentucky Counseling Center

Counseling Now

ESALetterOnline.co

Therapy Trainings

In your application, identify three specific organic-growth opportunities you see across the portfolio.

We are not asking for a comprehensive unpaid audit.

We are evaluating how you think, how specific you are, and whether you can identify opportunities without being handed a step-by-step task list.

Generic applications will not be considered.

title: Amazon PPC / Advertising Specialist
description:
Amazon PPC Specialist - Pax Distribution



We manage Amazon end-to-end for premium brands. You'd run the ad accounts day to day. Build the campaigns, read the data, kill what's not working, double down on what is.



This isn't a set-it-and-forget-it seat. We don't manage everything to one ACoS number and call it a day. Every campaign has a job, and the job d
 the metric. A rank-building campaign gets judged differently than a profitability one. If that made sense to you, keep reading. If it didn't, this isn't your role.



What you'd actually do





Build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display across several brands

Structure campaigns so our own products don't bid against each other



Own the negative keyword work. This is where most people get lazy and it's where accounts quietly leak money

Read Search Query Performance and Brand Analytics, and tell me which terms we can actually win and which we can't

Know when to stop spending, not just when to spend



You're a fit if



You think in terms of what a campaign is for, not just its ACoS

You'll tell me a keyword isn't worth it even when it looks good on paper

You get that sometimes the fix is the reviews or the listing, not more ad spend

You treat a budget as a ceiling, not a quota to hit



You're not a fit if



You manage everything to one blended ACoS target

You think more spend is always the answer

You need to be told what to do every day

You can't explain why you made a bid change

Your availability and current hourly rate

title: Medical Records QA + Patient Coordinator - US practice, long-term, $1,500/mo
description:
We are a small physician-owned pain management practice in New York. Most of our patients were injured in car a
, so their medical records go to insurance companies and to lawyers. If a document is missing from a patient's chart, the practice does not get paid for that visit - and there is a 45-day deadline.



Right now, things fall through. Notes get written and never filed. A patient's date of a
 is recorded one way in one place and another way somewhere else. Two different patients turn out to share a name and a birthday. Nobody notices until it is late.



Your job is to be the person who notices.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- Work through a daily list of chart errors and missing documents, and clear it

- Open patient charts in our EMR and verify what is actually in them - not what a report says is in them

- Chase what is missing: call the physical therapy office, call the patient, call the lawyer's paralegal

- Keep a written record of what you checked and what you found

- Escalate the small number of things only the doctor can d
, and never guess on those



YOU MUST HAVE

- Spoken English clear enough that a New York paralegal understands you the first time, on a cell phone

- Written English good enough to send a professional
 with nobody editing it

- Real comfort with computers - spreadsheets, web applications, PDFs, keyboard shortcuts. You should be the person your family calls

- Genuine attention to detail. This job is largely noticing that two things which should match, don't

- The confidence to phone a stranger and ask them for something

- The judgment to tell the difference between a mistake you can fix and a mistake you must escalate

- Reliable power and internet, and a quiet place to take calls



NICE TO HAVE

US medical records, medical billing, no-fault or workers' compensation experience, Tebra or Kareo. We will teach you the medical side. We cannot teach diligence.



HOURS AND PAY

40 hours a week, of which at least 5 must fall between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM New York time, because of the phone calls.

$1,500 per month, paid twice monthly, plus 13th month pay in December. Reviewed at six months.

This is long-term.



ABOUT THE DATA

This role handles US patient health information. You will be trained on HIPAA, you will sign a confidentiality agreement, and you will be given your own named logins. You will never be asked to share an account.



HOW TO APPLY - read this part carefully, it is the first test.



Start your application with these two lines, exactly, each on its own line:



CHART-2026

MANSHEET



Then answer these three, numbered, in this order:



1. Record yourself and send a link I can open without an account (Google Drive, Loom, anything). Read this out loud:



"Hi, this is [your name] calling from Northside Pain Medicine on behalf of Dr. Alvarez. I am following up on a patient we saw on August nineteenth. I need the claim number and the adjuster's name for the no-fault carrier. Is that something you can pull up now, or should I
 the request?"



Then, on the same recording, speak for about thirty seconds in your own words: tell me about a time you found a mistake that nobody had asked you to look for.



2. A patient's visit form says her a
 was on 05/19/2026. Her chart says 12/07/2025. Both are in front of you. What do you do? Answer in no more than four sentences.



3. If our workday starts at 9:00 AM in New York, what time is that where you are, today? Would your answer be the same in January? Explain in one sentence.



Applications that do not follow this format are not read. That is not a trick - it is the job.

title: Automation Engineer (Python) - US medical practice, long-term, $1,800-2,600/mo
description:
We are a small physician-owned pain management practice in New York. We run our own document pipeline: providers fill in patient visit forms, Python and Node scripts turn them into clinical notes, and browser automation files them into our EMR. It runs nightly on a Mac and in Google Cloud.



It mostly works. When it doesn't, it usually fails silently - a job reports success and the output is empty. Your job is to own that pipeline and make it honest.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- Maintain a Python and Node.js codebase plus six scheduled jobs on macOS launchd and Google Cloud Scheduler

- Read the nightly audit output every morning and work the exceptions

- Write a failing test for a defect before you fix it

- Improve the monitoring so that a job which ran but did not work is visible without a human noticing

- Occasionally join a call with the doctor and explain what broke, in plain English



YOU MUST HAVE

- Real Python. Not "I have used Python" - you can debug code you have never seen before, written by someone else

- Comfort in a terminal: git, cron or launchd, log files, ssh

- Enough JavaScript to maintain a Playwright or Puppeteer browser automation script

- The habit of checking that a thing worked, rather than that it ran

- Reliable power and internet, and a machine you can work on for eight hours



NICE TO HAVE

Google Cloud (Functions, Scheduler, Storage). PDF form tooling. Any exposure to US healthcare.



HOURS AND PAY

40 hours a week, of which 4 must overlap 9am-1pm New York time. The rest you schedule yourself.

$1,800-$2,600 per month depending on what you demonstrate, paid twice monthly, plus 13th month pay in December. Reviewed at six months.

This is long-term. We are not looking for project work and we are not looking for an agency.



ABOUT THE DATA

This role handles US patient health information. You will be trained on HIPAA, you will sign a confidentiality agreement, and you will be given your own named logins. You will never be asked to share an account or to use someone else's.



HOW TO APPLY - read this part carefully, it is the first test.



Start your application with these two lines, exactly, each on its own line:



PIPELINE-2026

LEDGER



Then answer these three, numbered, in this order:



1. A link to code you have written that I can read - GitHub, GitLab, a gist, anything. If you cannot share code, instead describe in five sentences the hardest bug you have ever found in someone else's code, and how you found it.



2. A script runs every night, exits with status 0, and writes an empty file. There is nothing in the logs. Name the three things you would check first, in order.



3. If our workday starts at 9:00 AM in New York, what time is that where you are, today? Would your answer be the same in January? Explain in one sentence.



Applications that do not follow this format are not read. That is not a trick - it is the job. Following an instruction exactly, every time, is most of this work.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Faceless Channel Storyteller
description:
Are you looking for an awesome job that's not only fun, challenging, and enjoyable, but also pays you more money the harder you work?



If so, then please read this job listing carefully. I have a fantastic job opportunity available for a YouTube Scriptwriter that can meet certain criteria.



And I have to state upfront, this job isn't for everyone. I'm looking for a very unique person to fill this job.



I'm looking for someone who would also enjoy contributing ideas and sharing their thoughts, while they do their job.



I'm basically looking for a talented, hard-working person who would like to become a valuable member of my team. And you can do this job completely from your home if you have a high-speed Internet connection and a computer.



Not only do we work on fun and challenging projects, but as my business grows so does everyone's SALARY! :)



I am putting together a small, tight-knit team, and the scriptwriter (that's you!) is a key seat on it. I'm looking for that special person who can become a superstar on my team. 



Someone hard-working, passionate, who would love their job and loves writing videos that evoke emotion and keep people watching to the very end. Someone who can help me take my YouTube channels to the next level.



Attention to detail, good work ethic, and a strong desire to excel in everything they do are just some of the qualities that can set you apart from the other candidates.



I am looking for an A-player, who can work full time, long term, and can commit and dedicate fully to ensure the success of the business.



Here's just some of the criteria that this person would meet:



Has their own computer and high-speed Internet connection

Speaks, Reads, and Writes excellent English

Can work from home without distractions

Is always learning and improving his/her skills

Has a Wise/PayPal account

Has access to the paid Claude plan ($20/month Claude Pro) — or is willing to get it before starting. Our entire scriptwriting system runs on it.

Is willing to learn new skills and can easily be trained in other skills

Can work full-time (30–40 hours per week)



HOW WE WORK — READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING:



We write with a specific system that mixes AI with your own skill. You will not be writing from a blank page, and you will not be pasting raw AI output either. I provide a defined scriptwriting system, a series of training videos, and clear instructions. You bring the judgment, the hooks, and the voice. If you think "AI writes it for me," this isn't the role. If you think "AI is a tool I drive," we'll get along.



TASKS YOU WILL TAKE CARE OF:



- Write engaging long-form scripts for faceless YouTube channels (different niches, from tech and science documentary to bird watching)

- Hook the viewer in the first 15–30 seconds and earn their attention into the video

- Hold attention across the whole video using open loops, STR (situation–tension–resolution), and curiosity gaps — opening tension early and paying it off later so the viewer can't leave

- Write in each channel's established voice rather than imposing your own

- Work with the AI to pull the facts and details the script needs

- Take a title and turn it into a finished, ready-to-record script

- Iterate on feedback until the voice is locked

- Meet script deadlines so the production pipeline never stalls

- Collaborate with me on content ideas and creative direction



You'll start on one channel first, then you'll write across others.



I will need you to work 6–8 hours per day, 40 hours per week. You can make your own hours.



SKILLS NEEDED FOR THIS JOB:



Proven long-form YouTube scriptwriting experience — REQUIRED

Deep understanding of viewer retention: hooks, open loops, STR, curiosity gaps — REQUIRED

Writing for spoken narration, not blog/article/SEO copy — REQUIRED

Very comfortable working with AI/LLM platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, and others) — you know how to prompt the AI to get exactly what you want out of it

Excellent written English and a strong storytelling instinct

Sharp attention to detail

Fast learner — you can pick up new tools quickly and put them to use right away

Understanding of YouTube as a platform — what makes people click and stay

Creative thinking and coming up with great hooks

Outside-the-box thinking

Ability to take initiative and self-accountability

Positive mindset

Good communication skills

Self-motivated and able to adhere to deadlines

Problem solver and able to get the job done without supervision

Willingness to go above and beyond the tasks they are given

A passion for constant self-improvement and a desire to over-deliver

Open-minded, willing to innovate and find better ways to do things



I'm not looking for just another writer, I'm looking for a teammate who will work side by side with me and help me grow my YouTube channels. 



This role starts as a scriptwriting seat, but for the right person it grows into a department manager / team lead position — running a small team of writers under you as we scale. You will have the opportunity to be promoted and achieve a higher position on my team, with a bigger salary, all while working from home.



PERFORMANCE-BASED COMPENSATION: 



Starting budget is around $500/month, and your salary will grow based on performance! The better our videos perform (views, engagement, revenue), the more money you earn. This means you're directly incentivized to write the best scripts possible.



There are also bonuses which will be awarded according to your performance.



The job is full time and it is an ongoing position, hopefully for as long as possible.



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, this is the part that matters:



Send me an
 with the subject line "YouTube Script Superstar" and let me know why you think you'd be great for this job. Please include the phrase 'Amber Lighthouse' in the first paragraph of your
 so I know you read this all the way through.



Also tell me: what channels have you written for, can you share a script sample or a video made from your script, and do you already have the paid Claude plan?



IMPORTANT: A simple test task will be given to further evaluate your skills. If you are not ok with that, please do not apply for this job. 



Thank you!



Sincerely,

Romy Banciu

title: Senior Java Developer (E-commerce)
description:
Summary:

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Java Developer to drive the development and optimization of our e-commerce platform. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in Java, microservices architecture, and performance tuning, along with the leadership skills to mentor a growing development team and steer complex projects to success.



Key Responsibilities

Application Design & Development



Architect, design, and develop high-performance, scalable Java-based e-commerce applications.

Implement microservices and event-driven architectures to ensure modular and resilient systems.

Performance Optimization & Scalability



Monitor, analyze, and optimize system performance, memory usage, and throughput.

Troubleshoot concurrency, threading, and performance bottlenecks using advanced profiling tools and techniques.

Technical Leadership



Mentor junior and mid-level developers, setting best practices in coding, testing, and deployment.

Drive architectural decisions and technology choices aligned with business needs and industry standards.

System Integration



Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, and services to enhance platform capabilities.

Implement caching solutions (e.g., Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) for efficient data handling.'



Quality Assurance & Testing



Champion test-driven development (TDD) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).

Write and maintain robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, and Mockito.

DevOps & Deployment



Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate builds, deployments, and monitoring (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).

Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and seamless scalability in production environments.

Security & Compliance



Enforce secure coding practices, including data encryption, OAuth/JWT-based authentication, and compliance with PCI-DSS/GDPR where applicable.

Continuously monitor and mitigate security vulnerabilities and threats.

Documentation & Collaboration



Produce clear, comprehensive technical documentation and architectural diagrams.

Work cross-functionally with product managers, QA, UX designers, and other engineers to deliver robust solutions within agile sprints.



Continuous Improvement



Stay current with emerging trends, tools, and technologies to evolve and enhance our software development lifecycle.

Propose and implement improvements to optimize code quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.



Note: Please send a link to your updated CV, no uploaded CV will not be entertained.



Qualifications:



5+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally on large-scale e-commerce or SaaS platforms.

Demonstrated success in building and deploying microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.

Technical Expertise



Java Proficiency: Strong command of Java 8+ features (Streams, Lambdas), concurrency, memory management, and JVM internals.

Frameworks & Libraries: Advanced experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA.

API & Integrations: Experience creating RESTful APIs, integrating third-party services, and working with GraphQL (preferred).

Database Systems: Hands-on experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB; adept at writing complex queries and optimizing database performance.

Messaging & Caching: Practical knowledge of message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka) and caching systems (Redis, Memcached).

Build & CI/CD: Proficiency in Maven/Gradle, Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, Docker, and Kubernetes for seamless development and deployment.

Testing: Expertise in TDD, unit testing, integration testing, and test automation frameworks like JUnit, TestNG, and Mockito.

Performance Monitoring & Profiling: Familiarity with tools like VisualVM, YourKit, or New Relic for troubleshooting and tuning.

Soft Skills



Leadership: Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and influence technical direction.

Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively with product owners, designers, and cross-functional teams.

Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment, reacting quickly to changing requirements.

Problem-Solving: Proven analytical mindset and a pragmatic approach to solving complex challenges.



***Very important: Do take note that the applicant is required to share their updated CV with appropriate access. Applicants who are non compliant with this will be automatically ignored.***
