title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT – LEAD CALLING, SALES, SOCIAL MEDIA & VIDEO EDITING
description:
FULL-TIME VIRTUAL ASSISTANT – SALES & APPOINTMENT SETTER



### Remote Position | Philippines | Australian Company



**Full-Time | 40 Hours per Week | Sydney, Australia Working Hours**



# IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING



**WE WILL ONLY CONSIDER APPLICANTS WHO READ THIS JOB POST CAREFULLY AND FOLLOW ALL APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS.**



Applications that are incomplete or do not include ALL the requested information will **not be reviewed**.



To be considered, your application MUST include:



1. **Your CV / Resume**

2. **Your clickable WhatsApp link** so our team can contact you directly

3. **A 1–3 minute video introducing yourself in English**

4. A short summary of your **main skills and previous experience**

5. A short explanation of **why you believe you are a good fit for this position**

6. Confirmation that you are available to work **Sydney, Australia hours**

7. Confirmation that you have a **reliable computer, professional headset, stable internet and quiet workspace**



**The English introduction video is MANDATORY.**



Applications without the video introduction or without the requested information will **not be considered**.



---



# About Us



We are a growing Australian skin and aesthetic clinic based in **Sydney, Australia**, looking for a motivated, energetic, professional and results-driven **Virtual Assistant / Sales & Appointment Setter** to join our team full-time.



This is a **sales and communication-focused position**.



Your primary responsibility will be speaking with potential clients, following up with leads and converting enquiries into booked consultations.



If you enjoy talking to people, building relationships, following up with leads, achieving targets and working in a structured environment, this could be a great long-term opportunity.



---



# Salary + Commission



### Base Salary



**AUD $220 per week**



Approximately:



**USD $158–160 per week**



**PHP ₱9,000–₱9,500 per week**



*USD and PHP amounts are approximate and may vary depending on exchange rates.*



### PLUS COMMISSION



In addition to your guaranteed base salary, you will receive:



**Commission for successfully scheduled consultations/appointments.**



The more qualified appointments you successfully schedule, the greater your earning potential.



This means your total earnings are **not limited to your base salary**.



High-performing team members may also receive:



* Increased commission opportunities

* Performance incentives

* Salary reviews

* Additional responsibilities

* Professional development

* Opportunities for promotion

* Long-term career progression within the company



We are looking for someone who wants to **grow with the company**, not someone looking for a temporary position.



Performance, reliability, consistency and results are recognised and rewarded.



---



# Your Main Responsibilities



Your primary responsibilities will include:



* Calling new leads

* Making **inbound and outbound calls**

* Following up with potential clients

* Contacting leads through phone, WhatsApp, SMS and other messaging platforms

* Responding quickly to new enquiries

* Re-engaging leads who have stopped responding

* Building rapport and trust with potential clients

* Booking consultations and appointments

* Keeping clients engaged until they are successfully scheduled

* Following up consistently with leads

* Helping fill last-minute appointment cancellations

* Answering reception calls when required

* Updating our CRM accurately

* Maintaining an organised lead pipeline

* Updating spreadsheets and client information

* Completing administrative tasks

* Preparing daily reports

* Following company procedures and scripts

* Working closely with our management team



This is a **fast-paced role where communication, organisation, speed and consistency are essential.**



You must be comfortable spending a significant part of your working day **speaking with potential clients over the phone**.



---



# Requirements



We are looking for someone who:



* Speaks **fluent or near-fluent English**

* Has a clear, confident and professional speaking voice

* Has excellent telephone communication skills

* Is confident making outbound calls

* Is comfortable speaking with potential clients

* Has a strong sales mindset

* Can communicate naturally without sounding like they are reading from a script

* Has previous experience in **Sales, Appointment Setting, Customer Service, Reception, Lead Generation, Telemarketing or Call Centres**

* Is organised and detail-oriented

* Learns quickly

* Follows instructions and procedures carefully

* Can work independently while remaining accountable

* Is comfortable working towards targets and KPIs

* Has strong computer skills

* Can learn new software quickly

* Has a stable internet connection

* Has a reliable computer

* Has a professional headset with clear microphone quality

* Has a quiet and professional workspace

* Is reliable and punctual

* Is open to feedback and coaching



Experience using CRM and booking systems is highly desirable.



---



# Working Hours



This is a **full-time, 40-hour-per-week position**.



You will work according to **Sydney, Australia time**, not Philippine business hours.



Applicants must therefore be comfortable adjusting their schedule to Australian working hours.



Some flexibility may also be required for:



* Weekend shifts

* Evening coverage

* Urgent lead follow-ups

* Contacting leads during high-response periods



Your exact weekly schedule will be discussed during the recruitment process.



---



# Work Tracking



We use **Hubstaff** or similar productivity and time-tracking software.



The software must be installed on your work computer.



During your contracted working hours, you are expected to:



* Clock in at the beginning of your shift

* Clock out during breaks

* Clock back in after your break

* Remain available and responsive during working hours

* Work exclusively on company-related tasks while clocked in



You cannot perform work for another company or unrelated personal work while being paid and clocked into our system.



Reliability, productivity and accountability are important parts of this position.



---



# Equipment & Working Environment



Because this position involves frequent calls with clients, **professional audio quality is essential**.



You must have:



* Reliable computer

* Professional-quality headset

* Clear microphone

* Fast and stable internet

* Reliable electricity

* Quiet and private workspace

* Minimal background noise



There should be no significant background noise from television, conversations, children, pets, traffic or other distractions during client calls.



Your communication represents our company, so call quality and professionalism are extremely important.



---



# Bonus Skills – Not Required



Additional skills that will be highly valued include:



* Basic video editing

* Canva

* Social media management

* Instagram

*

* TikTok

* Reels and Stories editing

* Content scheduling

* Graphic design

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Excel

* CRM management

* Administrative experience

* Experience working with beauty, aesthetic, skin, medical, dental or wellness businesses



These skills are **not mandatory**, but please mention them in your application if you have them.



---



# We Are Looking for Someone Who Is



* Positive

* Friendly

* Professional

* Confident

* Comfortable on the phone

* Sales-driven

* Self-motivated

* Honest

* Reliable

* Punctual

* Organised

* Coachable

* Results-driven

* Detail-oriented

* Consistent

* Interested in learning

* Interested in professional growth



Most importantly, we want someone who **takes ownership of their responsibilities and wants to build a long-term career with the company.**



---



# Career Growth



This position has **real opportunities for professional and financial growth**.



We invest in training, coaching and professional development.



As you demonstrate strong performance, reliability, excellent communication and consistent results, there may be opportunities for:



* Higher commissions

* Salary reviews

* Performance bonuses

* Additional responsibilities

* Senior positions

* Team leadership opportunities

* Professional development

* Long-term career progression



We want our strongest team members to **grow as the company grows**.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



**Please read carefully.**



Send ALL of the following:



**1. CV / Resume**



**2. Clickable WhatsApp link**



Please provide a direct clickable WhatsApp link so our recruitment team can contact you easily.



**3. 1–3 Minute Video Introduction in English**



In your video, please:



* Introduce yourself

* Tell us about your previous work experience

* Tell us about your sales or customer-service experience

* Explain why you believe you would be good at speaking with leads and booking appointments



**This video is mandatory because communication and spoken English are essential parts of this role.**



**4. Your Key Skills**



Provide a short list of your strongest professional skills.



**5. Why Should We Hire You?**

title: Long-term faceless YouTube editor — Gaming breakdowns (multiple hires) — LONG-TERM Positions
description:
Needs to hire 2 Freelancers

Summary

Long-term faceless YouTube editor — cinematic gaming breakdowns (multiple hires) — Please only apply for long-term work 



Compensation



This is a per-video position with real room to grow. We're starting with modest trial rates while we learn each other's workflow; strong, reliable editors get raises, performance bonuses, and steady volume as we scale.



Starting rates (trial / first-video, then they grow):



5–12 minutes: $12 per video

13 minutes: $13 per video

14 minutes: $14 per video

15–19 minutes: $15 per video

20–25 minutes: $20 per video

26–30 minutes: $25 per video

31–35 minutes: $30 per video — and so on



Reliable turnaround is highly valued and rewarded with bonuses and more work. As soon as we get monetized, the rates change — our policy is simple: if we grow, you grow with us.



Expected workload



We publish on a consistent schedule, so we're looking for someone who can reliably deliver 4–8+ videos per month and scale up as we grow. Speed matters — but never at the cost of retention or quality.



About us



We run a faceless YouTube channel doing cinematic, investigative breakdowns of a huge open-world game universe — "everything we actually know," "how [topic] really works," and the real story behind the hype. Think measured, evidence-first, a little noir — but with real energy where it counts. Every video is opened on screen: confirmed facts stamped and sourced, rumors clearly labeled as rumors (we provide those in the script). The look is one consistent, high-end template — dark neon-noir, clean motion graphics — reused across every video so the brand stays instantly recognizable.



The retention comes from a mix of two speeds: deliberate, cinematic reveals and push-ins that let big moments land — and fast, punchy, high-energy sequences (rapid cuts, quick on-screen text, fast graphics reveals) where the script builds momentum. We need an editor who can do both and knows which the moment calls for.



This is not basic cut-and-trim editing



We need an editor who can turn a script + voice-over into a polished, high-retention breakdown: original maps and diagrams, on-screen stamps and callouts, source lower-thirds, deliberate push-ins and rack focus, restrained texture (subtle grain/vignette), and clean sound design. If you only "cut clips and put talking over them," this isn't the role.



What we provide for every video:

1. A complete, timestamped script (scene-by-scene)

2. A voice-over recording (real human VO)

3. A locked channel style template / style guide so the look stays consistent

4. Scene direction + creative feedback



Your responsibilities:

1. Edit cinematic, high-retention gaming breakdowns (typically 12–25 minutes) to our locked template

2. Build original graphics — maps, region diagrams, timelines, "confirmed vs. rumored" stamp cards, source lower-thirds, chapter cards (NOT just clips with a voice over them)

3. Source relevant b-roll, images, and short official clips — used transformatively, with commentary/analysis over them

4. Add deliberate motion — push-ins, parallax on layered cards, rack focus, clean transitions and on-screen text that matches our neon-noir look

5. Design restrained sound — licensed music + SFX, and protect the two hard-silence beats the scene direction calls out (we use silence on purpose)

6. Keep every video 100% monetization-safe. This is the single most important part of the job in this niche:

Absolutely no leaked or datamined footage — ever. Rumored details get rebuilt as original graphics, never shown as stolen clips. Transformative use only — short clips with real commentary, never long re-uploads of anyone's video. 

7. Properly licensed music/SFX only (we use Epidemic Sound).

8. You understand what triggers a copyright claim or a "reused content" strike, and you actively build to avoid it. Protecting the channel's monetization is part of the job.

9. Follow the pacing, tone, and style of our reference videos and template

10. Deliver on schedule — turnaround matters

11. Revise based on time-stamped feedback (we review on 
, free)



Requirements



1. Strong experience editing YouTube videos — ideally gaming, documentary, or long-form breakdown content

2. Excellent pacing and retention instincts — comfortable with both deliberate cinematic pacing and fast, punchy, high-energy cutting within the same video

3. Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or similar

Ability to independently source visuals and build clean original motion graphics, maps, and text — not just place clips

4. A clear, specific understanding of copyright and YouTube monetization safety — you know exactly what gets a channel claimed or demonetized, and how to avoid it

5. Fast, reliable turnaround and communication

6. Good English comprehension

7. Familiarity with gaming culture (especially open-world / GTA-style games) is a big plus

8. Willingness to use 
 (free) for reviews and revisions



Preferred experience:

Experience editing videos similar in build quality and pacing to:



No Fast Travel

RENZI

Eufalla

That GTA Gamer (TGG)

gameranx / Spawn Wave (for gaming fluency)



We blend cinematic/investigative pacing with fast, high-energy sequences — No Fast Travel and RENZI are the closest match for the overall build, but you should also be comfortable with the punchy, fast-paced style of gameranx/TGG where the script calls for it.



⚠️ Application instructions (read carefully)



To confirm you've read this entire posting:



Include the word VICE as the second line of your application.

Record a short 30–60 second Loom video introducing yourself and why you're a good fit.

Answer all application questions below.

Do not apply if you aren't willing to complete a short free 30–60 second trial edit (materials sent only to shortlisted applicants).



Applications that don't follow these instructions will be automatically rejected.



Application questions

1. Send links to your 3 best YouTube videos that you personally edited — ideally gaming, documentary, or long-form breakdown content — and explain your exact role in each.



2. Which editing software do you use? Are you willing to use 
 (free) for our review process?



3. How many years of YouTube editing experience do you have?



4. Have you edited gaming, documentary, or news/commentary channels before? Share examples.



5. If we provide only a script and voice-over, can you source all footage and build the maps, diagrams, and graphics yourself? Walk us through your exact process.



6. What sources do you use for footage, images, music, and sound effects — and specifically, how do you make sure everything is safe for YouTube monetization (no copyright claims, no reused-content issues, no leaked footage)? Be specific.



7. How fast can you realistically turn around a 15-minute video?



8. How many videos can you realistically edit per week and month?



9. How many hours per week are you available, and what hours overlap with GMT+3?



Final selection

Shortlisted applicants complete a 30–60-second sample edit using a script, voice-over, and reference video we provide, so we can judge pacing, sourcing, original graphics, sound design, retention, and attention to detail. Please don't apply if you're unwilling to complete it. Only shortlisted candidates receive the test materials.



Long-term opportunity



We're building out a growing channel — and more channels behind it — and want reliable editors to grow with us. Strong performers earn higher rates, bonuses, more projects, and the chance to work across multiple channels.



If you love gaming and can make cinematic videos people can't stop watching, we'd love to hear from you!

description:

Creativity comes first.



We are not looking for someone who needs to be handed a completed design and told exactly where every element goes. We need someone who can think through the design, create the visual direction, and build it in WordPress/Elementor.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Modern, high-end website design

- Creative layouts and section concepts

- Typography and visual hierarchy

- Brand consistency

- Imagery and visual storytelling

- Conversion-focused design

- Creative use of backgrounds, graphics, and visual elements

- Clean spacing and composition

- Exceptional mobile website design

- WordPress

You should understand mobile layouts, typography, spacing, navigation, CTA placement, usability, and conversion flow.



SEO SOPs

Ghost Engine Digital will provide the SEO strategy and SOPs. Your responsibility is to follow them accurately while designing and building the website.



This includes:

- Proper heading structure

- URL preservation

- Internal linking requirements

- Metadata implementation

- Rank Math

- Image optimization and alt text

- Redirect requirements

- Crawlability and indexation

- Core Web Vitals



YOU’RE A GOOD FIT IF:



- You are creative before you are technical

- You are extremely detail-oriented

- You care about mobile design as much as desktop

PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

BONUS EXPERIENCE



Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, custom graphics, animation, ACF, WooCommerce, GoHighLevel, accessibility/WCAG, local SEO, and experience designing websites for service businesses are all a plus.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term part of Ghost Engine Digital’s website production team.

We provide the brand, objectives, content, SEO direction, and processes.

You bring the creative vision and turn it into an exceptional website.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



You should be able to turn around a figma design in 24 Hours of a homepage/hero section for sales purposes.

title: Creative Strategist – E-commerce & Performance Ads
description:
Creative Strategist – E-commerce & Performance Ads



We are looking for a **Creative Strategist** who can take real ownership of the creative strategy behind our e-commerce brands.



This is **not just a video editing position**.



We need someone who understands WHY an ad works, can research markets and competitors, discover new angles, and translate those insights into strong **Top of Funnel (TOF), Middle of Funnel (MOF), and Bottom of Funnel (BOF)** creatives.



Our goal is simple: **develop winning creatives that allow us to scale our products profitably while achieving the highest possible ROAS.**



## What You’ll Be Doing



You will help develop and continuously improve our overall creative strategy.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Conducting competitor and market research

* Researching winning ads using Meta Ad Library and other sources

* Analyzing customer reviews, comments, feedback and competitor messaging

* Identifying customer pain points, desires, objections and buying triggers

* Understanding different customer awareness levels

* Developing new hooks, angles and advertising concepts

* Building clear TOF, MOF and BOF creative strategies

* Writing scripts and detailed creative briefs

* Analyzing existing ad performance

* Identifying winning creatives and developing new iterations

* Testing new creative formats

* Working with editors and other creatives to turn concepts into finished ads



**Top of Funnel is especially important to us.**



We want to continuously find new ways to reach people who have never heard of our brand or product before.



That means creating ads that first make people aware of a problem, capture their attention, and introduce our product as the solution.



## The Type of Products We Sell



We primarily work with e-commerce products that solve a clear problem.



For example, one of our products focuses on protecting people against **pickpocketing and theft while travelling, visiting cities or being in crowded public places.**



Because of this, we need someone who thinks beyond:



“Let's make a nice product video.”



We want you to think about questions such as:



**Why does someone actually need this product?**



**What problems does our target audience experience?**



**Which problems might they not even be aware of yet?**



**What hook will stop someone from scrolling?**



**Which angles can introduce the problem to a completely cold audience?**



**What objections prevent someone from purchasing?**



**Which creatives do we need for TOF, MOF and BOF?**



And most importantly:



**What should we test next to improve performance and increase ROAS?**



## AI Is a Big Part of Our Creative Workflow



We use AI heavily throughout our creative process.



You should therefore be comfortable working with tools such as:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Higgsfield

* Other AI video and image generation tools



We don't expect everything to be produced traditionally.



We actually want someone who understands how to use AI to **rapidly develop and test new concepts, hooks, scripts, visuals and creative formats.**



Examples of creatives we want to produce include:



* AI-generated video ads

* UGC ads

* AI UGC

* Mashup ads

* Problem/solution ads

* Storytelling ads

* Educational ads

* Founder-style ads

* VSL-style creatives

* Static ads

* Product demonstrations

* Testimonial/review ads

* Competitor-inspired concepts

* Awareness-focused creatives



We don't want to produce the same three formats every week.



You should constantly be looking for **new formats, new angles and new ways to communicate the problem and solution.**



## Who We're Looking For



You could be a great fit if you:



* Have experience as a Creative Strategist in e-commerce/performance marketing

* Understand Meta Ads and direct-response creative

* Fully understand TOF, MOF and BOF

* Are strong at competitor and market research

* Understand customer psychology and awareness levels

* Can independently develop new hooks and angles

* Can analyze performance data and turn it into new creative decisions

* Are comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude and AI creative tools

* Have experience with AI-generated creatives and/or UGC

* Are proactive and constantly bring new ideas to the table



Most importantly, **we are NOT looking for someone who waits for us to tell them exactly what to create every week.**



We want someone who independently researches the market, identifies opportunities and can come to us saying:



**“This is what we should test next, this is the angle, this is the format, and this is why I believe it can work.”**



## What Matters Most to Us



Your way of thinking is more important than simply making beautiful creatives.



We are looking for someone who can combine:



**Creative thinking + Data + Customer psychology + Performance marketing**



Your goal isn't to create the prettiest advertisement.



Your goal is to **find winning ads that we can scale.**



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with e-commerce/performance creatives

3. Examples of ads you've developed or worked on

4. The AI tools you currently use

5. An example of a creative strategy you've previously worked on



**And one important question:**



Imagine you're selling an anti-theft crossbody bag designed to protect travellers against pickpockets.



**What are the first 3 Top of Funnel angles you would test — and why?**



We're much more interested in how you think than in receiving a generic application.



Applications that don't answer this question will not be considered.

title: Senior YouTube Editor (Talking Head Hooks + Screenshare), Long-Term, 3 Videos/Week
description:
About the role



I run a growing YouTube channel in the online business / education space and need one editor, long term, for 3 long-form videos per week (10 to 25 minutes each).



The reference for the standard is this channel: 



Watch three of those videos before applying. If that style is not something you can already produce, please do not apply.



What the edit actually looks like



Each video has two parts:



The hook (first 2 to 4 minutes): talking head with heavy, polished editing. Animated text and callouts, b-roll, zooms and punch-ins, sound design, motion graphics, fast pacing without feeling chaotic. This section is where most of your effort goes and it has to look like the reference channel.



The body (the rest): screenshare with light editing. Tight cuts to remove dead air and rambling, cursor zooms where useful, occasional text callouts, clean audio. Fast to produce, but still clean.



You will also create the thumbnail for each video (or work with our thumbnail designer if that's not your strength; tell me which in your application).



Volume and turnaround



3 videos per week, delivered on a fixed weekly schedule

48-hour turnaround from raw footage to first cut

One round of revisions per video



Pay



$900 to $1,200USD per month on a full-time retainer, depending on skill and whether you handle thumbnails



Paid weekly, on time, every time



Requirements



2+ years editing YouTube long-form in this niche (business, finance, marketing, self-improvement education)

Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects for the hook graphics

Strong understanding of retention editing: why cuts, zooms and text go where they go, not just that they look nice

Fluent English, available on
 or Slack during UK working hours for at least a few hours overlap

Stable internet and a machine that can handle 4K timelines



How to apply



Answer these in your application. Applications that skip any of them will not be read.



Link 2 or 3 long-form videos you edited in this exact style, and name the channel for each.

Link 3 thumbnails you designed (or say "editing only").

Which YouTuber's editing do you study, and what is one specific technique you have copied from them?

Your monthly rate for 3 videos per week, with and without thumbnails.

Put the word "retention" at the start of your application so I know you read this.

title: Operations Virtual Assistant – E-commerce & Ticketing
description:
FULL-TIME OPERATIONS VA – E-COMMERCE & TICKETING

LONG-TERM GROWTH ROLE WITH MANAGEMENT OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a smart, organised and reliable Operations Virtual Assistant to join our growing ticketing and e-commerce businesses.



This is a full-time, long-term position.



I am not looking for somebody who just wants a temporary VA job. I want to find somebody I can train, trust and grow with the businesses over the long term.



Our ticketing business is something we want to scale significantly over the coming months and years. As the company grows, I intend to hire additional Virtual Assistants, and the right person will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility, increase their salary and eventually progress into an Operations Manager / VA Manager position.



You do NOT need previous experience in ticketing or Amazon FBA.



I can teach you the industry-specific parts.



What matters much more is that you are intelligent, extremely comfortable using a computer, organised, good with customers, good with spreadsheets and able to learn quickly.





--------------------

TICKETING OPERATIONS

--------------------



You will gradually help oversee the day-to-day administration and operation of our ticketing business.



Responsibilities will include:



- Reviewing our ticket inventory spreadsheets and making sure all information is accurate

- Checking that sold tickets have been transferred correctly by other members of our team

- Identifying tickets that still require action

- Informing and following up with our other Virtual Assistants when work needs completing

- Monitoring payments and refunds

- Matching payments and refunds against our records

- Identifying missing payments or refunds

- Investigating discrepancies when figures do not match

- Following up and chasing outstanding payments where required

- Creating invoices for ticket purchases and sales

- Saving and organising invoices from suppliers and ticketing platforms

- Keeping clear records explaining transactions

- Calculating profit splits with partners

- Confirming that payments have been received

- Preparing clear information showing me which payments need to be made

- Monitoring selected ticketing 
 communities for useful information and upcoming events

- Alerting and reminding me about important ticket releases and good opportunities

- Auditing the inventory shown on our website and correcting it when necessary

- General ticketing administration and problem solving



We already have other VAs who handle some of the repetitive ticket purchasing and transferring work.



Your role will increasingly be to oversee the process and make sure everything is accurate, organised and completed properly.





--------------------

CUSTOMER SERVICE & TICKET SALES

--------------------



An important part of this role will be communicating professionally with customers.



We operate a ticketing website and Instagram account.



You will help with:



- Responding quickly and professionally to Instagram enquiries

- Answering ticket availability and pricing questions

- Helping convert enquiries into sales

- Checking our existing ticket inventory

- Sourcing tickets through the suppliers and marketplaces we provide

- Identifying opportunities where we can fulfil a customer order profitably

- Asking me for approval initially when required

- Gradually learning which sales can be completed without needing to ask me

- Handling customer questions after purchase

- Helping resolve ticket delivery problems or complaints

- Advertising available ticket stock

- Creating ticket advertisements and social media posts

- Using ChatGPT and prompts we provide to help create content

- Making sure the inventory displayed on our website remains accurate



For example:



If a customer wants to buy a ticket from us and we can source that ticket elsewhere for a lower price, your job may be to identify the opportunity, communicate professionally with the customer, confirm the deal with me initially and help complete the sale.



As you gain experience, you will be given more independence.



Good written English, customer service skills and professional communication are very important for this part of the role.





--------------------

AMAZON FBA

--------------------



We also operate an Amazon FBA business.



Previous Amazon experience is NOT required.



I will personally teach you our buying process and what makes a good product for us.



You will gradually learn how to:



- Review Amazon buying opportunities

- Use SellerAmp SAS

- Understand basic Keepa information

- Place suitable products into a pending buying queue for my approval

- Alert me when a product looks especially strong

- Purchase approved stock

- Record all purchases accurately

- Save supplier invoices

- Maintain our purchasing spreadsheets

- Enter Cost of Goods into our inventory software

- Monitor stock levels

- Check that purchased stock has been received

- Check that stock sent to Amazon has arrived correctly

- Monitor returns and refunds

- Identify missing stock

- Identify discrepancies

- Raise issues initially and eventually help investigate and resolve them independently

- Make sure what we buy, receive, send, return and refund is properly accounted for



You will NOT be required to source Amazon products yourself.



We already have systems for providing buying opportunities.



Your responsibility will be to help analyse, purchase, record and monitor them correctly.





--------------------

ACCOUNTS, INVOICES & RECORD KEEPING

--------------------



Another important part of this role is helping keep our business records organised for accounting purposes.



You do NOT need to be a qualified accountant.



The goal is simply to make sure transactions are properly recorded, explained and supported with the correct documentation.



For example:



If we purchase football tickets from a private supplier through a bank transfer, you may need to create an invoice or transaction record explaining what was purchased.



If we purchase proxies, software or another business service, you would save the invoice and clearly record what the expense was for.



Tasks may include:



- Downloading invoices

- Generating invoices where required

- Organising invoices into the correct folders

- Matching invoices to transactions

- Recording what business expenses were for

- Updating spreadsheets

- Reviewing bank transaction reports

- Helping reconcile incoming and outgoing payments

- Identifying payments that do not match our records

- Preparing organised information for our accountant



The objective is simple:



Every important transaction should have a clear explanation and supporting documentation so that we never look at a transaction months later and wonder what it was for.





--------------------

WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR

--------------------



You should be:



- Extremely comfortable using a computer

- Experienced with Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel

- Comfortable working with multiple websites, browser tabs and systems

- Very organised

- Detail-oriented

- Able to notice when information or numbers do not match

- Able to investigate problems instead of ignoring them

- Reliable

- Able to communicate professionally in written English

- Confident communicating with customers

- Able to learn new software quickly

- Comfortable asking questions when you are unsure

- Able to work independently after training

- Proactive

- Interested in staying with one company long-term



Being genuinely good with computers is extremely important.



I have previously worked with VAs who struggled with basic computer navigation, and this role would not be suitable for somebody like that.



You should feel completely comfortable:



- Navigating websites

- Using Google Drive

- Using spreadsheets

- Downloading and organising files

- Working across multiple browser tabs

- Learning new software

- Following online processes

- Troubleshooting basic problems yourself





--------------------

BONUS EXPERIENCE

--------------------



The following experience is useful but NOT required:



- Customer service

- Sales

- E-commerce

- Amazon FBA

- Amazon Seller Central

- SellerAmp SAS

- Keepa

- Ticketing

- Bookkeeping

- Administration

- 

- Instagram

- Social media management

- ChatGPT

- AI tools

- AI automation

- Claude

- Claude Code

- Coding



Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT is a big advantage.



Experience with Claude Code, coding or AI automation would definitely get my attention, but it is absolutely not required.





--------------------

WORKING HOURS

--------------------



This is a FULL-TIME position.



Approximately 40 hours per week.



Monday-Friday is preferred, although I am flexible regarding the exact working schedule and can discuss this with the successful applicant.



We will communicate regularly through WhatsApp and/or Microsoft Teams.



At the beginning of the role, we will have several calls where I will personally show you our systems, explain how our businesses operate and train you.



I am friendly, approachable and happy to explain things properly.



I do not expect somebody to understand our businesses immediately.



Once you are trained, most day-to-day communication will be through messages, with calls whenever useful.





--------------------

CAREER PROGRESSION

--------------------



This is one of the most important parts of this position.



I am looking for somebody who wants to grow with the company.



One of the main reasons I am making this hire is to free up my own time so that I can focus more heavily on growing our ticketing business.



If we grow as planned, we will need additional employees and Virtual Assistants.



My intention is for the person hired into this role to gradually progress through something like:



Operations VA

→ Senior Operations VA

→ Operations Manager / VA Manager



Eventually, your responsibilities could include:



- Managing other Virtual Assistants

- Assigning their work

- Checking their work

- Following up when tasks have not been completed

- Training new members of the team

- Improving our systems and processes

- Managing more of the company's daily operations

- Reporting important information directly to me



As your responsibility and contribution to the business increases, your salary and position will increase accordingly.



I am looking for somebody I can build a strong professional relationship with, trust and work with for many years.





--------------------

SALARY

--------------------



STARTING SALARY: $400 USD PER MONTH



This is the starting salary while you learn our businesses, systems and processes.



There will be opportunities for salary reviews and increases as you become trained, take on additional responsibility and provide more value to the company.



Someone who eventually progresses into a management position and becomes responsible for managing other VAs would obviously be compensated at a significantly different level.





--------------------

HOW TO APPLY

--------------------



Please answer ALL of the questions below:



1. Tell me about your previous work experience.



2. What customer service experience do you have?



3. How would you rate your Google Sheets / Excel ability from 1-10?



Please explain what you have previously used spreadsheets for.



4. Tell me about a situation where you noticed a mistake, discrepancy or problem at work.



What did you do about it?



5. What does being "good with computers" mean to you?



Please give examples of software, websites or systems you have used regularly.



6. Have you previously worked in e-commerce?



If yes, please explain.



7. Have you ever used any of the following?



Amazon Seller Central

SellerAmp SAS

Keepa



Experience is NOT required, so please answer honestly.



8. Do you currently use AI tools such as ChatGPT?



If yes, explain how you use them.



9. Have you ever used Claude, Claude Code, coding tools or any other AI tools?



Again, this is only a bonus.



10. Are you comfortable communicating with customers and helping convert enquiries into sales?



Please tell me about any relevant experience.



11. Are you looking for a temporary VA position, or are you interested in staying somewhere for several years and potentially progressing into management?



12. What monthly salary are you looking for?



13. What are your normal available working hours and timezone?



14. Why do you think you would be a good fit for this particular position?





IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION:



Please start your application with the word:



GROW



Applications that do not begin with GROW will not be considered.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
description:
DTiQ is looking for a hands-on Lead Full Stack Engineer to join our Drive-Thru engineering team in Melbourne.

Our Drive-Thru platform provides quick-service restaurant operators across the globe with real-time speed-of-service information and operational insights. The technology spans Angular applications, Java services, containers, Linux-based edge devices, IoT messaging, computer vision and cloud-connected systems.

This role goes beyond typical web development. It would suit a senior engineer who enjoys hands-on software development, solving complex technical problems and helping other engineers make sound technical decisions.

You will work across the full product stack, from user interfaces and backend services through to Linux devices, messaging and network communications.

What you will do

• Design and develop front-end applications using Angular and TypeScript.

• Build backend services, APIs and integrations using Java and Spring Boot.

• Develop and maintain software running on Linux-based edge devices.

• Implement communication between devices, applications and services using MQTT, REST APIs and event-driven patterns.

• Build, deploy and troubleshoot containerised applications using Docker.

• Investigate and resolve complex issues across applications, Linux systems, devices, messaging and networks.

• Lead the technical design and delivery of major product improvements.

• Review code and designs, mentor engineers and improve engineering practices.

• Improve system reliability, diagnostics, deployment and failure recovery.

• Work closely with Product, QA, Computer Vision, Support and Infrastructure teams.

What you will bring

Core requirements

• Strong commercial experience across front-end and backend software development.

• Strong experience with modern Angular, preferably Angular 17 or later.

• Strong TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS skills.

• Experience with standalone components, signals, reactive programming and state management.

• Strong commercial experience with Java and Spring Boot.

• Experience designing maintainable backend services, REST APIs, asynchronous processing and application integrations.

• Strong practical Linux skills, including shell scripting.

• Experience with Docker and containerised applications.

• Experience with MQTT or comparable messaging technologies.

• Sound networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ports, routing and firewalls.

• Experience working with distributed systems, edge devices or intermittently connected environments.

• Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

• Experience with Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable experience

Experience in any of the following would be valuable:

• IoT or edge-computing platforms.

• Strong systems thinking.

• Virtual machines and virtualisation.

• Computer vision.

• Hardware or peripheral-device integration.

• Retail, hospitality or quick-service restaurant technology.

• AWS and hybrid edge-to-cloud environments.

• Monitoring, observability or configuration-management tools.

Why join DTiQ

• Work on a globally deployed product operating in real customer environments.

• Take ownership across applications, services and edge devices.

• Influence the technical direction and modernisation of the Drive-Thru platform.

• Solve engineering problems that extend beyond conventional web development.

• Work directly with the Head of Engineering and contribute to key technical decisions.

• Remain hands-on while growing your influence as a technical leader.

About you

You are a senior engineer who enjoys building software, solving difficult technical problems and helping other engineers produce strong outcomes.

You communicate clearly, take ownership and make sound technical decisions without adding unnecessary complexity.

HOW TO APPLY

title: Clinical Reviewer

mbers operate as extensions of provider offices, supporting clinical staff through accurate documentation, clinical review, and consistent follow-up to help patients access therapy faster.

title: Inbound Sales & Customer Care Representative With Excellent English
description:
Inbound Sales & Customer Care Representative With Excellent English



U.S. Home Services / Septic Company | Remote Contractor Role



Company Open Water Septic Tank Services LLC — family-owned septic service company in Georgia, USA

Role Type Full-time independent contractor, phone-first customer care and inbound appointment booking

Schedule Monday-Friday, 7:00 AM-5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time; Philippine time varies with U.S. daylight saving time

Compensation USD $700 - $900/month base, plus performance bonus potential $50 - $100 bonus 

Target Start As soon as the right candidate is selected



About Us

Open Water Septic is a growing family-owned septic service company based in Georgia, USA. We help homeowners and businesses with septic tank pumping, septic backups, inspections, hydrojetting, sewer camera inspections, and related service needs.



We are looking for a long-term remote team member in the Philippines who can answer inbound customer calls, help customers understand our services, and book appointments accurately. This is a phone-first role for someone with excellent spoken English neutral or light accent, good judgment, and a calm, professional customer service style.



Important: This Is Inbound Sales and Customer Care — Not Cold Calling



Customers are calling us because they already need septic service. However, this is not only basic customer support. The right person must be comfortable helping ready-to-book customers get scheduled, and must also know how to explain our value when a caller is shopping around, unsure, or comparing prices.



Main Responsibilities



Phone-Based Customer Care & Booking — 60%

• Answer inbound calls from U.S. customers with warmth, confidence, and professionalism.

• Schedule septic service appointments in Jobber CRM and enter accurate customer details.

• Explain basic pricing clearly and confidently.

• Ask the right questions about the customer’s issue, location, tank size, timing, and access.

• Help customers understand why Open Water Septic is a strong choice when they are comparing providers.

• Send follow-up texts and
s to customers who requested pricing but did not book.

• Coordinate with the owner and field technician so service details are clear before arrival.

• Process basic payment and billing questions according to company instructions.



Administrative Support — 20%

• Keep organized notes, customer records, and follow-up tasks.

• Assist with unpaid invoice follow-up and simple reports.

• Help improve scripts, templates, and customer communication over time.



Social Media Support — 20%

• Prepare simple
 and Instagram posts using provided photos, service updates, and guidance.

• Respond to basic messages and route service requests quickly.

• Help organize job photos and customer review opportunities.



Service Advantages You Will Learn to Explain



Open Water Septic does more than basic septic pumping. Our service truck can bring multiple solutions to one visit, including:



• A septic pump truck for tank pump-outs.

• A hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of lines at up to 3,000 PSI and reach up to 200 feet.

• A sewer camera that can inspect lines in color and record photos/videos up to 150 feet.



This matters because some septic problems are not only a full tank. If there is a clog or line issue, we may be able to help during the same visit instead of the customer needing to call another company, pay another fee, and wait another day.



What We Are Looking For



Required Experience

• 3+ years phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inbound sales, dispatch, or BPO experience.

• Experience speaking with U.S., Canadian, Australian, or U.K. customers.

• Experience working night shift or U.S. business hours from the Philippines.

• CRM experience preferred; Jobber experience is a plus.

• Home services, plumbing, HVAC, pest control, roofing, garage door, or similar service company experience is a strong plus.



Spoken English Requirement

• Strong spoken English is required because this role involves live phone calls with U.S. customers. No accent or light accent required.

• You must be easy for U.S. callers to understand over the phone.

• You must be able to understand customers without repeatedly asking them to repeat themselves.

• You must be able to explain pricing and service benefits naturally, not just read a script.



Skills and Qualities

• Warm, patient, and confident phone manner.

• Comfortable asking for the booking when the customer is ready.

• Detail-oriented and accurate with names, addresses, phone numbers, prices, and scheduling notes.

• Able to memorize simple pricing and local service area towns.

• Reliable attendance and strong follow-through.

• Good judgment when a customer is upset, has an emergency, or needs a technician quickly.

• Willing to learn basic septic service language over time.



Technical Requirements

• Reliable computer suitable for voice calls, CRM work,
, and basic social media tasks.

• Stable internet with at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.

• Backup internet connection, such as mobile data or a second ISP.

• Quiet workspace for professional customer calls.

• Quality headset with noise-canceling microphone.

• Ability to use phone/CRM systems,
, text messaging tools, Google Workspace, and basic design tools such as Canva.



Information You Will Be Expected to Learn



The right candidate does not need septic experience on day one. We will train you. However, you must be able to memorize and use simple information, including:



• Basic pump-out pricing, including common tank sizes.

• Which towns are in our service area.

• How to explain pump-outs, septic backups, hydrojetting, and camera inspections in simple customer-friendly language.

• How to identify when a customer is ready to book versus when they need a follow-up.



Compensation

Base Pay $700 - $900/month base

Performance Bonus Possible $50-$100/month based on attendance, call quality, booking accuracy, calls converting into jobs, and customer communication.

Payment Schedule Paid twice monthly through an agreed payment platform such as Payoneer, Wise, EasyPay, or similar.

Growth Opportunity Long-term role with room for rate increases as performance and company growth support it.



Contractor Relationship

This is an independent contractor role. The contractor will:

• Complete IRS Form W-8BEN for U.S. tax purposes.

• Handle their own Philippine tax obligations.

• Use their own equipment, internet connection, and workspace.

• Be paid a flat contracted monthly rate plus any earned bonus.



We provide clear expectations, training on our systems, regular feedback, and a stable long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. service company.

How to Apply

Use this subject line:

OPEN WATER SEPTIC — [Your Name]

Please include all of the following:

1. Resume.

2. OnlineJobs.ph profile link.

3. Screenshot of internet speed test.

4. Screenshot of computer specs.

5. A 2-3 minute video recording using the script below.



Required Voice Recording Script



Please record yourself saying this naturally. Do not use AI voice tools. We are listening for clarity, confidence, pacing, warmth, and whether U.S. customers will be able to understand you easily over the phone.



“Hi, this is [Name] with Open Water Septic. I understand your septic system is backing up. We can help with that. Our standard pump-out for a 1,000-gallon tank is $500. What makes us different is that we bring more than just a pump truck. Our truck also has a hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of the line at up to 3,000 PSI, and we also have a sewer camera that can inspect the line in color up to 150 feet. That means if the problem is more than just a full tank, we may be able to help solve it during the same visit instead of you needing to call another company and wait another day.”

title: Funnel Builder
description:
About us



We're a fast-growing, AI-first ecommerce group running supplement and skincare brands across Europe. We build direct-response funnels, test fast, and scale what wins — powered by our own internal platform, Library, which handles most of the heavy lifting from product launch to localization.



We're a small, ambitious team across creative, operations, and media buying. We're adding a Funnel Builder to keep up with our testing and localization volume.





What you'll do:



- Build new product funnels in Library from an approved brief (offer, pricing, angle, copy and creatives are provided)

- Duplicate and localize proven funnels to new markets (currency, language, shipping, guarantee terms, shop-specific details)

- Test every funnel before launch: mobile layout, checkout flow, tracking, links, pricing consistency, typos

- Fix and update live funnels quickly when the team reports an issue

- Keep all funnel statuses updated in Library so the rest of the team knows when a funnel is ready





What we're looking for:



- Hands-on experience building funnels, or a fast learner who picks up systems quickly

- Fast and precise — you build a full funnel in hours, not days, and you don't ship broken links or mismatched pricing

- Strong eye for detail — the kind of person who notices when a guarantee says 60 days in one place and 90 in another

- Good written English

- Reliable internet, own computer

- You follow a process and update your status without being chased





Nice to have:



- Experience with dropshipping or direct-response offers

- Basic design skills (Canva / Figma / Photoshop)

- Comfortable following detailed SOPs and video walkthroughs





What we offer:



- Competitive pay

- Performance bonus tied to company results — everyone from junior to senior shares in it

- A clear growth path: our best builders move into localization lead, QA lead, or operations roles

- A team that moves fast, gives direct feedback, and doesn't micromanage





How to apply:



Interested? Don't reply in the comments — apply by
 to 
 



with:

Subject: funnel wizard

Your availability — when can you start, and are you currently working elsewhere? Mon/Sat - availibilty included

Your hourly rate in USD

title: TikTok Shop Japan – International Lead Research & Outreach Specialist
description:
We are a Japan-based e-commerce and fulfillment company helping international brands and sellers enter the Japanese market.



We are looking for a skilled Research & Outreach Specialist who can identify promising overseas brands and TikTok Shop sellers, evaluate whether their products may have potential in Japan, find the correct business contacts, and introduce our Japan fulfillment and market-entry services.



This is NOT a simple data-entry or mass
 position.



We are looking for someone who can research, think, verify information, understand basic compliance risks, and explain why a company is a strong prospect.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Research promising brands, manufacturers, and sellers in Southeast Asia and other Asian markets.



Main platforms may include:

- TikTok Shop

- Shopee

- Lazada

- Instagram

- Amazon

- Shopify / brand websites



2. Identify products and brands that may have potential in TikTok Shop Japan.



3. Research whether the company is already active in Japan.



Please check for:

- Official Japanese website

- TikTok Shop Japan presence

- Amazon Japan / Rakuten / Yahoo Japan presence

- Japanese distributor or importer

- Japanese warehouse / fulfillment partner

- Japanese company or branch



4. Perform a BASIC regulatory risk check before outreach.



Examples:

- Electrical products / PSE or other Japanese safety requirements

- Cosmetics / skincare

- Food

- Supplements

- Medical or health-related products

- Children's products

- Restricted or prohibited TikTok Shop categories



You are NOT expected to be a lawyer or Japanese regulatory expert.



However, you must be able to research potential risks, use reliable sources, and FLAG products that may require additional review before we contact the company.



5. Find official business contact information.



Preferred contact priority:

Business Development

→ International Sales

→ Wholesale

→ Distributor

→ Partnership

→ Sales

→ Collaboration

→ General Contact



Do NOT guess
 addresses.



6. Explain WHY each company is a strong prospect.



Your research should include evidence such as:

- Sales activity

- Reviews

- Product popularity

- Social media traction

- Marketplace presence

- Japan market gap

- Product suitability for TikTok-style content

- Logistics suitability



7. Prepare personalized outreach messages.



AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini may be used, but all information must be personally verified.



8. Send approved outreach messages and follow up with prospects.



9. Maintain accurate records in Google Sheets or CRM.



TARGET MARKETS



Initial focus:

- Indonesia

- Thailand

- Vietnam

- Malaysia

- Philippines

- Singapore



Future expansion:

- South Korea

- China

- Taiwan

- Hong Kong



IDEAL CANDIDATE



Required:

- Strong online research skills

- Strong written English

- Experience with e-commerce research

- Experience with B2B lead generation or outreach

- Good Google Sheets skills

- Ability to verify information carefully

- Comfortable using AI tools

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to explain your reasoning clearly



Highly preferred:

- TikTok Shop experience

- Shopee or Lazada experience

- Cross-border e-commerce experience

- Product research experience

- Experience finding brands, manufacturers, distributors, or wholesalers

- Cold
 / LinkedIn / Instagram outreach experience

- Experience researching Asian e-commerce markets



IMPORTANT



We do NOT want mass-generated lead lists.



Finding 100 random companies is less valuable than finding 10–20 genuinely strong prospects.



Quality, evidence, and accuracy are more important than volume.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL questions below.



1. Which e-commerce marketplaces have you researched professionally?

Please specify TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, Amazon, Shopify, or others.



2. Have you done B2B lead generation or cold outreach before?

Please explain your process.



3. Imagine you find a product selling very well on TikTok Shop Thailand.

How would you determine whether the brand is a good prospect for entering Japan?



4. How would you check whether the brand already has a distributor, warehouse, official seller, or business presence in Japan?



5. If the product is an electrical appliance, cosmetic, supplement, food product, or health-related product, what would you check before contacting the company?



6. Please find ONE real brand from Southeast Asia that you believe may be a good candidate for TikTok Shop Japan.



Please provide:

- Brand name

- Country

- Official website

- Main product

- Evidence showing why the product/brand is interesting

- Whether they appear to already operate in Japan

- Official business contact URL or

- Why you selected this brand



Please do NOT use a generic AI-generated answer. We will verify the company, URLs, and evidence you provide.



Applications that do not answer all questions will not be considered.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
To be considered, you must fill out the application form below:


/ansiblehealth/2475d4d7-7ed7-449e-a350-75eb5484b5db





What is Ansible Health?

Ansible Health unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We are looking for a top-tier Patient Care Coordinator to become an integral part of our expanding team. This role is vital in delivering the best care possible to our patients, handling patient communications, and providing essential support to our clinical staff in their mission to offer exceptional care. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exemplary professionalism, excellent English language communication skills, and outstanding organizational abilities with meticulous attention to detail. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to our patient-centric approach in healthcare delivery.



Responsibilities

• Customize initial discussions based on patient needs, ensuring they understand how the program can address their specific health conditions, providing personalized benefits rather than general services.

, etc.), including voi

The ideal candidate for this role at Ansible Health is a dynamic professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment. • Typing speed of at least 60 words per minute.

Nice to have

• Proven track record in sales.

Job Details

Full-time: Full-time: 40 hours a week (with a possible shifting schedule including weekends)

Benefits: Flexible PTO and HMO coverage

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work US hours - EST/EDT)

title: Family Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Please Read the Whole Job Description Before Applying.



At Meadow, we’re reimagining end-of-life care - a $23B industry untouched by modern software or service thinking. In under a year, we became the largest cremation provider in Los Angeles, with 80+ NPS and hundreds of families served monthly. Now we’re scaling across the U.S. and hiring globally.



We believe great people live everywhere. Our team works across continents and time zones, grounded by shared values: high standards, deep empathy, and a drive to do work that matters.



Learn more about our global teams here: 
/global

If this sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role

We’re hiring Family Coordinators to support families from the moment a loved one enters our care through the final steps of the cremation process. You’ll play a critical role in ensuring every case is handled with accuracy, compassion, and attention to detail.



In this role, you’ll be responsible for managing a dedicated book of cases, serving as a primary point of contact for families, and handling inbound inquiries related to those cases. You’ll coordinate key parts of the process - including transportation, documentation, cremation scheduling, and ashes return - while ensuring families receive clear communication and thoughtful support throughout.



At the same time, this is a highly collaborative environment. While each representative owns assigned cases, the team works closely together to support the broader case load, step in during high-volume moments, and ensure no family experiences delays or gaps in care. Success in this role requires both strong personal accountability and a team-first mindset.



This position is ideal for someone who is empathetic, organized, and comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment. We’re in active build mode, and this role offers meaningful growth for someone who is proactive, collaborative, and motivated to support others during an important moment in their lives.



What You’ll Do:

-Support families primarily through inbound phone calls, as well as text and
, with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned cases, building trust through frequent phone conversations.

- Guide families through each step of the process while building trust and rapport.

- Coordinate key case milestones, including transportation, documentation, cremation scheduling, and ashes return.

- Collaborate with teammates to support the broader case load and maintain continuity of care.

- Assist with team coverage, escalations, and urgent case needs as volumes shift.

- Partner with internal teams and external vendors to keep cases moving efficiently.

- Maintain accurate documentation, update systems promptly, and proactively flag issues.

- Ensure smooth case handoffs and anticipate downstream impacts.

- Work across HubSpot, Aircall, Slack, GSuite, and our internal case management system.



Requirements & Qualifications:

-  2+ years in customer support, hospitality, case management, account or client coordination, or similar customer-facing roles. Experience owning a caseload or book of accounts end-to-end is strongly preferred; comfort in high-volume, phone-based environments is a plus.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Clear, calm communicator who builds trust quickly, whether over the phone,
, or text.

- Strong multitasker - able to move quickly while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

- Accountable and proactive: you take ownership, close the loop, and surface issues early.

- Energized by our mission and excited about the opportunity to help shape something new in a category that truly needs it.

- A home setup that supports the work - see our tech requirements for details.



Bonus Points

- Experience in environments where empathy and execution were equally important.

- Spanish fluency - many of the families we serve speak it.



Details:

- Remote, full-time

Compensation: $5-$7.80/hr (USD)

Tools: HubSpot (CRM), Aircall (phone), Slack, and our case management system

Shift: Full-time (consistent schedule)

Days:

- Monday–Friday

Hours: US Day Shift:

- 8 a.m. - 4:30 pm PT including a 30-minute lunch break



Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

- We’re a real business, built to last. We’ve proven our model in LA and became the largest independent funeral home in California in less than two years. We’re now going national. And plan to grow for years to come.

- A serious employer for global teammates. We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.

- People stay. Regrettable turnover is very low. Don't take our word for it - read our Glassdoor reviews.

- Fair compensation with real upside. Base pay benchmarked globally. Top performers consistently earn the full bonuses.

- High care, high standards. Real investment in training and growth, honest feedback, no burnout culture.

- Benefits: PTO, 10 paid holidays, paid training, fully remote.

- Purpose-driven work: Real impact during one of life's most meaningful transitions.
