title: Inbound Customer Care Representative - Excellent Spoken English Required
description:
Inbound Customer Care Representative - Excellent Spoken English Required



U.S. Home Services / Septic Company | Remote Contractor Role



Company Open Water Septic Tank Services LLC — family-owned septic service company in Georgia, USA

Role Type Full-time independent contractor, phone-first customer care and inbound appointment booking

Schedule Monday-Friday, 5:00 PM-8:00 PM and Saturday-Sunday 7:00 am - 7:00 pm U.S. Eastern Time; Philippine time varies with U.S. daylight saving time

Compensation USD $700 - $900/month base, plus performance bonus potential $50 - $100 bonus

Target Start As soon as the right candidate is selected



About Us

Open Water Septic is a growing family-owned septic service company based in Georgia, USA. We help homeowners and businesses with septic tank pumping, septic backups, inspections, hydrojetting, sewer camera inspections, and related service needs.



We are looking for a long-term remote team member in the Philippines who can answer inbound customer calls, help customers understand our services, and book appointments accurately. This is a phone-first role for someone with excellent spoken English neutral or light accent, good judgment, and a calm, professional customer service style.



Customers are calling us because they already need septic service. However, this is not only basic customer support. The right person must be comfortable helping ready-to-book customers get scheduled, and must also know how to explain our value when a caller is shopping around, unsure, or comparing prices.



Main Responsibilities



Phone-Based Customer Care & Booking — 60%

• Answer inbound calls from U.S. customers with warmth, confidence, and professionalism.

• Schedule septic service appointments in Jobber CRM and enter accurate customer details.

• Explain basic pricing clearly and confidently.

• Ask the right questions about the customer’s issue, location, tank size, timing, and access.

• Help customers understand why Open Water Septic is a strong choice when they are comparing providers.

• Send follow-up texts and
s to customers who requested pricing but did not book.

• Coordinate with the owner and field technician so service details are clear before arrival.

• Process basic payment and billing questions according to company instructions.



Administrative Support — 20%

• Keep organized notes, customer records, and follow-up tasks.

• Assist with unpaid invoice follow-up and simple reports.

• Help improve scripts, templates, and customer communication over time.



Social Media Support — 20%

• Prepare simple
 and Instagram posts using provided photos, service updates, and guidance.

• Respond to basic messages and route service requests quickly.

• Help organize job photos and customer review opportunities.



Service Advantages You Will Learn to Explain



Open Water Septic does more than basic septic pumping. Our service truck can bring multiple solutions to one visit, including:



• A septic pump truck for tank pump-outs.

• A hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of lines at up to 3,000 PSI and reach up to 200 feet.

• A sewer camera that can inspect lines in color and record photos/videos up to 150 feet.



This matters because some septic problems are not only a full tank. If there is a clog or line issue, we may be able to help during the same visit instead of the customer needing to call another company, pay another fee, and wait another day.



What We Are Looking For



Required Experience

• 3+ years phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inbound sales, dispatch, or BPO experience.

• Experience speaking with U.S., Canadian, Australian, or U.K. customers.

• Experience working night shift or U.S. business hours from the Philippines.

• CRM experience preferred; Jobber experience is a plus.

• Home services, plumbing, HVAC, pest control, roofing, garage door, or similar service company experience is a strong plus.



Spoken English Requirement

• Strong spoken English is required because this role involves live phone calls with U.S. customers. No accent or light accent required.

• You must be easy for U.S. callers to understand over the phone.

• You must be able to understand customers without repeatedly asking them to repeat themselves.

• You must be able to explain pricing and service benefits naturally, not just read a script.



Skills and Qualities

• Warm, patient, and confident phone manner.

• Comfortable asking for the booking when the customer is ready.

• Detail-oriented and accurate with names, addresses, phone numbers, prices, and scheduling notes.

• Able to memorize simple pricing and local service area towns.

• Reliable attendance and strong follow-through.

• Good judgment when a customer is upset, has an emergency, or needs a technician quickly.

• Willing to learn basic septic service language over time.



Technical Requirements

• Reliable computer suitable for voice calls, CRM work,
, and basic social media tasks.

• Stable internet with at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.

• Backup internet connection, such as mobile data or a second ISP.

• Quiet workspace for professional customer calls.

• Quality headset with noise-canceling microphone.

• Ability to use phone/CRM systems,
, text messaging tools, Google Workspace, and basic design tools such as Canva.



Information You Will Be Expected to Learn



The right candidate does not need septic experience on day one. We will train you. However, you must be able to memorize and use simple information, including:



• Basic pump-out pricing, including common tank sizes.

• Which towns are in our service area.

• How to explain pump-outs, septic backups, hydrojetting, and camera inspections in simple customer-friendly language.

• How to identify when a customer is ready to book versus when they need a follow-up.



Compensation

Base Pay $700 - $900/month base

Performance Bonus Possible $50-$100/month based on attendance, call quality, booking accuracy, calls converting into jobs, and customer communication.

Payment Schedule Paid twice monthly through an agreed payment platform such as Payoneer, Wise, EasyPay, or similar.

Growth Opportunity Long-term role with room for rate increases as performance and company growth support it.



Contractor Relationship

This is an independent contractor role. The contractor will:

• Complete IRS Form W-8BEN for U.S. tax purposes.

• Handle their own Philippine tax obligations.

• Use their own equipment, internet connection, and workspace.

• Be paid a flat contracted monthly rate plus any earned bonus.



We provide clear expectations, training on our systems, regular feedback, and a stable long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. service company.

How to Apply

Use this subject line:

OPEN WATER SEPTIC — [Your Name]

Please include all of the following:

1. Resume.

2. OnlineJobs.ph profile link.

3. Screenshot of internet speed test.

4. Screenshot of computer specs.

5. A 2-3 minute video recording using the script below.



Required Voice Recording Script



Please record yourself saying this naturally. Do not use AI voice tools. We are listening for clarity, confidence, pacing, warmth, and whether U.S. customers will be able to understand you easily over the phone.



“Hi, this is [Name] with Open Water Septic. I understand your septic system is backing up. We can help with that. Our standard pump-out for a 1,000-gallon tank is $500. What makes us different is that we bring more than just a pump truck. Our truck also has a hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of the line at up to 3,000 PSI, and we also have a sewer camera that can inspect the line in color up to 150 feet. That means if the problem is more than just a full tank, we may be able to help solve it during the same visit instead of you needing to call another company and wait another day.”

title: Senior Shopify CX Operator — One-of-a-Kind E-com, Night Shift ET
description:
Cowhides Direct is a US hide brand, in business since 1998. We own the warehouse in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. Every cowhide rug is photographed in our own studio. The hide in the photo is the hide that ships — no stock shots, no substitutions, a certificate of authenticity in the box. Around 10,000 hides in stock. Every one is different.



This post is for someone who can drop in.



If you have already run Shopify for a brand where the unit on the page is the unit that ships — handmade, vintage, furniture, rugs, one-of-ones — you already know the job. Unique SKUs. The photo is a promise. The process has to match the product. If your last role was a ticket queue on identical SKUs, our other CX post is a better fit.



THE SEAT

One Senior Customer Experience & Operations Operator. Phone,
, chat. You finish the problem on that contact. You notice the same issue twice and write the process so it stops. Project-manager brain, willing to do the customer work. Same pay and shift as our other CX seat. Higher bar on what you already know.



PAY

$1,300–$1,600 USD per month, full-time, 40 hours. Long-term.



THE SHIFT (read this twice)

- 9:00am to 5:00pm Eastern Time / 9:00pm to 5:00am Philippines

- Eight-hour shifts. 40 hours. Night shift covering US daytime.

- We answer seven days. Weekend days are assigned. Daytime Philippines hours is the wrong post.

- Attendance is tracked. Cameras on for training gates. First seven calendar days are paid training, earned by completing every scheduled 8-hour shift. Miss or leave early without notice before the shift starts, and that day ends the engagement.



WHAT "DROP-IN" MEANS HERE

Shopify order states are already muscle memory. You have changed an address, cancelled an unfulfilled order, issued a partial refund, and written a note the next person could pick up cold.



You already know unique-product support is different:

- Ask before you recommend. Size, room, light, pets, floors. Recommending first creates returns.

- Never extend a one-of-a-kind promise to a product stocked by color.

- "It arrived folded" is usually not a defect. Save that call.

- Natural marks are character. Never call a clearance hide a second, a reject, or B-grade.

- Check history before you speak.



You will learn our hides, sizing, and authority table in training. You will not be learning what an order is, or how to talk to someone spending real money on a room they care about.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- US customers on the phone. Greeting, read-back of every number, solve it before she hangs up.

- One inbox: live chat,
, phone. Shopify data beside the conversation. Written procedures with citations. D
. Escalate only when it is actually not yours.

- Cancels, address changes, returns, missing gifts, folded-on-arrival, "is this the exact hide" — inside a written authority table.

- English we can send unedited. Short sentences. No filler. No invented reasons.

- Flag gaps. If you escalated something that should have had a procedure, write the procedure.



WHO THIS IS FOR

- 3+ years Shopify e-commerce support or ops, not "I used Shopify once."

- Unique-SKU or made-to-order catalog, or a brand where the photo is the unit.

- Helpdesk you could open tomorrow (Gorgias, Help Scout, Zendesk, or Reamaze) plus actual Shopify admin: orders, refunds, addresses, inventory exceptions.

- Tenures of 18 months or longer. You built a system other people still use.

- Hard customers do not make you blame the customer. When you mess up, you can say exactly what you did.

- Quiet workspace, a computer (not a phone), stable internet, backup power or internet. Speed-test screenshot required.

- You can commit to THIS shift. "I can start whenever" is a no. No overlapping full-time job.



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

Flexible VA gigs, overlapping jobs, script readers, AI-written applications, anyone who cannot do a live video gate camera-on with no notes, anyone who needs a week to learn what fulfilled means.



HOW TO APPLY

We read every file. The people who do all three get seen first.



1. Put GRAIN as the first word of your reply. Then why this night shift works for your life right now.

2. Walk through one Shopify (or equivalent) exception you finished without escalating: wrong address after fulfillment, unique SKU out of spec, split shipment, partial refund, or a photo-vs-product complaint. Tools, clicks, what you told the customer, what you wrote down. Specifics. No essays.

3. In the last two years, how many scheduled shifts or meetings did you miss without giving notice beforehand? What happened?



Also include: recent internet speed-test screenshot, backup power or internet (yes/no), hours you can actually work in Philippines time.



If you cannot do 9:00pm–5:00am Philippines, do not apply. One long-term seat. Smart enough to drop in.



Jason H

Cowhides Direct

Our services include benefits investigation, prior authorization submission, patient assistance enrollment, pharmacy coordination, and patient engagement.

Our tea
mbers operate as extensions of provider offices, supporting clinical staff through accurate documentation and consistent follow-up.

Squad Health is hiring a Medication Coordinator to ensure patients get on therapy quickly and affordably. You will be responsible for identifying the root cause driving issues with scripts and resolving them by coordinating with different stakeholders—doctors, patients, pharmacies, and payers—to minimize delay in care. A standout person in this role will drive higher satisfaction among providers and reduce time-to-therapy for patients.

The ideal candidate will have had at least 1 year of managing a team of prior authorization specialists at a specialty clinic or shown equivalent development in a prior authorization role at a specialty clinic. You are low-ego, curious, and love getting into the weeds to solve complex problems for providers and patients.



Responsibilities

Document issues that arise to surface tactical feedback for our operations, product, and tech teams

Work closely with different Squad tea
mbers to resolve patient cases

Maintain patience and empathy with our providers and patients to make sure they feel supported and confident that we are properly handling their medications

Have strong verbal and written English communication skills 

Have a strong growth mindset but are also low ego and willing to get your hands dirty solving difficult situations



Qualifications

1+ years at a specialty clinic submitting and managing prior authorizations for specialty medications (e.g., biologics, GLP-1s) - ideal is at allergy / ENT, pulmonology, gastroenterology, neurology, or urology clinic

1+ years managing other tea
mbers, i.e., tracking their performance, providing feedback, creating and maintaining training materials

Showed growth in their position, i.e., 1 promotion in the past 2 years at the same clinic

title: Corporate Sales & Wholesale Coordinator — B2B Outreach, Client Management & Canva
description:
We are a growing consumer products company looking for a reliable and proactive **Corporate Sales & Wholesale Coordinator** to help grow our B2B business.



We sell premium consumer products internationally and work with companies that order customized products for corporate gifts, employees, events, clients, promotions, and wholesale/resale.



This is a long-term position for someone who is organized, communicates very well in English, enjoys working with clients, and is comfortable doing both sales outreach and account management.



You do **not** need to be an expert in our products or corporate gifting. We will teach you our products, pricing, customization options, and processes.



## Your Responsibilities



### 1. Find New Corporate Clients



You will research companies that may be interested in purchasing customized products.



This includes:



* Finding potential corporate clients

* Researching the appropriate decision makers

* Building prospect lists

* Sending personalized cold
s

* Following up with potential customers

* Identifying new industries and companies to target

* Finding potential wholesale and retail partners



We do not want someone who simply sends hundreds of generic
s.



We are looking for someone who can research good prospects, communicate professionally, and consistently follow up.



### 2. Handle Incoming Corporate Inquiries



Companies regularly contact us asking about customized products.



You will eventually be responsible for helping manage these inquiries from beginning to end.



Tasks include:



* Replying to client
s

* Understanding what the client is looking for

* Recommending suitable products

* Explaining pricing, MOQ, customization options, and production timelines

* Preparing quotations

* Following up with clients

* Collecting purchase orders

* Coordinating invoices and payment

* Keeping clients updated during production

* Helping arrange shipping and delivery



You will be trained on our products and pricing before handling inquiries independently.



### 3. Create Basic Product Mockups



Corporate customers often send us their company logo and ask to see how it would look on our products.



You will create simple product mockups by placing client logos onto our existing product templates.



This is **not advanced graphic design**.



You should be comfortable using tools such as:



* Canva

* Photoshop

* Illustrator



Basic design skills and good visual judgment are enough.



### 4. Manage Leads and Follow-Ups



Organization is extremely important for this role.



You will maintain our corporate sales tracking system and make sure no potential customer is forgotten.



You will:



* Track every lead

* Record conversations

* Schedule follow-ups

* Keep track of quotes

* Track samples sent

* Track pending orders

* Follow up with old leads

* Contact previous corporate clients about reorders



We want someone who naturally thinks:



"I haven't heard from this customer for five days. I should follow up."



Rather than waiting to be told what to do.



### 5. Develop Wholesale Accounts



Over time, you will also help grow our wholesale business.



This may include:



* Finding retailers

* Finding distributors

* Contacting potential wholesale partners

* Sending wholesale information

* Handling sample requests

* Following up with wholesale prospects

* Maintaining relationships with existing wholesale customers



## What We're Looking For



You should have:



* Excellent written English

* Strong communication skills

* Very good organization

* Attention to detail

* Confidence communicating with business customers

* Experience with B2B sales, lead generation, customer service, account management, or business development

* Experience using spreadsheets or a CRM

* Basic Canva or graphic design ability

* Good online research skills

* Strong follow-up habits

* Ability to work independently



Experience selling physical products, promotional products, corporate gifts, merchandise, wholesale products, or customized products is a big advantage.



## Most Important Qualities



We care more about your attitude and working style than having the perfect resume.



The ideal person is:



* Proactive

* Organized

* Persistent without being pushy

* Professional

* Friendly

* Reliable

* Comfortable learning new things

* Good at keeping track of many conversations at once

* Not afraid to follow up multiple times



We are especially looking for someone who can eventually take ownership of our corporate sales pipeline instead of waiting for instructions for every task.



## About Us



We operate a portfolio of consumer brands selling internationally.



Our corporate customers purchase customized products for:



* Employee gifts

* Customer gifts

* Events

* Conferences

* Promotional campaigns

* Company merchandise

* Wholesale and retail



You will work closely with the business owners and will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility as the corporate side of the company grows.



## Work Type



Long-term remote position.



We are looking for someone interested in growing with the company rather than someone looking for a short-term freelance project.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Any experience you have with B2B sales, lead generation, account management, customer service, or wholesale.

3. What tools you have used for CRM or tracking leads.

4. Your experience with Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator.

5. An example of how you would follow up with a potential corporate customer who received a quotation five days ago but has not replied.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. Your available working hours and timezone.



Please start your application with the words **"CORPORATE SALES"** so we know you read the full job description.



We are looking forward to finding someone who can become an important part of our team and help us grow our corporate and wholesale business.
